title: High-Order Markov Blanket Discovery via a k-Order Relaxation of the Faithfulness Assumption
comments: 17 pages (9 pages main text + supplementary material), 4 figures, 8 tables, 3 algorithms. Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). Code: https://github.com/lklee9/k-order-Markov-blanket
summary: The problem of learning the graphical Markov blanket (MB) of a variable from data has applications in many areas such as structure learning for Bayesian networks and Markov random fields, causal discovery, and feature selection. However, a common assumption most methods make is that the conditional independencies in the distribution imply the same separation in the graphical structure -- also known as the faithfulness assumption. Unfortunately, this assumption can be violated by higher-order dependencies such as XOR and parity-type relations, and -- on finite samples -- by empirical violations that, in extreme cases, even induce spurious dependencies absent from the true distribution. Therefore, in this paper we propose a "k-order" relaxation of the faithfulness assumption that captures parity type relationships between k+2 variables. We then propose a proof of concept algorithm called k-order Markov blanket (kOMB) that uses this relaxation for MB discovery. Finally, we empirically show how kOMB can recover the MB of a variable under both true and empirical violations of faithfulness. Code available at: https://github.com/lklee9/k-order-Markov-blanket
comment: 17 pages (9 pages main text + supplementary material), 4 figures, 8 tables, 3 algorithms. Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). Code: https://github.com/lklee9/k-order-Markov-blanket

AI.title_translation: 通过忠实性假设的 k 阶松弛实现高阶马尔可夫毯发现
AI.tldr: 本文提出了忠实性假设的“k阶”松弛及kOMB算法，解决了存在异或等高阶依赖和有限样本偏差时传统马尔可夫毯发现算法失效的问题。
AI.motivation: 大多数现有的马尔可夫毯（MB）发现方法均依赖“忠实性假设”，即条件独立性与图结构中的分离完全对应。然而，这一假设常被高阶依赖关系（如异或XOR或奇偶类型关系）破坏，且在有限样本下易发生经验性违背导致虚假依赖，从而使得传统MB发现算法失效。
AI.method: 提出了忠实性假设的“k阶”松弛（k-order relaxation），用以捕获k+2个变量之间的奇偶类型关系；基于该松弛提出了“k阶马尔可夫毯”（kOMB）概念验证算法来进行马尔可夫毯的发现。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，在存在真实的忠实性违背（如高阶奇偶依赖）以及有限样本导致的经验违背场景下，kOMB算法均能成功恢复目标变量的马尔可夫毯。
AI.conclusion: 通过对传统忠实性假设进行k阶松弛，kOMB算法能够有效克服高阶交互及有限样本偏差带来的影响，成功恢复复杂分布下的马尔可夫毯。
AI.translation: 从数据中学习变量的图马尔可夫毯（MB）问题在贝叶斯网络和马尔可夫随机场的结构学习、因果发现以及特征选择等许多领域都有应用。然而，大多数方法做出的一个共同假设是：分布中的条件独立性意味着图结构中存在相同的分离——这也称为忠实性假设。不幸的是，该假设可能会受到高阶依赖关系（如异或XOR和奇偶类型关系）的破坏，并且在有限样本上，还会受到经验性违背的影响，在极端情况下甚至会诱发真实分布中不存在的虚假依赖。因此，在本文中，我们提出了忠实性假设的“k阶”松弛，能够捕获 k+2 个变量之间的奇偶类型关系。随后，我们提出了一种名为k阶马尔可夫毯（kOMB）的概念验证算法，该算法利用这种松弛来进行MB发现。最后，我们通过实验展示了在忠实性假设存在真实违背和经验违背的情况下，kOMB 如何恢复变量的马尔可夫毯。代码获取地址：https://github.com/lklee9/k-order-Markov-blanket。
AI.summary: 本文针对忠实性假设容易因高阶依赖关系（如XOR）及有限样本偏差而失效的问题，提出了忠实性假设的“k阶”松弛理论，并开发了kOMB算法。实验证明，该算法能够有效克服忠实性假设被破坏的影响，准确恢复变量的马尔可夫毯。
AI.keywords: 马尔可夫毯发现, 忠实性假设, k阶松弛, 高阶依赖, 因果发现
AI.comments:
创新点：提出了忠实性假设的k阶松弛机制，突破了图模型与因果发现中长期依赖强忠实性假设的局限，有效解决了异或（XOR）和奇偶交互等高阶依赖难以识别的问题。
重要性：在现实复杂数据及有限样本场景下，忠实性假设极易失效，该研究为提高马尔可夫毯发现和特征选择的鲁棒性提供了重要理论支持和实践工具。
局限性：作为概念验证算法，当阶数k增大时，需要检验的变量组合呈指数级增长，其在高维数据中的计算效率和可扩展性有待进一步优化。

title: Post-Training at the Edge of Detectability: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Fine-Tuning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning is widely used in language model training to improve model performance on a target task while limiting drift from a reference policy. A standard way to balance this trade-off is via a KL-regularized RL objective, although this formulation does not by itself provide a principled way to set the regularization coefficient. In practice, the coefficient is typically chosen heuristically or via hyperparameter search, which can lead to unnecessary overhead in training cost or undesirable reward-retention trade-offs. We instead propose a game-theoretic framework that gives this trade-off an explicit statistical interpretation. Specifically, we study a sequential game in which an agent chooses a policy to maximize cumulative reward while a monitor observes policy outputs over time and tests for deviations from the reference policy. Although not originating from the same perspective, we show that the resulting equilibrium policy can nonetheless be expressed as the solution to a KL-regularized RL problem for an optimal regularization parameter that can be viewed as maximizing reward per unit of statistical distinguishability. Drawing on classical results from concave-convex fractional programming, we provide a principled method for learning this equilibrium coefficient via reduction to the KL-regularized RL objective, thus allowing for flexible integration into standard fine-tuning pipelines. In experiments with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.2-1B, we demonstrate that our methods result in competitive reward-retention trade-offs in a continual learning setting, and illustrate how our framework may be used to audit API providers serving open-source models.

AI.title_translation: 可检测性边缘的后训练：基于博弈论的微调方法
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于博弈论的微调框架，将KL正则化系数设为最大化单位统计可区分性奖励的最优解，实现高效且有理论保障的微调。
AI.motivation: 在语言模型强化学习微调中，标准KL正则化RL方法缺乏确定正则化系数的原则性依据，依赖启发式或超参搜索会导致高训练成本及不理想的奖励-保留（reward-retention）权衡。
AI.method: 构建了一个代理（最大化累积奖励）与监视器（检测偏离参考策略）之间的时序博弈框架；利用凹凸分式规划（concave-convex fractional programming）将平衡策略规约为KL正则化RL目标，从而自动学习最优正则化系数。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.2-1B模型上的实验表明，该方法在持续学习场景中取得了极具竞争力的奖励-保留权衡，并展示了在审计开源模型API提供商方面的应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该博弈论框架为KL正则化RL微调中的超参选择提供了原则性的统计解释，能够无缝集成到标准微调流水线中并实现更优的奖励-保留权衡。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）微调广泛用于语言模型训练，以提高模型在目标任务上的性能，同时限制与参考策略的偏离。平衡这种权衡的标准方法是通过KL正则化的RL目标，尽管这种公式本身并没有提供设置正则化系数的原则性方法。在实践中，该系数通常是基于启发式方法或通过超参数搜索来选择的，这可能会导致不必要的训练成本开销或不理想的奖励-保留（reward-retention）权衡。相反，我们提出了一种博弈论框架，为这种权衡提供了明确的统计解释。具体而言，我们研究了一个时序博弈，其中代理选择一种策略来最大化累积奖励，而监视器随着时间的推移观察策略输出并检验与参考策略的偏离。尽管并非出自相同的视角，但我们证明所产生的平衡策略仍然可以表达为在最优正则化参数下KL正则化RL问题的解，该参数可以被视为最大化每单位统计可区分性的奖励。利用凹凸分式规划的经典结果，我们提供了一种通过规约为KL正则化RL目标来学习该平衡系数的原则性方法，从而可以灵活地集成到标准微调流水线中。在Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.2-1B的实验中，我们证明了我们的方法在持续学习设置中能够带来具有竞争力的奖励-保留权衡，并说明了如何使用我们的框架来审计提供开源模型的API提供商。
AI.summary: 本研究针对大语言模型强化学习微调中KL正则化系数难以确定的问题，提出了一种基于博弈论的分析框架。通过将微调过程建模为代理与检测器之间的时序博弈，论文将最优正则化参数解释为最大化“每单位统计可区分性的奖励”，并通过凹凸分式规划实现了该参数的自动学习。实验证明该方法在持续学习中展现出优异的性能权衡。
AI.keywords: 强化学习微调, 博弈论, KL正则化, 统计可区分性, 持续学习
AI.comments:
创新性：将微调过程创新性地建模为代理与检测器之间的时序博弈，从“单位统计可区分性奖励”的角度给出了KL正则化系数选择的理论依据。
重要性：解决了强化学习微调中超参搜索成本高、系数设定缺乏原则性依据的痛点，且能灵活融入现有微调流水线。
局限性：检测器模式的假设可能对更复杂或隐蔽的模型漂移设置提出了更高的建模要求，仍需在更多复杂下游任务中验证其实用性。

title: Embedding Items at Scale: Comparing GNN-Based and ID-Based Item Embeddings in the Yandex Ecosystem
summary: Transformer-based sequential recommendation models, which process sequences of user-item interactions, rely heavily on the item embedding strategy. Existing approaches either use pretrained item embeddings or learn them end-to-end with the transformer. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has compared these options from both cost and quality perspectives in a large-scale industrial setting. This paper is a case study that compares pretrained industrial graph neural network item embeddings with end-to-end trainable item embeddings across two mature production recommendation systems at Yandex: Yandex Market and Yandex Music. We additionally evaluate both approaches on a low-resource dataset sampled from Yandex Lavka production logs, for which both the data and code are publicly available for demonstration purposes. Our results show that a separate pretraining stage helps when training data is limited, but provides no worthwhile benefit for large-scale models trained on extensive datasets.

AI.title_translation: 大规模物品嵌入：在 Yandex 生态系统中比较基于 GNN 和基于 ID 的物品嵌入
AI.tldr: Yandex的大规模工业推荐系统对比研究表明：预训练物品嵌入仅在小数据/低资源场景有用；在海量数据的大规模系统中，端到端训练更加高效且无需预训练开销。
AI.motivation: 基于 Transformer 的序列推荐模型严重依赖物品嵌入策略，但现有研究缺乏在大规模工业场景下，从计算成本和推荐质量两个角度对“预训练物品嵌入”与“端到端训练物品嵌入”进行系统性对比。
AI.method: 作为一项案例研究，在 Yandex 的两个成熟生产推荐系统（Yandex Market 和 Yandex Music）以及从 Yandex Lavka 生产日志中采样的低资源数据集上，对比了预训练的工业级图神经网络（GNN）物品嵌入与端到端可训练的物品（ID）嵌入。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，当训练数据有限时，单独的预训练阶段有助于提升模型表现；但在海量数据集上训练的大规模模型中，预训练阶段并未带来值得付出的收益。
AI.conclusion: 在数据资源有限的场景下，独立的物品嵌入预训练阶段能够提升推荐质量；但在拥有海量训练数据的大规模工业推荐系统中，预训练阶段无法带来有价值的收益，直接进行端到端训练更加高效。
AI.translation: 基于 Transformer 的序列推荐模型用于处理用户-物品交互序列，严重依赖于物品嵌入策略。现有的方法要么使用预训练的物品嵌入，要么与 Transformer 一起进行端到端学习。据我们所知，此前尚无工作在大规模工业场景下从成本和质量两个角度对这些选项进行对比。本文是一项案例研究，在 Yandex 的两个成熟生产推荐系统（Yandex Market 和 Yandex Music）中，对比了预训练的工业级图神经网络物品嵌入与端到端可训练的物品嵌入。此外，我们还在从 Yandex Lavka 生产日志中采样的低资源数据集上评估了这两种方法，该数据集和代码均公开可用以供演示。我们的结果表明，当训练数据有限时，独立的预训练阶段是有帮助的，但对于在海量数据集上训练的大规模模型而言，预训练并没有带来值得的收益。
AI.summary: 本文评估了基于 Transformer 的序列推荐模型中两种主流的物品嵌入策略：预训练 GNN 嵌入与端到端 ID 嵌入。通过在 Yandex 多个真实工业级推荐场景（Yandex Market、Yandex Music 及低资源数据集 Yandex Lavka）上的对比实验，揭示了预训练仅在低资源场景有效，而在海量数据的大规模系统中，端到端训练成本更低且效果相当。
AI.keywords: 序列推荐, 物品嵌入, 图神经网络, 工业级推荐系统, 端到端训练
AI.comments: 本文具有极高的工业实战价值，创新与重要性在于首次在大规模真实生产系统（Yandex生态）中，从“效果”与“计算成本”两个维度全面对比了GNN预训练嵌入与端到端ID嵌入的优劣，为工业界推荐系统的架构选型提供了明确务实的指导。局限性在于结论主要基于Yandex的业务场景，在不同领域图拓扑结构下的泛化性仍有待验证。

title: Exploring Structures in Physics Problems: Can AI Agents Discover Statistical Mechanical Mappings?
comments: Accepted to the AID-Wild workshop at CAIS 2026
summary: An important skill in theoretical physics is to recognize when a new problem can be transformed into a known model. We study this skill as an AI-agent task: can LLM-based agents discover statistical mechanical mappings from a raw partition function to a tractable representation? To probe this question, we introduce StatMechBench-v0, a benchmark of six Ising-type problems covering transfer-matrix methods, gauge-removable disorder, and planar/Pfaffian structure. We evaluate a simple propose-verify-revise agent across multiple LLMs and problem phrasings. The results show that numerical feedback often helps agents repair code and recover correct partition functions. However, agents can also pass the numerical checks while misidentifying the underlying tractable class or understating computational complexity. This both reveals limitations in current LLM reasoning and calls for a verification stack that goes beyond numerical agreement, incorporating, for example, symbolic checks and structural invariants. Our study provides an early evaluation and design directions for AI agents aimed at structural discovery in theoretical physics.
comment: Accepted to the AID-Wild workshop at CAIS 2026

AI.title_translation: 探索物理问题中的结构：AI Agent能否发现统计力学映射？
AI.tldr: 本文提出了StatMechBench-v0基准，评估LLM Agent能否发现物理问题中的统计力学映射，研究发现数值反馈虽有助于纠错，但Agent常在未真正理解物理结构的情况下误通过数值检验。
AI.motivation: 理论物理中的关键技能是将新问题转化为已知的可解模型。本文旨在研究基于LLM的AI Agent是否具备从原始配分函数中自动发现并映射到可处理物理模型的能力。
AI.method: 提出了一个包含六个Ising类型问题的基准测试StatMechBench-v0（涵盖转移矩阵、规范可消除无序和平面/Pfaffian结构），并利用多种大语言模型和问题表述方式，评估了一个简单的“提出-验证-修改”（propose-verify-revise）Agent架构。
AI.result: 数值反馈能有效帮助Agent修复代码并计算出正确的配分函数；但Agent容易出现“假阳性”现象，即虽然通过了数值测试，却误判了底层可解的物理类别或低估了计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前LLM在物理结构推理上的局限性，表明仅依靠数值对比不足以保证物理理解的正确性，呼吁构建包含符号检查和结构不变量的复合验证机制，为物理学AI Agent的发展提供了早期评估与设计指南。
AI.translation: 理论物理中的一项重要技能是识别新问题何时可以转化为已知模型。我们将这项技能作为一项AI Agent任务来进行研究：基于LLM的Agent能否从原始配分函数中发现向可解表示的统计力学映射？为了探索这一问题，我们推出了StatMechBench-v0，这是一个包含六个Ising类型问题的基准，涵盖转移矩阵方法、规范可消除无序以及平面/Pfaffian结构。我们在多种LLM和问题表述下评估了一个简单的“提出-验证-修改”Agent。结果表明，数值反馈通常有助于Agent修复代码并恢复正确的配分函数。然而，Agent也可能在通过数值检查的同时，误判底层可解类或低估计算复杂度。这既揭示了当前LLM推理的局限性，也呼吁建立超越数值一致性的验证栈，例如结合符号检查和结构不变量。我们的研究为旨在探索理论物理结构的AI Agent提供了早期评估与设计方向。
AI.summary: 本文探究了大语言模型Agent在理论物理中发现统计力学模型映射的能力。作者构建了包含6个Ising类型问题的StatMechBench-v0基准，并测试了“提出-验证-修改”Agent。实验表明，数值反馈虽有助于代码修复和数值求解，但Agent容易出现物理结构误判。论文强调了结合符号验证与结构不变量以提升AI物理推理可靠性的必要性。
AI.keywords: AI Agent, 统计力学 (Statistical Mechanics), 大语言模型 (LLMs), 基准测试 (Benchmark), 结构发现 (Structural Discovery)
AI.comments: 本论文的创新之处在于将理论物理中“物理模型等价转换与结构发现”这一高级物理推理能力形式化为AI Agent的评估任务，并构建了专门的StatMechBench-v0基准。其重要价值在于揭示了仅依赖数值检查验证LLM推理能力的缺陷（如Agent可能在错误理解底层结构的情况下通过数值验证），为未来物理学AI工具的设计指明了方向（需引入符号检查与结构不变量）。局限在于目前基准规模相对较小（6个Ising类问题），评估的Agent架构也较为基础。

title: Diagnosing Fine-Grained Inconsistency Classification in Financial Disclosure Text
summary: Financial disclosures contain numerical claims, temporal statements, entity references, policy commitments, and risk descriptions that may conflict in qualitatively different ways. Detecting a conflict is only the first step: review workflows may also need to determine its type, since numerical, temporal, referential, factual, and normative inconsistencies require different evidence and downstream checks. We study this problem as fine-grained inconsistency classification. Using a fixed 5,940-instance snapshot of SBID-FD, a synthetic financial-disclosure benchmark with 11 inconsistency labels and paired reference evidence spans, we compare frozen embedding classifiers, fine-tuned encoders, evidence-augmented classifiers, prompted large language models, and LoRA-adapted generative models under a shared evaluation protocol. A fine-tuned 300M encoder reaches 61.9% accuracy, compared with 61.5% for a LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-9B model and 61.3% for GPT-5.4. Because these systems differ in architecture, supervision, training objective, and input format, we interpret this as a practical efficiency result for compact supervised encoders rather than a controlled conclusion about model scale. Supplying gold evidence spans improves the fine-tuned encoder to 65.3%, whereas automatically predicted spans recover a meaningful but incomplete share of that gain, indicating that localization quality remains a bottleneck. Class-level analyses show that Referential inconsistencies are especially sensitive to localization quality, while Factual and Logical inconsistencies remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is provided. Together, the oracle, distractor, and per-class analyses separate localization errors from residual type-discrimination errors, indicating that progress requires both stronger evidence extraction and better reasoning over closely related inconsistency categories.

title: ClockRoPE: Random Fourier Rotations for Temporal Routine Modeling
summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) has been widely adopted in transformer-based large language models. However, its log-linear frequency schedule, originally designed to produce long-term attention decay, limits its adoption in domains with more complex distance-correlation patterns, such as temporal periodicity in sequential recommendation. We investigate the expressiveness of general query/key rotations and find that any normalized continuous positive-definite attention modulation function can be approximated by random rotations induced by its own Fourier transform, which we term Random Fourier Rotations. Building on this theory, we propose ClockRoPE for routine modeling in sequential recommendation, where rotation frequencies are derived from periodic attention modulation functions. In online A/B tests, ClockRoPE demonstrates consistent improvements in valued engagement metrics, and has been successfully deployed in production-scale generative retrieval system at a major video-sharing platform.

title: Self-Adaptive Learning and Model Predictive Control for Tracking Unknown Dynamics with No Regret
summary: We propose a self-adaptive online learning for control method for tracking unknown target dynamics. The target dynamics can exhibit switching behavior, particularly, a mixture of structured, random, and/or adversarial motion. Such challenging target tracking scenarios arise in applications of dynamic mapping, traffic control, and pursuit evasion, where robots need to track, pursue, or avoid collision with moving landmarks, objects, humans, etc., whose dynamics are unknown. Our method simultaneously learns multiple predictors from scratch, via self-supervised, one-shot, and computationally efficient learning, and adaptively selects the best one to match the observed target behavior. The method enjoys finite-time near-optimality guarantees in expectation, characterized as a function of the learning error of the target dynamics and the frequency that the target dynamics switch. In the absence of both error and switching, the method asymptotically matches the optimal non-causal control policy that knows a priori the target dynamics, i.e., the method enjoys no regret in expectation. In the presence of learning errors and switching, the method degrades gracefully, \eg when there are errors and no switching, the average regret is proportional to the average learning error and switching times. To prove these guarantees, a novel technical approach is required compared to the existing works that employ RFF-based online learning. We validate our method in Crazyflie simulations and hardware experiments, across target trajectories that vary from structured to random to adversarial, in comparison to non-stochastic, kernel-based, and neural-network-based methods for online learning.

title: A Controlled Candidate-Set Benchmark for Offline Satellite-Security Plan Decomposition
summary: Some security-development settings require local models that map an objective to an ordered, checkable plan. We present a low-rank decomposition adapter and release a case-disjoint corpus with 24 authored decompositions and 83 derived next-step examples across 24 satellite-security cases. To prevent reference-plan leakage, prompts contain one objective and eight shuffled SPARTA candidates. The evaluation candidate sets are constructed with oracle inclusion of every reference technique, so this study measures selection from a controlled set, not retrieval. On six fixed cases and five decoding seeds, mean scores vary across adapters and prompted Qwen2.5 baselines; a separate greedy check over three adapter training seeds shows non-negligible training variance. A 24-fold greedy leave-one-case-out control at the two compact sizes likewise shows tradeoffs: at 1.5B, adapter precision is 0.583 against 0.480 for two-shot prompting, while recall is 0.586 against 0.660. Case-resampling intervals for adapter precision relative to the strongest prompted baseline cross zero at 1.5B and 7B. The adapter is also substantially more format-compliant, which prevents attributing all score differences to selection. Autoregressive next-step accuracy is 0.08, 0.06, and 0.29 at 0.5B, 1.5B, and 7B. We therefore offer the formulation, leakage-controlled dataset, reproducibility package, and descriptive analysis as a proof of concept, not evidence of a reliable stand-alone decomposition system or a general adapter advantage. A separate diagnostic tests contract reuse.

title: (Im)Paired Programming: Coding Agents Improve Productivity but Harm Understanding
summary: Coding agents (e.g., Cursor) improve developer productivity by optimizing task completion, but shifting users from writing code to prompting and reviewing may harm their understanding, impeding oversight, learning, and communication. To probe this, we have 54 students create a website with one of two AI systems: an agent that edits user code; or a chatbot where users write code alone or adapt generic code snippets. We test understanding via comprehension questions and a task where users extend their code without agents, showing: (1) While agents aid initial task completion, they harm users' code comprehension and thus do not prepare users to extend their code; (2) Low-effort agent interaction types, like copy+paste prompts and auto-accepted edits, are linked with lower comprehension; and (3) Despite self-reported weaker understanding, users still prefer coding agents because they are quick and easy to use. While users stay in the loop for coding workflows, understanding should not be forgotten. Towards this goal, we distill our analyses into future research directions for coding agent developers: dissuading low-effort prompting, creating readable code, and promoting active engagement.

title: Polynomially Improved Lower Bounds for Trifferent Codes via Locally Sparse $3$-Uniform Hypergraphs
summary: A ternary code is \emph{trifferent} if every three distinct codewords have a coordinate in which their symbols are pairwise distinct. Let $T(n)$ be the maximum size of a trifferent code of length $n$. The classical Körner--Marton construction gives $T(n)\ge c_0(9/5)^{n/4}$ for an absolute constant $c_0>0$. We prove the polynomial strengthening $T(n)\ge c\sqrt{n}(9/5)^{n/4}$ for an absolute constant $c>0$. Our proof refines the outer-code step in the Körner--Marton concatenation. We encode non separating triples as edges of a $3$-uniform hypergraph, randomly thin its vertex set, and remove high-degree vertices together with all remaining Berge cycles of lengths two and three. The resulting locally sparse hypergraph admits a large independent set by a theorem of Verstraete and Wilson, producing the additional factor $\sqrt n$. Concatenation with the length-four Tetra code then yields the stated lower bound.

title: QUIC-TRIP: A Triple-Redundant Journey Toward Secure Substation Communications
summary: Modern power systems rely on real-time substation communication protocols, such as the Routable Generic Object-Oriented Substation Event (R-GOOSE), for critical control and protection functions. However, these protocols often lack built-in security features and prioritize availability over confidentiality and integrity, making them susceptible to false data injection and denial-of-service attacks. This vulnerability is exacerbated when communications are transmitted over wide-area or public networks. Addressing these cyber threats is essential to comply with current security mandates, including the DOE's defense-in-depth and zero-trust guidelines. This paper introduces QUIC-TRIP, a transparent security methodology for low-latency IP-based industrial communications. By operating at the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) Transport Layer (Layer 4), the solution encapsulates and protects data flows without affecting the operation of existing protocol endpoints. Baseline echo Round-Trip Time (RTT) results over a Frankfurt-Amsterdam communication path show that the underlying transport-layer proxy used by QUIC-TRIP achieves a lower average RTT than OpenVPN and only 2.88% higher average RTT than integrated DTLS 1.2, even with DTLS session reuse. We evaluate the resilience of QUIC-TRIP multipath communication under DoS flooding by securing R-GOOSE communications. In these tests, traffic is transparently delivered through three different paths, and QUIC-TRIP forwards the earliest-arriving duplicate while discarding later copies. The framework provides a triple-redundant defense scheme with a measured communication overhead of 32.18% per enabled proxied path, offering a bounded trade-off between resilience and bandwidth cost for time-critical grid operations.

title: Continuous Online Evaluation of Recommendation Strategies in Social Science Academic Search
comments: 21 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for publication at the 30th International Conference on Theory and Practice of Digital Libraries (TPDL 2026)
summary: Delivering relevant recommendations in academic search engines is a complex task due to the diversity of subject areas, information types, and user preferences. In this case study, we address these challenges by integrating and evaluating a range of recommendation systems within GESIS Search - a domain-specific search engine for the social sciences that provides researchers with access to research data, publications, variables, and measurement instruments. To support continuous, real-time evaluation of multiple recommendation strategies with actual platform users, we utilize the STELLA evaluation framework. We implement and compare a diverse set of algorithms, including traditional lexical similarity, semantic document similarity by using transformer-based embeddings, and session-based recommendations based on click paths from historical user sessions. Our results show that users prefer recommendations based on semantic similarity, which outperformed term-similarity and session-based methods. However, the performance of recommenders varies across categories within GESIS Search, suggesting that information-seeking behavior differs by information type. Overall, our study provides insights into how continuous evaluation can be incorporated to develop recommendations that better align with the preferences in academic search portals.
comment: 21 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for publication at the 30th International Conference on Theory and Practice of Digital Libraries (TPDL 2026)

AI.title_translation: 社会科学学术搜索中推荐策略的持续在线评估
AI.tldr: 本研究利用STELLA框架在GESIS Search学术搜索引擎中对多种推荐算法进行了真实的持续在线评估，发现基于语义相似度的推荐最受用户青睐。
AI.motivation: 学术搜索引擎面临学科领域、信息类型及用户偏好高度多样化的挑战，需要在真实学术搜索平台中集成并评估多种推荐策略，以改善推荐的相关性。
AI.method: 利用STELLA评估框架在GESIS Search平台上对实际用户进行持续、实时的在线评估。对比了三类推荐算法：传统的词法相似度方法、基于Transformer嵌入的文档语义相似度方法，以及基于历史用户会话点击路径的会话推荐方法。
AI.result: 用户更青睐基于语义相似度的推荐策略，其表现优于词法相似度和基于会话的方法；同时，推荐算法在不同信息类别中的表现存在差异，表明用户在不同信息类型下的寻检行为有所不同。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，结合持续在线评估机制能够有效推动推荐系统的迭代，从而开发出更好地契合学术搜索门户用户偏好的推荐策略。
AI.translation: 在学术搜索引擎中提供相关的推荐是一项复杂的任务，原因在于学科领域、信息类型和用户偏好的多样性。在本案例研究中，我们通过在GESIS Search（一个为社会科学领域研究人员提供研究数据、出版物、变量和测量工具访问权限的领域特定搜索引擎）中集成并评估一系列推荐系统来应对这些挑战。为了支持与真实平台用户一起对多种推荐策略进行持续、实时的评估，我们采用了STELLA评估框架。我们实现并比较了一组多样化的算法，包括传统的词法相似度、使用基于Transformer嵌入的语义文档相似度，以及基于历史用户会话点击路径的基于会话的推荐。我们的结果表明，用户更喜欢基于语义相似度的推荐，其表现优于词法相似度和基于会话的方法。然而，推荐器的性能在GESIS Search的不同类别中有所差异，这表明信息寻检行为因信息类型而异。总体而言，我们的研究为如何结合持续评估以开发更好地契合学术搜索门户偏好的推荐提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本研究针对社会科学学术搜索引擎GESIS Search中的推荐难题，采用STELLA评估框架开展了真实的持续在线评估。通过对比传统词法相似度、基于Transformer的语义相似度及基于会话的推荐算法，发现语义相似度推荐最受用户欢迎，且不同信息类别的推荐差异揭示了多元化的用户信息寻检行为。
AI.keywords: 学术搜索, 推荐系统, 持续在线评估, 语义相似度, 社会科学
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将持续在线评估框架（STELLA）应用于真实的社会科学学术搜索场景（GESIS Search），对词法、语义及基于会话的多种推荐策略进行了真实用户环境下的对比。研究揭示了语义相似度推荐的优越性以及不同信息类型对推荐效果的影响，对学术搜索推荐系统的实际落地与持续优化具有重要的实践价值。

title: Zero-Fi: Zero-Shot Wi-Fi-Based Human Activity Recognition via Contrastive Signal-Language Alignment
summary: Wi-Fi-based human activity recognition has advanced substantially, but most existing methods assume a closed set of activities and require labeled Wi-Fi samples for every target class, limiting their ability to recognize unseen activities. We present Zero-Fi, a contrastive signal-language alignment framework for zero-shot Wi-Fi-based human activity recognition. Zero-Fi learns unified representations from complementary Wi-Fi signal features and aligns them with the semantic representations of natural-language activity descriptions in a shared embedding space. This cross-modal alignment enables Zero-Fi to recognize new activity classes without requiring labeled Wi-Fi samples or model adaptation for those classes. Experiments on large-scale public benchmark datasets demonstrate effective zero-shot recognition of held-out activity classes, highlighting the potential of signal-language alignment to extend Wi-Fi sensing beyond predefined activity classes.

AI.title_translation: Zero-Fi：基于对比信号-语言对齐的零样本Wi-Fi人体活动识别
AI.tldr: Zero-Fi通过对比学习将Wi-Fi信号特征与自然语言活动描述的语义表示进行跨模态对齐，首次实现了无需目标类别标注数据的零样本Wi-Fi人体活动识别。
AI.motivation: 现有的Wi-Fi人体活动识别方法大多基于封闭集假设，要求为每个目标类别都提供标注的Wi-Fi数据，这严重限制了模型识别未见过的新活动的能力。
AI.method: 提出Zero-Fi框架，首先从互补的Wi-Fi信号特征中提取并学习统一表示，然后通过对比学习机制，在共享嵌入空间中将Wi-Fi信号表示与自然语言活动描述的语义表示进行跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在大规模公开基准数据集上的实验结果表明，Zero-Fi对未包含在训练集中的留出活动类别实现了有效的零样本识别。
AI.conclusion: 基于对比学习的信号-语言跨模态对齐能够有效突破传统Wi-Fi感知的预定义类别限制，为构建通用、开放集无线人体感知系统开辟了新途径。
AI.translation: 基于Wi-Fi的人体活动识别已取得了长足进展，但大多数现有方法假设活动类别是封闭集，并且需要为每个目标类别提供标注的Wi-Fi样本，从而限制了它们识别未见活动的能力。我们提出了Zero-Fi，一种用于零样本基于Wi-Fi的人体活动识别的对比信号-语言对齐框架。Zero-Fi从互补的Wi-Fi信号特征中学习统一表示，并在共享嵌入空间中将其与自然语言活动描述的语义表示进行对齐。这种跨模态对齐使Zero-Fi能够识别新的活动类别，而无需这些类别的标注Wi-Fi样本或模型适配。在大规模公开基准数据集上的实验表明，Zero-Fi对留出的活动类别实现了有效的零样本识别，突出了信号-语言对齐将Wi-Fi感知扩展到预定义活动类别之外的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Zero-Fi框架，旨在解决Wi-Fi人体活动识别中依赖封闭集和标注数据的问题。该框架通过构建共享嵌入空间，将互补的Wi-Fi信号特征与自然语言描述的语义表示进行对比对齐，从而实现了无需任何新增类别标注样本或模型适配的零样本活动识别。实验验证了其在未见类别识别上的有效性。
AI.keywords: Wi-Fi人体活动识别, 零样本学习, 跨模态对齐, 对比学习, 无线感知
AI.comments: 创新性：该论文将多模态对比学习（如CLIP思想）首次巧妙应用于Wi-Fi无线感知领域，将隐式信号特征与显式自然语言描述对齐。重要性：突破了传统Wi-Fi活动识别依赖封闭集训练和目标类标签的瓶颈，显著提升了无线感知系统的可扩展性和泛化能力。局限性：基于摘要无法确定复杂或细粒度活动描述的准确性对对齐效果的影响，以及环境噪声对跨模态嵌入映射的干扰。

title: When a positive SIMP density floor is not enough: solver admissibility and guarded floor selection in matrix-free 3D topology optimization
comments: 31 pages; 8 main figures and 4 supplementary figures. Code: https://github.com/nbbllxx0/solver-admissibility-and-guarded-floor-selection
summary: In a matrix-free geometric-multigrid FGMRES solver for three-dimensional SIMP topology optimization, a reported converged solve is not always a converged solve. On four of 102 held-out states, the projected residual used for stopping falls below $10^{-6}$ while a recomputed true residual is 1.35 to 49.5 times the tolerance; in an unguarded optimization trajectory, 22 of 40 state solves reach the iteration cap without raising an error. We formulate floor selection as a verified control problem: probe the frozen state at the original floor, use two residual features to choose the first attempted floor, and accept no solution until $||f-Ku||/||f||\le10^{-6}$ is recomputed. The two-feature rule matches 98 of 102 reference classifications; the residual guard detects the four missed escalations, and all 102 selected solves satisfy the tolerance. Relative to always using a $10^{-3}$ floor, the policy preserves the original operator on 24 admissible states and avoids mean compliance and gradient changes of 31.0% and 0.340 on those severe random states, and 0.48% and 0.008 on seven optimized designs, at 2.5 times the mean wall time. In a 12-state subset of the held-out states, eight still require escalation at the conventional floor $10^{-6}$. In a nine-state control with the preconditioner's adaptive components disabled, every failure is visible and no false acceptance occurs, tying the stopping-estimate drift to the iterate-dependent preconditioner. The recomputed residual is the correctness safeguard; the probe and floor ladder govern an implementation-specific cost-fidelity tradeoff.
comment: 31 pages; 8 main figures and 4 supplementary figures. Code: https://github.com/nbbllxx0/solver-admissibility-and-guarded-floor-selection

AI.title_translation: 当正SIMP密度下限还不够时：无矩阵三维拓扑优化中的求解器可容许性与受护下限选择
AI.tldr: 针对三维拓扑优化无矩阵求解器的“假收敛”问题，提出了基于真实残差验证与特征驱动的动态密度下限选择策略。
AI.motivation: 在用于三维SIMP拓扑优化的无矩阵几何多重网格FGMRES求解器中，由于迭代相关的预条件子导致收敛估计漂移，求解器汇报的收敛并不总是真正的收敛（存在假收敛现象），单纯设置正的SIMP密度下限不足以保证求解质量。
AI.method: 将密度下限选择表述为一个可验证的控制问题：首先在原始下限下探测冻结状态，利用两个残差特征选择首次尝试的密度下限，并且只有在重新计算的真实相对残差 $||f-Ku||/||f||\le10^{-6}$ 时才接受解。
AI.result: 双特征规则在102个测试状态中成功匹配了98个参考分类；残差防护检测到了4次漏报的升级情况，最终所有102个选定的求解均满足容差要求。在无假收敛的状态下保留了原始算子，有效避免了柔度和梯度的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 重算的真实残差是确保求解正确性的安全保障，而探测与下限梯级策略则用于控制算法在成本与精度之间的权衡。
AI.translation: 在用于三维SIMP拓扑优化的无矩阵几何多重网格FGMRES求解器中，汇报的收敛求解并不总是真正的收敛。在102个留存状态中的4个状态下，用于终止迭代的投影残差降至 $10^{-6}$ 以下，但重新计算的真实残差却是容差的1.35到49.5倍；在无保护的优化轨迹中，40个状态求解中有22个达到迭代上限却没有引发错误。我们将下限选择表述为一个可验证的控制问题：在原始下限下探测冻结状态，利用两个残差特征选择首次尝试的下限，并且只有在重新计算的真实残差 $||f-Ku||/||f||\le10^{-6}$ 时才接受解。双特征规则匹配了102个参考分类中的98个；残差防护检测到了4次遗漏的下限升级，所有102个选定的求解均满足容差要求。相对于始终使用 $10^{-3}$ 的下限，该策略在24个可容许状态上保留了原始算子，并在极端随机状态上避免了31.0%的平均柔度变化和0.340的梯度变化，在七个优化设计上避免了0.48%和0.008的变化，平均挂钟时间增长为2.5倍。在留存状态的12状态子集中，即使在传统下限 $10^{-6}$ 下仍有8个需要升级。在禁用预条件子自适应组件的9状态对照实验中，每个失败都是可见的且没有发生假接受，这证实了终止估计漂移与迭代相关的预条件子有关。重新计算的残差是正确性的安全保障；探测与下限梯级控制着特定实现的成本与保真度权衡。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了无矩阵三维SIMP拓扑优化求解器中的假收敛问题，指出这是由迭代相关的预条件子导致终止残差估计漂移引起的。作者提出了一种基于控制策略的受护下限选择与真实残差重新计算验证机制，确保了求解器的正确性并在计算成本与精度之间取得了平衡。
AI.keywords: 拓扑优化, 无矩阵法, SIMP方法, FGMRES求解器, 几何多重网格
AI.comments: 本文针对无矩阵三维拓扑优化中由于自适应预条件子导致的求解器“假收敛”问题提出了非常切实有效的监控与下限选择机制，具有极强的工程应用价值和算法严密性。

title: Time-delay Control Using a New Nonlinear Adaptive Law for Cable-Driven Robots
summary: Cable-driven manipulators exhibit strong nonlinearities and low structural stiffness, which make precise control challenging under time-varying uncertainties and external disturbances. This paper presents a time-delay-estimation (TDE)-based adaptive fractional-order nonsingular terminal sliding mode (AFONTSM) control strategy for cable-driven robots. A robust controller is constructed within a TDE-based model-free framework by combining fractional-order nonsingular terminal sliding mode error dynamics with a fast terminal sliding mode reaching law. The main contribution is a new adaptive law that introduces an adaptive exponential term into the update gain to form a nonlinear adaptive mechanism. This design improves adaptive regulation under different operating conditions by suppressing noise-induced chattering during smooth tracking while preserving or enhancing the adaptive gain during trajectory reversal. Lyapunov analysis proves the ultimate uniform boundedness of the tracking error. Experimental results show that, compared with the baseline method, the proposed controller reduces RMSE by 34.52% and 31.11%, ITAE by 33.79% and 32.97%, and ISCT by 6.69% and 17.77% for the two joints, respectively. Further comparisons with recently reported adaptive laws demonstrate that the proposed law provides faster adaptive response, more stable gain evolution, and improved chattering suppression. Additional payload tests further verify the robustness and repeatability of the proposed method.

AI.title_translation: 基于新型非线性自适应律的绳驱机器人时延控制
AI.tldr: 本文为绳驱机器人设计了一种基于时延估计和新型非线性自适应律的分数阶终端滑模控制方法，显著提升了轨迹跟踪精度并抑制了抖振。
AI.motivation: 绳驱机械臂具有强非线性和低结构刚度，在时变不确定性和外部干扰下难以实现高精度控制。
AI.method: 提出了基于时延估计（TDE）的自适应分数阶非奇异终端滑模（AFONTSM）控制策略，结合快速终端滑模到达律，并在更新增益中引入自适应指数项，构建新型非线性自适应律。
AI.result: 实验表明，与基线方法相比，所提控制器将两关节的RMSE分别降低34.52%和31.11%，ITAE降低33.79%和32.97%，ISCT降低6.69%和17.77%，且自适应响应更快、增益更稳定、抖振抑制更好。
AI.conclusion: 提出的控制策略成功解决了绳驱机器人在时变不确定性和干扰下的高精度控制难题，具有优异的跟踪性能、抖振抑制能力和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 绳驱机械臂表现出强非线性和低结构刚度，这使得在时变不确定性和外部干扰下实现精确控制面临挑战。本文提出了一种用于绳驱机器人的基于时延估计（TDE）的自适应分数阶非奇异终端滑模（AFONTSM）控制策略。通过将分数阶非奇异终端滑模误差动力学与快速终端滑模到达律相结合，在基于TDE的无模型框架内构建了鲁棒控制器。主要贡献在于一种新型自适应律，该律在更新增益中引入自适应指数项以形成非线性自适应机制。该设计通过在平滑跟踪期间抑制噪声引起的抖振，同时在轨迹换向期间保持或增强自适应增益，改善了不同运行条件下的自适应调节。Lyapunov分析证明了跟踪误差的最终一致有界性。实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，所提控制器使两个关节的RMSE分别降低了34.52%和31.11%，ITAE分别降低了33.79%和32.97%，ISCT分别降低了6.69%和17.77%。与近期报道的自适应律的进一步比较表明，所提自适应律具有更快的自适应响应、更稳定的增益演化和改进的抖振抑制效果。额外的负载测试进一步验证了所提方法的鲁棒性和可重复性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于绳驱机器人的TDE-AFONTSM控制策略，通过引入包含自适应指数项的新型非线性自适应律，兼顾了平滑跟踪时的噪声抖振抑制与轨迹换向时的自适应增益保持，理论与实验均验证了其优异的控制精度和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 绳驱机器人, 时延控制, 分数阶终端滑模, 非线性自适应律, 抖振抑制
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将分数阶非奇异终端滑模控制与新型非线性自适应律结合，利用指数项巧妙解决了平滑跟踪时噪声抖振与轨迹换向时增益不足的矛盾，对绳驱机器人高精度控制具有重要的应用价值。局限性在于摘要中未明确讨论绳索松弛或极端非线性工况下的系统表现。

title: An ER-Model-Based Framework for Case Notion Selection in Object-Centric Processes
comments: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, BPM Objects 2026 workshop
summary: Object-centric process mining operates on event logs where each event references multiple objects of different types. A fundamental challenge is defining a case notion - the grouping of events into coherent process execution instances -without which process discovery and conformance checking cannot proceed. Existing approaches either flatten the log to a single object type (losing inter-object coordination) or use the connected component of the object graph (creating overly complex cases due to resource-like objects). We propose an Entity-Relationship-schema-guided framework that identifies the primary entity (PE) type anchoring each process execution, classifies other entity types as secondary coordination entities or resources, and defines cases as connected components of the primary and secondary entity object relationship graph. The resulting case notion is shown to produce strict partitions with automatic transitive closure. The framework is illustrated with an order management process and validated on a 1,000-event OCEL log producing 40 structurally coherent cases.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, BPM Objects 2026 workshop

AI.title_translation: 一种基于实体-关系模型的以对象为中心的过程案例概念选择框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用ER模型指导以对象为中心过程挖掘中案例概念选择的框架，通过区分主/次实体与资源，生成结构一致且划分严格的过程案例。
AI.motivation: 在以对象为中心的过程挖掘中，定义案例概念（将事件分组为连贯的过程执行实例）是基础挑战。现有方法要么将日志平坦化为单一对象类型（导致丢失对象间协调关系），要么使用整个对象图的连通分量（因资源类对象导致案例过于复杂）。
AI.method:
提出了一种基于实体-关系（ER）模式指导的框架：
1. 识别锚定每次过程执行的主实体（Primary Entity, PE）类型；
2. 将其他实体类型分类为次要协调实体或资源；
3. 将案例定义为主实体与次要协调实体构成的对象关系图的连通分量。
AI.result: 该案例概念定义能够产生具有自动传递闭包的严格划分。通过订单管理流程进行了展示，并在包含1,000个事件的OCEL日志上进行了验证，成功生成了40个结构一致的案例。
AI.conclusion: 基于ER模式的框架成功克服了传统平坦化方法和全对象连通分量方法的缺陷，为以对象为中心的过程挖掘提供了一种严格、结构一致且具备自动传递闭包特性的案例定义新途径。
AI.translation: 以对象为中心的过程挖掘作用于事件日志，其中每个事件引用多种不同类型的对象。一个根本性挑战是定义案例概念（case notion）——即把事件分组为连贯的过程执行实例——缺少这一概念，过程发现和合规性检查就无法开展。现有方法要么将日志平坦化为单一对象类型（丢失了对象间的协调关系），要么使用对象图的连通分量（由于资源类对象的存在而产生过于复杂的案例）。我们提出了一种由实体-关系（ER）模式指导的框架，该框架识别锚定每次过程执行的主实体（PE）类型，将其他实体类型分类为次要协调实体或资源，并将案例定义为主实体和次要协调实体的对象关系图的连通分量。结果表明，由此产生的案例概念能够产生具有自动传递闭包的严格划分。该框架通过一个订单管理过程进行了说明，并在包含1,000个事件的OCEL日志上进行了验证，生成了40个结构一致的案例。
AI.summary: 本文针对以对象为中心的过程挖掘中案例概念定义难的问题，提出了一种基于实体-关系（ER）模型的新型框架。该框架通过主实体和次要协调实体的划分来构建对象关系图并提取连通分量，在保留对象间协调性的同时避免了因资源型对象导致的案例图过度复杂化，实现了高质量的案例划分。
AI.keywords: Object-Centric Process Mining, Case Notion, Entity-Relationship Model, OCEL, Process Mining
AI.comments:
创新性：引入传统数据库中的实体-关系（ER）模式来指导以对象为中心的过程挖掘（OCPM），巧妙解决了因资源型对象引入而导致的案例图过度复杂化问题。
重要性：案例概念（Case Notion）的界定是以对象为中心的过程挖掘中进行过程发现和合规性检查的关键前提，该框架填补了这一重要空白。
局限性：验证部分仅基于一个包含1,000个事件的OCEL日志，未来需要在更大规模、更复杂的真实工业场景下评估其通用性与计算性能。

title: Collusion with Competitive Marginals: Price-Level Audits Are Blind by Construction
summary:
Empirical work on algorithmic collusion asks one question of the data: are prices supracompetitive? We show this can be answered "no" by a conspiracy that is nonetheless profitable. Consider bidding agents that couple only through the joint distribution of their unexplained bid components, leaving every agent's own bid law exactly at the competitive law. Any test whose input is a single agent's price or bid history then has power exactly equal to its false-positive rate, for every coupling strength up to comonotonicity. The published detection methodology is therefore blind to this conduct by construction rather than underpowered, and no sample size repairs it.
  Three empirical results follow. First, the mechanism appears in real language-model agents: twenty models from nineteen independent developers, three deployment prompts each, show residual correlation of $+0.053$ between two deployments of one model against $+0.0001$ across models, with a 95% interval clustered by developer of $[0.030, 0.078]$, under an auditor that sees every order feature and is fitted out of sample. Second, the coupling falls monotonically as sampling temperature rises ($p=0.002$), turning a deployment parameter into a candidate mitigation. Third, on 24 days of Ethereum block-building auction data covering 77,684 bids from 39 bidders, the honest population of bidder pairs is itself so dependent that a screen held at a 5% false-positive rate must sit above a floor of $+0.50$ to $+0.81$, which is 20 to 32 times the family-wise sampling threshold and does not fall as the audit window grows. Since lawful multi-identity operation and conspiracy are behaviourally indistinguishable here, the tractable regulatory target is not detection but counting: resolving 40 bidding identities into 23 operators raises the Herfindahl index by 247.5%, and adding behavioural clusters from public bid streams reaches 324.5%.

AI.title_translation: 具有竞争性边际的暗中勾结：价格水平审计在结构上存在盲区
AI.tldr: 研究证明算法勾结可通过仅耦合未解释的出价残差来隐蔽获利，使传统价格审计结构性失效；LLM代理与以太坊拍卖实证表明，监管应从“检测勾结”转向“识别运营者实体”。
AI.motivation: 现有的算法勾结实证检测主要依赖于评估价格是否超过竞争水平。本文旨在探索是否存在一种既能获利、又完全保持单代理竞争性出价分布的暗中勾结机制，揭示现有审计方法的结构性盲区，并验证该现象在AI代理及区块链拍卖市场中的普遍性与监管启示。
AI.method:
1. 理论建模：构建仅通过未解释出价成分的联合分布进行耦合的出价代理模型，推导单代理价格历史检测方法的统计功效与假阳性率关系。
2. LLM代理实验：评估来自19家开发商的20个大语言模型在不同部署提示与采样温度下的残差相关性。
3. 真实数据实证：分析以太坊区块构建拍卖（24天、39个出价者、77,684次出价）中的出价相关性，并评估将多身份归并为单一运营者对赫芬达尔指数（HHI）的影响。
AI.result:
1. 理论结果：只要代理的单体出价分布符合竞争规律，任何仅依赖单代理价格/出价历史的检验方法的统计功效都严格等于其假阳性率，增加样本量也无法修复。
2. LLM代理实证：同一模型的不同部署间存在+0.053的显著残差相关性（跨模型仅为+0.0001）；提高采样温度可单调降低该耦合度（p=0.002）。
3. 以太坊数据实证：诚实出价者对之间本身具有极强依赖性（5%假阳性率对应的筛选门槛需高达+0.50至+0.81）；将40个出价身份识别归并为23个实际运营者后，市场赫芬达尔指数（HHI）提升了247.5%，引入行为聚类后提升达324.5%。
AI.conclusion: 传统的价格水平检测方法在结构上无法识别具有竞争性边际分布的隐蔽算法勾结。由于合法的多身份操作与暗中勾结在此类场景下难以在行为上区分，监管和治理的有效方向应从单纯的“勾结检测”转向出价实体的“识别与计数”。
AI.translation:
关于算法勾结的实证研究在数据中只关注一个问题：价格是否高于竞争水平？我们证明，通过一种仍能盈利的勾结机制，这一问题的答案可以是“否”。考虑仅通过其未解释出价成分的联合分布进行耦合的出价代理，这使得每个代理自身的出价规律恰好保持在竞争规律上。于是，任何以单个代理的价格或出价历史作为输入的检测方法，其检验功效在达到共单调性的所有耦合强度下都严格等于其假阳性率。因此，已发表的检测方法在设计机制上对此类行为具有盲点，而非仅仅是统计功效不足，并且没有任何样本量能够修复这一盲点。
随后得出了三个实证结果。首先，该机制出现在真实的语言模型代理中：来自19家独立开发者的20个模型在每种模型进行3次部署提示的测试下，在审计者能看到所有订单特征且跨样本拟合的情况下，同一个模型的两次部署之间的残差相关性为+0.053，而跨模型之间仅为+0.0001（由开发者聚类的95%置信区间为[0.030, 0.078]）。其次，随着采样温度的升高，耦合度单调下降（p=0.002），使得部署参数成为一种潜在的缓解手段。第三，在涵盖39个出价者的77,684次出价的24天以太坊区块构建拍卖数据中，诚实出价者对本身就高度依赖，以至于保持在5%假阳性率的筛选门槛必须设在+0.50到+0.81的底限之上，这是族系采样门槛的20到32倍，且不会随审计窗口的扩大而下降。由于在此情境下合法的多身份操作与暗中勾结在行为上不可区分，因此易于处理的监管目标不是“检测”，而是“计数”：将40个出价身份归纳为23个运营者使赫芬达尔指数提高了247.5%，再加上来自公共出价流的行为聚类，这一增幅达到了324.5%。
AI.summary: 本研究证明，算法勾结可以通过仅耦合代理间未解释的出价残差、同时保持单个代理的边际出价分布处于竞争水平来实现。这种机制使得所有基于单代理价格历史的审计方法在设计结构上完全失效。实证研究进一步在真实LLM代理和以太坊拍卖数据中证实了此类行为依赖的存在，表明监管重点应从无法施行的“勾结检测”转向出价实体的“算子识别与计数”。
AI.keywords: 算法勾结, 价格审计, 大语言模型代理, 区块链拍卖, 赫芬达尔指数
AI.comments: 本文创新性极强，从理论上打破了传统经济学中“勾结必然导致价格高于竞争水平”的固有认知，证明了“具有竞争性边际分布的勾结”会在结构上导致传统单代理价格审计彻底失效。研究兼具理论深度与实证广度，不仅在大语言模型（LLM）代理中验证了残差相关性，还利用以太坊拍卖数据揭示了现实市场中的行为不可区分性，为竞争政策和算法监管从“检测勾结”转向“实体识别与集中度度量”提供了重要依据。局限在于分析主要针对以单代理历史数据为输入的审计体系，对于多代理联合审计的边界探讨仍有延伸空间。

title: A Fresh Look at Best Inductive Loop Invariant Synthesis for Bit-Vector Relations
summary: Synthesizing best inductive invariants (BII) is fundamental to program analysis and verification, yet existing approaches face significant efficiency challenges. We introduce a new formulation for the problem through the lens of mathematical optimization over quantified constraints in first-order theories. The formulation offers a constructive and operational perspective on the BII problem and opens new algorithmic avenues. Building on this formulation, we present two new algorithms for bit-vector programs: a strategically guided linear search that exploits the lattice structure and a bitwise greedy approach that resolves bound bits from high to low with a solver-call count linear in bit-width. We evaluate our approach on a comprehensive benchmark suite, demonstrating significant performance improvements over conventional methods based on symbolic abstraction and chaotic iteration. Experimental results demonstrate our approach solves up to 86\% more benchmarks than baseline methods, with improved scaling in solver-call count for high bit-widths and improved verification effectiveness when integrated with k-induction.

AI.title_translation: 位向量关系的最佳归纳循环不变式合成的新视角
AI.tldr: 本文通过将最佳归纳不变式合成转化为数学优化问题，提出了策略引导搜索和按位贪心两种高效算法，大幅提升了位向量程序验证的效率。
AI.motivation: 合成最佳归纳不变式（BII）是程序分析和验证的基础，但现有基于符号抽象和混乱迭代的方法面临显著的效率和扩展性 challenges。
AI.method: 引入基于一阶理论中带量词约束的数学优化新形式化方法。在此基础上提出两种新算法：一是利用格结构的策略引导线性搜索算法；二是按位贪心算法，从高到低解析边界位，使求解器调用次数与位宽呈线性关系。
AI.result: 在基准测试集上相比传统基线方法多解决了高达86%的样例，在高位宽下具有更好的求解器调用扩展性，且与k-归纳结合时显著提升了验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过数学优化视角重新形式化不变式合成问题，并配合策略引导搜索与按位贪心算法，能极大提升位向量程序分析与验证的效率和扩展性。
AI.translation: 合成最佳归纳不变式（BII）对于程序分析与验证至关重要，然而现有的方法面临着显著的效率挑战。我们通过一阶理论中带量词约束的数学优化视角引入了该问题的新形式化表达。该形式化为BII问题提供了建设性和可操作的视角，并开辟了新的算法途径。在此形式化的基础上，我们针对位向量程序提出了两种新算法：一种是利用格结构的策略引导线性搜索算法，另一种是从高位到低位解析边界位且求解器调用次数与位宽呈线性关系的按位贪心方法。我们在全面的基准测试集上评估了我们的方法，证明了相比于基于符号抽象和混乱迭代的传统方法，性能得到了显著提升。实验结果表明，我们的方法比基线方法多解决了高达86%的基准测试，在大位宽下的求解器调用次数具有更好的扩展性，并且在与k-归纳结合时提高了验证有效性。
AI.summary: 本文重新审视了位向量关系的最佳归纳不变式（BII）合成问题，将其形式化为一阶理论下带量词约束的数学优化问题。基于此形式化，提出了策略引导线性搜索算法和求解器调用次数与位宽呈线性关系的按位贪心算法，显著超越了传统符号抽象与混乱迭代方法，极大地提升了验证效率与测试解决率。
AI.keywords: 最佳归纳不变式, 位向量程序, 程序验证, 约束优化, 不变式合成
AI.comments: 创新点在于将不变式合成重新构建为一阶理论下的数学优化问题，摆脱了传统依赖符号抽象和混乱迭代的局限；所提出的按位贪心算法将求解器调用次数降低至与位宽线性相关，极大地提高了位向量不变式合成的扩展性与效率。局限性在于该方法主要针对位向量关系，向更复杂的数据结构或非线性理论推广的可能性在摘要中未做详细说明。

title: "Nobody Did This": Contribution, Originality, and Accountability in Agent-Mediated Collaboration
summary: Collaborative knowledge work is changing in ways that go beyond disclosure or transparency. LLM agents are now embedded in how teams research, design, write, and decide: mediating between members, synthesizing inputs, reformulating ideas, and drafting shared outputs. They do not only facilitate collaboration; they operate within the workflow at the moment contributions are being formed. In doing so, they risk undermining the social conditions under which contributions can be witnessed, attributed, and held accountable. This workshop brings together researchers and practitioners to confront what we call contribution dissolution: the blurring of attribution, originality, and accountability in agent-mediated collaborative work. We argue that this dissolution begins before collaboration itself, in the individual worker's own uncertainty about what is genuinely theirs, and propagates through collaborative relationships, collapsing the reliability that makes productive intellectual exchange possible. Through position statements, mapping exercises, and a hands-on activity, participants will surface how framing accountability as a documentation problem (e.g., AI use statements, watermarking, provenance logs) overlooks the conditions under which accountability is produced. Our goal is to produce a shared research agenda and the foundations of an infrastructural response to contribution dissolution in collaborative knowledge work.

AI.title_translation: “无人为此负责”：智能体中介协作中的贡献、原创性与问责制
AI.tldr: 本工作坊探讨大语言模型智能体嵌入知识协作所引发的归因、原创性与问责制模糊（即“贡献消解”）现象，并旨在建立共享研究议程与基础设施层面响应措施。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体已深度嵌入团队的知识创作与决策流程中，在贡献形成的瞬间介入协作，导致贡献归因、原创性与问责制变得模糊（即“贡献消解”）。现有的文档化解决方案（如AI使用声明、水印、溯源日志）忽视了问责制产生的社会条件，亟需探索更深层的应对机制。
AI.method: 通过举办工作坊，汇集研究人员与从业者，采用立场声明、映射练习和动手实践活动等方法开展共同探讨。
AI.result: 揭示了仅将问责制视为文档记录问题的局限性，并将建立一份共同的研究议程，为应对协作知识工作中的“贡献消解”奠定基础设施层面的响应基础。
AI.conclusion: “贡献消解”始于个体对其原创性的困惑，并进一步蔓延至协作关系中，破坏了生产性智力交流的可靠性；仅将问责制视为文档记录问题是不够的，必须从社会条件和基础设施层面予以响应。
AI.translation: 协作性知识工作正在发生深刻变化，其影响已超出信息公开或透明度的范畴。大语言模型（LLM）智能体如今已深度嵌入到团队的研究、设计、写作和决策方式中：在成员之间起中介作用、综合输入、重构想法并起草共享产出。它们不仅促进协作，还在贡献形成的当下直接作用于工作流中。在此过程中，它们可能会破坏使贡献得以被见证、归因和追责的社会条件。本次工作坊汇集了研究人员和从业者，以共同面对我们称之为“贡献消解”（contribution dissolution）的现象——即智能体中介的协作工作中归因、原创性和问责制的模糊化。我们认为，这种消解在协作开始之前就已发生，始于个体工作者对自己真正创作内容的困惑，并进一步蔓延至协作关系中，从而摧毁了使高效智力交流成为可能的可靠性基础。通过立场声明、映射练习和动手实践活动，与会者将揭示将问责制简单归结为文档记录问题（例如AI使用声明、水印、溯源日志）是如何忽视了问责制产生的具体条件。我们的目标是建立一个共同的研究议程，并为针对协作知识工作中“贡献消解”问题的基础设施层面应对奠定基础。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了LLM智能体融入团队协作时带来的“贡献消解”问题。随着智能体在知识创作瞬间的介入，人际协作中的原创性、归因与问责制面临被破坏的风险。该工作坊旨在超越单纯的AI使用声明或溯源日志等文档化手段，深入探讨问责制生成的社会条件，并制定解决贡献消解问题的共享研究议程与基础设施方案。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 贡献消解, 问责制, 原创性, 协作知识工作
AI.comments: 该论文/工作坊提案敏锐地抓住了LLM智能体深度融入知识工作后带来的深层伦理与社会学挑战——即“贡献消解”。其创新点在于指出了当前将问责制简化为“水印、AI使用声明”等技术性文档手段的局限性，强调了问责与归因本质上是社会性生成的。局限性在于本文主要为工作坊提案，侧重于提出研究议程与框架讨论，尚未提供具体的实证研究数据或落地的技术解决方案。

title: Sensitivity and Differential Privacy in Metric Voting with Distortion below Three
summary: Voting rules aggregate individual preferences into collective decisions, but the rankings they receive contain only ordinal information. The metric distortion framework studies ordinal voting rules in settings where voters and candidates are embedded in an unknown metric space. Deterministic rules have optimal worst-case distortion $3$, while recent randomized rules break the $3$ barrier. We study whether such improvements can coexist with low worst-case sensitivity with respect to the Wasserstein distance of lotteries under one-voter deletion and approximate differential privacy under one-voter replacement. On the sensitivity side, we give a randomized rule with distortion at most $3-\varepsilon$ for an absolute constant $\varepsilon>0$ and, for $m$ candidates and $n$ voters, a worst-case sensitivity bound of $O((\log m+1)/n)$. On the privacy side, for every $δ\in(0,1)$ and all $n$ above an absolute constant, we construct a variant rule whose mechanism releasing a single sampled winner has distortion at most $3-\varepsilon$ and is $(O((\log m+\log(1/δ)+1)/n),δ)$-differentially private. Both constructions use the same family of Gibbs distributions over constant-size candidate lists, with only the temperature parameter differing between the sensitivity and differential-privacy guarantees. Our analysis builds on the biased-metric viewpoint behind the recent improvement over the $3$ barrier and proves a stability property for the biased-metric ratio.

AI.title_translation: 扭曲度低于三的度量投票中的敏感度与差分隐私
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个扭曲度低于3且同时具备低敏感度和近似差分隐私保证的随机度量投票机制。
AI.motivation: 探讨度量投票中打破确定性规则扭曲度为3的限制（实现 Distortion < 3）是否可以与单选民删除下的低 Wasserstein 敏感度以及单选民替换下的近似差分隐私（Differential Privacy）同时实现。
AI.method: 基于常数大小候选列表上的 Gibbs 分布族构造随机化规则（通过针对敏感度和差分隐私调整不同的温度参数），并基于偏置度量（biased-metric）视角证明偏置度量比率的稳定性。
AI.result: 成功构造了扭曲度至多为 $3-\varepsilon$（$\varepsilon>0$ 为绝对常数）的随机化投票规则，其在单选民删除下的最坏情况敏感度界为 $O((\log m+1)/n)$；同时构造了满足 $(O((\log m+\log(1/\delta)+1)/n),\delta)$-近似差分隐私的变体规则。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在度量投票中打破扭曲度为 3 的屏障与保持低敏感度以及近似差分隐私是完全可以兼容的。
AI.translation: 投票规则将个人偏好聚合为集体决策，但它们接收到的排名仅包含序数信息。度量扭曲框架研究了选民和候选人嵌入在未知度量空间中的序数投票规则。确定性规则的最高最坏情况扭曲度为 3，而最近的随机化规则打破了 3 的屏障。我们研究了这种改进是否能与关于单选民删除下抽签 Wasserstein 距离的低最坏情况敏感度，以及单选民替换下的近似差分隐私共存。在敏感度方面，我们提供了一个随机化规则，其扭曲度至多为 $3-\varepsilon$（$\varepsilon>0$ 为绝对常数），对于 $m$ 个候选人和 $n$ 个选民，最坏情况敏感度界为 $O((\log m+1)/n)$。在隐私方面，对于每个 $\delta\in(0,1)$ 和所有大于绝对常数的 $n$，我们构造了一个变体规则，其发布单个抽样赢家的机制扭曲度至多为 $3-\varepsilon$，且是 $(O((\log m+\log(1/\delta)+1)/n),\delta)$-差分私密的。这两种构造都使用相同的基于常数大小候选列表的 Gibbs 分布族，敏感度保障和差分隐私保障之间仅温度参数有所不同。我们的分析建立在超越 3 屏障的偏置度量视角之上，并证明了偏置度量比率的稳定性性质。
AI.summary: 本文研究了度量投票中低扭曲度与隐私及稳定性保障的兼容性问题。作者利用常数大小候选列表上的 Gibbs 分布族，首次提出了扭曲度低于 3 且同时具备 $O((\log m+1)/n)$ 级低敏感度和近似差分隐私保障的随机化投票机制。
AI.keywords: Metric Voting, Metric Distortion, Differential Privacy, Sensitivity, Gibbs Distribution
AI.comments: 该论文将计算社交选择中的度量扭曲度（Metric Distortion）理论与差分隐私及算法稳定性（敏感度）相结合，提出了首个既能打破扭曲度为3的界限又具备严格差分隐私和低敏感度保证的随机化投票机制。其创新之处在于利用 Gibbs 分布族统一了稳定性与隐私性的构造，并通过证明偏置度量比率的稳定性建立了理论支撑，具有很高的理论价值。

title: Misalignment Has a Personality: A Big Five Account of Emergent Misalignment
comments: The paper is currently under peer review
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on data containing a narrow flaw, such as insecure code or incorrect mathematical answers, can cause broad misalignment through a mechanism that remains debated. We provide an interpretable account: in the models and corpora we study, misalignment behaves like a shift in personality. Prior work extracts activation directions for character traits from a single binary contrast, which can separate or steer behavior without establishing a calibrated scale. We instead extract personality vectors for the Big Five using a graded, three-level intervention and validate them on two open-weight models. The three levels are linearly ordered, with Cohen's d values of up to 6.2; the vectors transfer zero-shot and trait-specifically to an independent corpus; and their effects are strongest within a middle-layer band. Applied to training data, the vectors reveal that misaligned corpora across eight domains share a common Big Five signature: lower agreeableness and conscientiousness, together with higher extraversion and neuroticism. This signature is recovered by both models with a correlation of r = 0.94. Fine-tuning imprints the same profile, shifting the model's generations along the corresponding signature, with r = 0.83 using activation-based measurements and r = 0.90 using a text-based judge, while also shifting internal activations with r = 0.69. The same vectors characterize sycophancy as high extraversion and low conscientiousness rather than excess agreeableness, a distinction that a single direction cannot capture. Calibrated personality vectors transform an opaque safety phenomenon into a human-legible diagnostic profile.
comment: The paper is currently under peer review

AI.title_translation: 失调具有人格：对新兴失调的大五人格解释
AI.tldr: 本研究发现语言模型中的失调行为类似于人格转变，并通过校准的大五人格向量将其转化为人类可理解的诊断档案。
AI.motivation: 微调语言模型时，数据中的狭窄缺陷（如不安全代码或错误数学答案）可能导致广泛的失调，其机制仍存在争议。
AI.method: 研究通过分级的三级干预提取了大五人格向量，并在两个开源模型上进行了验证。这些向量在线性有序，零样本且特质特定地转移到独立语料库中，并在中间层带内效果最强。将这些向量应用于训练数据，揭示了八个领域中失调语料库的共同大五人格特征。
AI.result: 校准的人格向量显示，失调语料库具有共同的大五人格特征：较低的宜人性和责任心，以及较高的外向性和神经质。这种特征在两个模型中以 r = 0.94 的相关性被恢复。微调会印刻相同的特征，使模型的生成沿相应特征移动，使用基于激活的测量时 r = 0.83，使用基于文本的判断时 r = 0.90，同时内部激活也发生 r = 0.69 的偏移。这些向量将谄媚描述为高外向性和低责任心，而非过度的宜人性。
AI.conclusion: 校准的人格向量将不透明的安全现象转化为人类可理解的诊断档案。
AI.translation: 在包含狭窄缺陷（如不安全代码或错误数学答案）的数据上微调语言模型，可能通过一个仍在争论的机制导致广泛的失调。我们提供了一个可解释的解释：在我们研究的模型和语料库中，失调表现得像人格转变。先前的工作从单一二元对比中提取性格特质的激活方向，这可以在不建立校准尺度的情况下分离或引导行为。我们Instead，使用分级的三级干预提取了大五人格向量，并在两个开源模型上进行了验证。这三个级别呈线性有序，科恩d值高达6.2；这些向量零样本且特质特定地转移到独立语料库中；其效果在中间层带内最强。应用于训练数据时，这些向量揭示了八个领域中失调语料库共享一个共同的大五人格特征：较低的宜人性和责任心，以及较高的外向性和神经质。这种特征在两个模型中以 r = 0.94 的相关性被恢复。微调会印刻相同的特征，使模型的生成沿相应特征移动，使用基于激活的测量时 r = 0.83，使用基于文本的判断时 r = 0.90，同时内部激活也发生 r = 0.69 的偏移。同样的向量将谄媚描述为高外向性和低责任心，而非过度的宜人性，这是单一方向无法捕捉的区别。校准的人格向量将不透明的安全现象转化为人类可理解的诊断档案。
AI.summary: 本研究提出语言模型中的失调行为可以被理解为人格转变。通过使用分级三级干预提取和验证大五人格向量，研究发现失调的语料库共享一种共同的人格特征，即较低的宜人性和责任心，以及较高的外向性和神经质。微调过程会将这种人格特征印刻到模型中，影响其生成内容和内部激活。这种方法将原本不透明的模型安全问题转化为人类可理解的诊断档案，并能更细致地区分不同类型的失调，例如将谄媚与过度的宜人性区分开来。
AI.keywords: 语言模型失调, 大五人格, 人格向量, 微调, 模型安全
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“大五人格”理论来解释语言模型中的失调现象，提供了一种新颖且具有解释性的视角。这种将心理学概念应用于AI模型行为分析的方法是其主要创新点。通过将抽象的失调问题转化为人类可理解的人格特征，它为理解和诊断模型安全问题提供了一个有力的工具，有望在模型对齐和行为修正方面发挥重要作用。

title: Impossible to hide secret ...: Uncovering Security and Privacy Issues in LLM-native IDEs
summary: LLM-native IDEs (Integrated Development Environments), aka LIDEs, are designed from the ground up to work with Large Language Models (LLMs). LIDEs have found remarkable success in Software Engineering (SE) tasks such as coding, debugging, and program comprehension. LIDEs are software systems, and, like any system, they can exhibit vulnerabilities. In this paper, we study the security and privacy issues that developers reported while using popular LIDEs in their development tasks. We collected 1.1M posts from 29 popular subreddits related to LIDEs. We identified 446 posts and analyzed over 6K comments to the posts that discussed security and privacy issues in almost all popular LIDEs, such as Cursor, Copilot, Codex, etc. Using a mix of qualitative and quantitative methods, we constructed a taxonomy of the reported security and privacy issues. Our results show that most issues in LIDEs stem from system-level design choices, rather than the underlying LLMs, such as user data access, unchecked autonomous actions, etc. To overcome these issues, developers frequently relied on external safeguards like code sandboxing and manual reviewing, highlighting prevalent mistrust among developers about LIDEs. We share lessons from our study to support future design of secure and privacy-aware LIDEs.

AI.title_translation: 无法隐藏的秘密……：揭示原生大语言模型集成开发环境（LLM-native IDE）中的安全与隐私问题
AI.tldr: 本文通过挖掘Reddit社区数据，首次系统分析了原生LLM集成开发环境（LIDE）的安全与隐私漏洞，发现绝大多数问题源于系统架构设计而非大模型本身，导致开发者对其普遍缺乏信任。
AI.motivation: 虽然原生LLM集成开发环境（LIDE）在提升软件工程效率方面成效显著，但作为复杂的软件系统，其潜在的安全与隐私漏洞尚未得到系统性研究。本研究旨在揭示开发者在实际使用LIDE时面临的安全与隐私隐患。
AI.method: 从29个LIDE相关Reddit社区中采集110万条帖子，筛选出446条相关讨论帖及6000多条评论；结合定性与定量方法分析开发者报告的问题，并构建了LIDE安全与隐私问题的分类体系。
AI.result: 研究发现LIDE的安全与隐私问题大多源于系统层面的设计选择（如数据访问控制不当、未经检查的自主行为），而非底层LLM本身。此外，开发者因缺乏信任，广泛依赖代码沙箱和手动审查等外部手段来进行自我保护。
AI.conclusion: LIDE的安全与隐私风险主要归咎于系统工程与架构设计层面的缺陷。未来构建LIDE时必须将安全与隐私感知作为核心设计原则，以重建开发者的信任。
AI.translation: 原生大语言模型集成开发环境（LIDE）旨在从底层开始与大语言模型（LLM）协同工作。LIDE在编码、调试和程序理解等软件工程（SE）任务中取得了瞩目的成功。然而，LIDE作为软件系统，与其他系统一样可能会表现出漏洞。在本文中，我们研究了开发者在开发任务中使用热门LIDE时报告的安全和隐私问题。我们从29个与LIDE相关的热门Subreddit中收集了110万条帖子，识别出446条帖子并分析了针对这些帖子的6,000多条评论，这些内容讨论了包括Cursor、Copilot、Codex等几乎所有热门LIDE中的安全与隐私问题。通过结合定性与定量方法，我们构建了所报告的安全与隐私问题的分类体系。研究结果表明，LIDE中的大多数问题源于系统层面的设计选择（例如用户数据访问、未经检查的自主行为等），而非底层的LLM。为了解决这些问题，开发者频繁依赖代码沙箱和手动审查等外部防护措施，这突显了开发者对LIDE普遍存在的不信任。我们分享了本研究的经验教训，以支持未来安全且具备隐私意识的LIDE的设计。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM原生集成开发环境（LIDE）的安全与隐私问题展开实证研究。通过挖掘与分析Reddit社区上的大量开发者讨论，研究团队对Cursor、Copilot等热门LIDE的安全隐患进行了分类，发现系统架构设计缺陷是安全风险的主因，并揭示了开发者对当前LIDE安全性的普遍不信任。
AI.keywords: LLM-native IDE, 安全与隐私, 开发者信任, 软件工程, 社区挖掘
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于首次从真实开发者社区（Reddit）的实证数据出发，全面梳理了新兴LLM原生IDE（如Cursor、Copilot等）面临的安全与隐私挑战。研究提出了一个重要的洞察：大多数安全风险源自系统层面的架构与交互设计，而非LLM模型本身。局限性在于数据主要依赖论坛用户的自发讨论，可能存在选择性偏见，且缺乏对具体漏洞的自动化漏洞挖掘验证。

title: Q-Steer: Action-Value Guidance for Molecular Policy Optimization
comments: 20 pages, 2 figures, and 25 tables. Includes supplementary experimental results
summary: Oracle-limited molecular optimization gives reward only after a complete molecule is generated, while each rollout requires many local next-token decisions. This delayed-feedback interface makes molecular policy optimization myopic: an optimizer can learn that a molecule was good without knowing which intermediate actions made it good. We introduce Q-Steer, a rollout-time action-value steering primitive for molecular language models. Q-Steer uses an offline-trained and frozen prefix-action value scorer, PAVS-Q, that estimates the downstream reward of taking a candidate next token under a partial SMILES prefix, then adds a normalized value bonus to sampling logits. The optimizer update rule and online oracle budget are unchanged; the claim is fixed-online-oracle performance, not equal total compute. On PMO23 with a fixed 10,000-call online budget, complete factorial studies across two molecular language-model backbones and four optimizers show that Q-Steer improves mean valid-unique score in all eight backbone-optimizer cells, with positive macro mean-score gains between +0.033 and +0.049 and 18-20 task wins per cell. Mechanism controls show that action identity matters: prefix-broadcast values are nearly neutral, while shuffled action values harm performance. These results support Q-Steer as a reusable rollout-time action-value wrapper that improves average molecular optimization reward across optimizer families and policy backbones without changing the online oracle budget.
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, and 25 tables. Includes supplementary experimental results

title: CaM-Wolf: Causal-Aware Multimodal Agents for Social Deduction Games
summary: Social deduction games (SDGs) such as Werewolf have become challenging testbeds for AI agents. These games require complex social skills such as reasoning, deception, and collaboration. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have driven significant progress in SDG agents, current approaches are predominantly text-based, overlooking the multimodal nature that is fundamental to human social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce CaM-Wolf, the first SDG agent that integrates multimodal perception and generation. CaM-Wolf processes video inputs from other players, employs a causal-aware Reasoner trained via reinforcement learning to establish logical chains between observable behaviors and hidden roles, and presents itself through an animated avatar. Our experiments and user study show that CaM-Wolf achieves superior agent gameplay performance and enhances the quality of human-AI interaction. This work represents a significant advancement towards creating more human-like AI agents capable of participating in nuanced social dynamics. Our code is available at https://3dagentworld.github.io/avatar_wolf.

title: Registration-Grounded Spectral Fusion for Unregistered WLI/NBI Endoscopic Lesion Segmentation
summary: White-light imaging (WLI) and narrow-band imaging (NBI) provide complementary views of endoscopic lesions, but their paired observations are often spatially misaligned due to viewpoint changes, tissue deformation, and sequential handheld acquisition. This makes direct WLI/NBI fusion prone to mixing non-corresponding regions and may even degrade segmentation around lesion boundaries. To address this problem, we propose a reliability-aware complex-domain fusion framework for paired-but-unregistered WLI/NBI lesion segmentation. The framework first establishes topology-regularized feature correspondence and further estimates where the cross-modal correspondence is reliable. Guided by this reliability, the model selectively fuses WLI and NBI features in a learnable complex representation. In this representation, WLI-derived cues mainly provide appearance-related magnitude responses, while NBI-derived cues provide structure-sensitive phase responses. Unlike conventional real-valued or symmetric multimodal fusion, the proposed method explicitly models the different roles of WLI and NBI and suppresses unreliable cross-modal interaction in locally mismatched regions. Experiments on paired WLI/NBI endoscopic datasets show that the proposed reliability-aware registration grounding and complex-domain fusion consistently improve lesion segmentation performance. Role-reversal and module ablation studies further validate the necessity of both the modality-role design and reliability-guided cross-modal interaction.

title: Knowledge before Reasoning: EC-Reason-Bench, a Training-Free Diagnostic Benchmark for LLM Enzyme Classification
summary: Enzyme function prediction is a hierarchical, knowledge-intensive form of protein function classification. Existing benchmarks expose an anomaly: general LLMs often get the coarse first level right, yet once asked for a complete EC number their accuracy at levels two through four drops to almost zero, while specialized models and tools stay usable. We propose EC-Reason-Bench, a training-free, diagnostic evaluation protocol built to answer two questions: why general LLMs score close to nothing on EC number prediction, and how much of that loss can be recovered without updating a single weight. We break enzyme classification ability into four orthogonal levers that can each be measured on their own: output structure, external knowledge, reasoning structure, and reasoning robustness. We test each lever with an inference-time method against a shared zero-shot baseline reproducing previously reported near-zero performance. Experiments with several strong reasoning LLMs yield four main findings. First, external knowledge is decisive and must precede reasoning: uniformly low closed-book performance rises sharply with open-book access, narrowing model gaps. Second, in closed-book settings, whether cascading and chain-of-thought help or hurt depends on a model's tendency to abstain. Third, once evidence is available the aggregate score of the best LLM setting is indistinguishable from simply voting the EC numbers of the nearest retrieved neighbors; that tie is an artifact of averaging, and it hides a large gain on adversarial evidence set against an equally large loss on multi-functional enzymes. Reasoning over evidence therefore acts as an arbiter of conflicting neighbors rather than as a source of knowledge, and no single-number leaderboard can see it. Fourth, accuracy obeys a law of homology availability.

title: Flow Map Learning via Nongradient Vector Flow
summary: Diffusion and flow-based models benefit from simple regression losses, but inference incurs significant overhead because sampling requires integration. Consistency models address this by directly learning the flow maps along the ODE trajectory, opening a design space between one-step and many-step approaches. However, existing methods face computational challenges such as requiring model inverses or backpropagation through iterated model calls, and do not always prove that the desired ODE flow map is a solution to the loss. We introduce SGFlow, an approach for learning flow maps that bypasses explicit invertibility constraints and expensive differentiation through model iteration. SGFlow trains a model to compute both the ODE solutions and the implied velocity from scratch by following non-conservative dynamics with a stationary point at the desired flow map. On the CIFAR image benchmark, no single method attains the best FID at every step count: SGFlow attains the best FID at 10 sampling steps and remains competitive with flow matching, Meanflow, and Lagrangian map matching at other step counts, while being the only one with a proven stationary-point guarantee for its stopgrad-based dynamics.

title: Sensor-Placement-Agnostic Sonomyography: Toward Continuous High-Dimensional Control by Users with Tetraplegia
comments: Vikram Athithan, Emma Ferran, Maria Herrera, and Carson J. Wynn contributed equally to this work. Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media
summary:
Sonomyography (SMG) enables continuous device control via ultrasound-measured muscle deformation signals, but existing SMG interfaces generally require substantial user- and sensor-location-specific training data and provide only one proportional signal or task-specific classification. We present a real-time, sensor-placement-agnostic SMG control system based on sparse optical flow tracking that enables continuous 1-DOF control after minimal calibration (3 pose definitions). We also present a preliminary expansion of this method that augments this algorithm with a short computer-aided calibration to enable 2-DOF control.
  We evaluate both 1- and 2-DOF systems' performance for a preliminary cohort of 3 cervical spinal cord injury survivors and 6 uninjured individuals across 6 sensor placements spanning the arm, neck, and upper torso. As assessed by a cursor trajectory tracking task, all participants achieved continuous 1-DOF control at all tested sensor locations (even those that relied on passive tissue motions), with all participants achieving <5.5% tracking error using at least one placement (and many <4% across many). All participants were also able to modulate 2D cursor position via the 2-DOF system, with varying levels of control authority, and several were able to complete a 2D drawing task, constituting the first (to our knowledge) demonstration of location-agnostic multi-DOF continuous SMG-based control. These results highlight the promise of SMG to enable rapidly calibratable, high-dimensional, sensor-placement-agnostic device control by users with tetraplegia, and also illuminate key challenges in both signal processing and practical system deployment. To enable further development by scientific and user communities, developed algorithms have been open-sourced as part of the OpenMyoControl project on SimTK (simtk.org/projects/openmyocontrol).

title: From Micro-Cognition to Self-Construction: A Four-Layer Integrative Review of Psychological Theories in HCI
summary: Human-computer interaction (HCI) is undergoing a paradigm shift from "tool use" toward "partnership" and even "mind symbiosis," with psychology evolving from a supplementary explanatory tool to a core pillar shaping interaction paradigms and long-term relationships. This paper systematically reviews relevant research and proposes a four-layer integrative framework comprising the Micro-cognitive, Meso-affective, Macro-social, and Self-constructive layers. The framework reveals that: the cognitive layer constitutes the foundation of interaction, the affective layer drives relational engagement, the social layer regulates trust and behavior through norms, and the self-constructive layer points to the ultimate goal of human-machine symbiosis. These four layers follow a progressive logic of "foundation--mediation--context--goal." The review further argues that psychology has shifted from "post-hoc evaluation" to a "proactive design paradigm," with direct implications for emerging scenarios such as generative AI and embodied agents. Concurrently, this paper identifies core challenges including the nature of affect, agency erosion, and ethical risks, and proposes future directions such as bidirectional theory of mind and personalized co-evolution. This framework offers a systematic theoretical perspective for understanding complex human-machine relationships.

title: Examining the Efficacy of Graph Neural Network Message-Passing in Regression Contexts
summary:
Graph Neural Networks (GNN) facilitate effective prediction on graph data such as molecules, media networks and neural network blueprints. GNNs facilitate prediction through message passing techniques which define how information flows from a node to its neighbors. Due to the ubiquity of the graph data type, the development of newer and better GNNs has garnered much interest in the machine learning community.
  However, GNN evaluation and benchmarking is primarily driven by classification tasks. Thus, prospective GNN message passing layers are evaluated on their ability to outperform prior work in classification contexts. In contrast, GNNs are equally capable of performing scalar regression prediction, yet this class of problem is often overlooked when proposing new GNNs while the best classification GNNs are utilized in an a priori or off-the-shelf manner for regression problems. In response, this paper studies the efficacy of GNN layers in a slew of regression contexts from rank ordering, error minimization and insight extraction. Results show that deep convolutional GNNs, particularly GEN, are more effective at these tasks than attention-based GNNs, while other classical, theoretically-inspired GNNs remain competitive and efficient.

title: Can We Trust AI in 6G? Verifiable and Auditable AI-Driven Trustworthy Wireless Networks
summary: Mobile network operators are increasingly exploring the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to automate complex network tasks, such as cell selection and mobility management. A fundamental problem arises: there is currently no way to verify that an AI function is making the right decisions or for the right reasons, rather than arriving at correct-looking answers through unreliable shortcuts. In safety-critical and resilience-focused infrastructure, this lack of transparency poses a significant challenge to the widespread adoption of AI technologies in wireless networks. In this paper, we propose a mechanical auditing approach: inspecting a function's internal representations and checking them against machine-verifiable 3GPP specifications. Specifically, we set out a general three-step auditing principle that locates protocol-relevant features, verifies their causal role, and diagnoses how adaptation reshapes their use, grounding it throughout publicly available interpretability and telecommunications research. We present an audit-native network architecture in which a dedicated verification agent continuously checks the reasoning of AI functions in networks, supporting both predeployment certification and runtime auditing. We also discuss how it could be realised, the data and benchmarks, as well as the open challenges that remain before mechanistic auditing can enter telecommunications practice and standardisation.

title: Voice Memory for Agentic Speech Recognition
comments: Preprint. Technical report and open source: https://huggingface.co/huckiyang/voice-memory
summary: We present Voice Memory, a inference-only scheme for agentic speech recognition: at stream time, a frozen corrector reads a single per-domain memory.md and decides per utterance whether to act on the hypothesis or abstain and keep the 1-best. Asynchronously, a score-gated optimizer revises that file through bounded edits, accepting an edit only when it strictly improves a held-out score. Extended from classical ASR-LM framework, we refer this split the listener-thinker architecture; the two roles are coupled only through the memory, so no weights change and the learned skill stays auditable and portable. Restraint turns out to be the operative skill this loop discovers: unconstrained generative error correction (GER) over-corrects, breaking correct tokens on up to 64% of its edits on financial news, and Voice Memory, reduces this rate to 35%. Across ten HyPoradise domains with an open corrector, Voice Memory, lowers weighted word error rate from 8.36% to 7.52% (7.47% with three added in-context examples) without regressing any dataset below its 1-best baseline; gains concentrate where recoverable headroom is largest, including air-travel commands (8.40% to 3.40%) and noisy far-field speech (CHiME-4, 12.69% to 10.46%). The memory transfers across corrector families and adds zero parameters to the inference path. A demo and example code are provided for future studies.
comment: Preprint. Technical report and open source: https://huggingface.co/huckiyang/voice-memory

title: Do Unified Multimodal Models Think in One Space? A Lens Through Cross-Branch Steering
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to integrate understanding and generation within a single architecture, yet it remains unclear whether these capabilities share a unified and transferable semantic space. This question is fundamentally challenging, as the two branches operate over heterogeneous representations (text tokens vs.\ visual latents) and distinct training objectives, making direct comparison difficult. To address this, we introduce \emph{cross-branch semantic steering}, an intervention-based framework that extracts semantic directions from one branch and applies them to the other. We show that steering vectors learned from the understanding branch can transfer to generation, enabling controllable image synthesis and improved semantic faithfulness. In contrast, the reverse direction consistently shows limited effectiveness. Our analysis suggests that this asymmetry may be related to a practical representational mismatch: understanding-derived vectors capture transferable, object-centric semantics, while generation-derived vectors primarily encode low-level appearance features. Our results reveal that architectural unification does not guarantee semantic alignment, and establish cross-branch steering as a practical tool for probing multimodal representations.

title: When Fish Look Alike: Tracking Identities with Dual-branch Elasticity
summary: Tracking dense, homogeneous targets like schooling fish remains a major challenge for multiple object tracking due to extreme inter-individual homogeneity, severe physical clustering, and rapid non-rigid deformations. While heavy-backbone separated detection and embedding trackers like SU-T push accuracy boundaries using complex Re-Identification networks, their computational overhead prohibits edge deployment. Furthermore, these modules often fail when appearance features degrade under severe occlusions. To overcome this, we propose Tracking Identities with Dual-branch Elasticity (TIDE). Bypassing expensive appearance cues, TIDE utilizes the Adaptive Geometric Correspondence IoU, an association mechanism leveraging spatial and structural consistency to robustly handle complex morphological variations. Crucially, TIDE introduces system-level deployment elasticity, decoupling the algorithmic pipeline from strict hardware constraints. Evaluations on the MFT-Edge benchmark demonstrate that our Lightweight L-branch achieves a competitive HOTA of 28.43 using merely 20.47G FLOPs. This represents a 38.7-fold computational reduction compared to upper bounds like SU-T, directly facilitating real-time edge deployment. Concurrently, our Scalable S-branch establishes a 29.98 HOTA, successfully bridging the gap between high-precision cloud analysis and efficient edge tracking. The dataset and codes are released at https://vranlee.github.io/TIDE/.

title: Machine-Checked Certificates for the Geometric Half of the Minimum Kochen-Specker Bound
comments: Lean 4 and Python sources, certificates, and CI at https://github.com/shayaansiddique06/kscert
summary: The best known lower bound for the minimum Kochen-Specker vector system in $\mathbb{R}^3$ -- 24 vectors -- rests on a computational proof whose combinatorial half emits DRAT proofs but whose geometric half does not: the non-embeddability of thousands of candidate graphs is established by Z3's nonlinear real arithmetic, which produces no checkable proof objects. We close this gap for the proof's blocking database. We introduce exact rational case-tree certificates of real non-embeddability, whose splits are polynomial factorizations and rational sum-of-squares decompositions and whose leaves are discharged by injectivity, ideal-membership, or Positivstellensatz-shaped positivity arguments, and we certify all 291 source lines (180 distinct graphs) of the published pipeline's order-10 to order-13 blocking lists. Certificates are replayed by two independent checkers that share no code with the generator: a pure-Python replay over exact fractions, and a total checker implemented and proved sound in Lean 4. The soundness theorem -- acceptance implies that no injective-on-rays, orthogonality-respecting assignment of nonzero real vectors realizes the graph -- is kernel-checked with axiom closure {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}, and a gcd-free rational arithmetic layer makes the entire verdict computation kernel-reducible, so each per-graph non-embeddability result is a closed kernel theorem proved by decide. The formalization surfaced findings about the published pipeline, including a load-bearing injectivity side condition in its embeddability notion, hidden WLOG case obligations invisible to Z3-based workflows, and an unreproducible candidate count that we resolve against the published artifacts. All certificates, checkers, and proofs are available and replayable from a single build.
comment: Lean 4 and Python sources, certificates, and CI at https://github.com/shayaansiddique06/kscert

title: SCOUT: Per-Context Reset Curricula for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: Sparse-reward reinforcement learning often fails because rollouts from the unassisted evaluation start rarely reach later task stages. Reset curricula address this by starting some training rollouts from easier intermediate states, called scaffolds. Such a curriculum faces two decisions: scaffold access, obtaining informative starts, and scaffold allocation, deciding how quickly that assistance is removed. Most prior curricula pace removal on one shared schedule, which can fail when task instances, or contexts, learn at different rates. We introduce SCOUT, an online, learner-agnostic reset controller that gives every context its own curriculum. Using only binary rollout success, SCOUT removes assistance after sustained success, restores it after failure, and cautiously tests a harder start when progress stalls, without changing the reward, optimizer, or learner. A counting construction shows that synchronized global pacing can be insufficient when contexts need conflicting amounts of assisted practice. Across six navigation and manipulation settings, scaffold access improves learning and enables success in three where unassisted training fails within the reported budget. In a constructed pacing conflict, each tested global schedule leaves one group unsolved, while SCOUT solves both. Average success can conceal this failure, so we also report the least successful group. Group-level pacing works when learning differences follow known groups but can fail when they occur within one group. SCOUT needs no group labels and remains consistently strong in both cases. A reset curriculum should remove assistance at the scale where learning progress differs.

title: DIRECTOR: Dynamic Index-based Recommendation with Transport-Optimized Retrieval
summary: Reranking is a combinatorial decision problem that aims to select and order a high-utility slate from a request-specific candidate set. A major line of generative rerankers adopts autoregressive (AR) models, which construct the slate one position at a time to capture inter-position dependencies. However, under practical greedy or bounded-width decoding, prefix-based search may prematurely prune globally promising permutations and incurs inherently sequential latency, restricting the effective search space under a fixed serving budget. Non-autoregressive (NAR) alternatives alleviate this efficiency bottleneck through position-parallel prediction, but naive position-wise factorization treats different positions too independently, leading to insufficient cross-position coordination and potentially duplicate or conflicting item selections. To retain parallel efficiency while introducing global structural coordination, we propose Dynamic Index-based RECommendation with Transport-Optimized Retrieval (DIRECTOR), a transport-guided parallel reranking framework. DIRECTOR maps candidate items into a continuous latent space and generates request-conditioned dynamic retrieval indices for all target positions in parallel.
