For symmetric pairwise allocations the induced game is an exact potential game: a Nash-stable partition exists, every strict better-response process converges, and with destination consent accepted better responses reach an individually stable partition. We characterize feasibility of bounded pair incentives and verify the exponentially many budget constraints in polynomial oracle time when retained slack is submodular. Decomposing welfare into participant potential and retained slack yields additive and multiplicative price-of-stability guarantees, the latter asymptotically tight; exact balance gives welfare-optimal stability only on the pairwise-representable class, and budget feasibility alone permits unbounded welfare loss. Global potential maximization equals weighted maximum-agreement correlation clustering, and approximation followed by stabilization satisfies an end-to-end welfare bound governed by retained slack and negative-edge mass, attained by an explicit construction. In a preregistered five-seed CIFAR-10 study the mechanism reaches the certified estimated-table welfare optimum on every primary instance, equal-surplus sharing has no Nash-stable outcome on three, and pairwise validation gain gives far more reliable pair signs than gradient alignment.
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures. Substantially revised and extended version of arXiv:2101.09673 (OptLearnMAS workshop at AAMAS 2021). Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21428635

AI.title_translation: 聚类联邦学习中稳定且预算可行的联盟形成：一种享乐势能博弈方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于享乐势能博弈的机制，实现了聚类联邦学习中稳定且预算可行的参与者联盟形成。
AI.motivation: 聚类联邦学习通过将异质参与者划分为不同联盟来训练特定模型，但这种划分要能够长期持续，必须保证参与者对其分配的联盟具有偏好（稳定性），且所需的转移支付在预算上是可负担的（预算可行性）。
AI.method: 提出了一个分离学习收益、系统成本、参与者成本和货币转移的可转移剩余模型；利用分配规则将联盟剩余转化为享乐偏好，并引入弱预算可行性；将诱导博弈建模为精确势能博弈；在保留松弛量为次模时利用多项式神谕时间验证指数级预算约束；采用基于加权最大一致性关联聚类的全局势能最大化及近似稳定化构造算法。
AI.result: 证明了Nash稳定分区和个人稳定分区的存在性及更好响应过程的收敛性；建立了渐近紧确的乘性稳定价格界限；在CIFAR-10实验中，该机制在所有主要实例上均达到了认证的福利最优，且证明了双边验证增益比梯度对齐能提供更可靠的双边符号。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的机制为聚类联邦学习中的参与者联盟形成提供了稳定性与预算可行性双重保障，并在理论福利界限和实际模型性能上均取得了优异的表现。
AI.translation: 聚类联邦学习受益于将异质参与者组织成训练特定联盟模型的联盟，但只有当参与者更偏好被分配的联盟且所需的资金转移是可负担的时，这种聚类才是可持续的。我们开发了一个分离学习收益、系统成本、参与者成本和货币转移的可转移剩余模型；分配规则将联盟剩余转化为享乐偏好，弱预算可行性保证了保留的协调员剩余非负。对于对称双边分配，诱导博弈是一个精确势能博弈：存在Nash稳定分区，每个严格更好响应过程都会收敛，并且在目标同意的情况下，接受的更好响应将达到个人稳定分区。我们刻画了有界双边激励的可行性，并在保留松弛量为次模时，在多项式神谕时间内验证了指数级数量的预算约束。将福利分解为参与者势能和保留松弛量，可以产生加性和乘性稳定价格保证，后者渐近紧确；精确平衡仅在双边可表征类上提供福利最优稳定性，而仅凭预算可行性可能导致无界福利损失。全局势能最大化等于加权最大一致性关联聚类，近似后稳定化满足由保留松弛量和负边质量决定的端到端福利界限，并通过显式构造实现。在预先注册的五种子CIFAR-10研究中，该机制在每个主要实例上都达到了认证的估计表福利最优，等额剩余分享在其中三个实例上没有Nash稳定结果，且双边验证增益提供了比梯度对齐可靠得多的双边符号。
AI.summary: 本文针对聚类联邦学习提出了一种基于享乐势能博弈的联盟形成机制，解决了参与者异质性下的稳定性与协调员预算可行性问题。论文提供了收敛性、预算约束可验证性以及福利界限的理论证明，并通过CIFAR-10实验验证了该机制的优越性。
AI.keywords: Clustered Federated Learning, Coalition Formation, Hedonic Potential Games, Budget Feasibility, Price of Stability
AI.comments: 本文将享乐势能博弈和博弈论机制设计引入聚类联邦学习，创新性地解决了参与者偏好稳定性与协调员预算可行性之间的矛盾。文章不仅在理论上证明了Nash稳定分区的存在性、算法收敛性以及稳定价格（Price of Stability）界限，还在算法复杂度和实证验证（预先注册的CIFAR-10实验）上给出了坚实的支撑，具有很高的理论与应用价值。

title: CheckVLA: Execution-Time Verification with Action-Conditioned World Model for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly execute long-horizon mobile manipulation through open-loop action chunks, issuing multiple actions without receiving new high-level visual input. A committed chunk therefore implies how observations should evolve, but accidental deviations can violate this expectation while the remaining actions continue to propagate the error: commit-time policy confidence cannot react to a deviation that occurs after dispatch, and observation-only anomaly scores lack an action-conditioned reference for separating expected effects from unexplained changes. We propose CheckVLA, which verifies execution with a separately trained, frozen action-conditioned world model. A conformally calibrated risk threshold bounds the episode-level probability of an unnecessary first intervention and determines when to intervene, its exceedance controls how strongly the rewritten suffix retains the superseded chunk, latency-aware hard prefixing restricts replacement to actions that remain deployable, and an event-driven keyframe bank preserves evidence of prior progress across repairs. On RoboCasa365, under a common training recipe and a matched invocation budget, CheckVLA attains a 36.1% average success rate against 27.6% for periodic replanning (+8.5 points). At a matched 5% episode-level false-alarm target, action conditioning raises timely recall to 77.9%, against 48.6% for an observation-only control and 37.9% for an action-shuffled control. These simulation results support action-conditioned verification as a way to restore feedback during chunked execution while keeping the repair consistent with inference latency.

AI.title_translation: CheckVLA：基于动作条件世界模型的长程移动操作执行期验证
AI.tldr: CheckVLA利用动作条件世界模型对VLA策略的开环动作块进行执行期实时验证与延迟感知纠正，显著提高了长程移动操作的成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在执行长程移动操作时通常采用开环动作块（action chunks），即在不接收新高层视觉输入的情况下连续发出多个动作。一旦执行中出现意外偏差，策略在提交时的置信度无法应对调度后发生的错误，且纯观察的异常检测缺乏动作条件参考，无法区分预期改变与未知偏差，导致错误持续累积。
AI.method: 提出了CheckVLA框架，利用单独训练且冻结的动作条件世界模型验证执行过程。主要机制包括：使用符合性校准（conformally calibrated）的风险阈值限定误报率并决定干预时机；利用风险超额量控制重写动作后缀对原动作块的保留强度；引入延迟感知的硬前缀限制，确保仅替换仍然可部署的动作；建立事件驱动的关键帧库，在多次修复中保留任务进展证据。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa365基准测试中，CheckVLA取得了36.1%的平均成功率，显著高于定期重规划的27.6%（提升8.5个百分点）。在5%的剧集级假警报控制目标下，动作条件验证将及时召回率提升至77.9%，远优于仅观察对照组（48.6%）和动作打乱对照组（37.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 仿真实验结果表明，基于动作条件的验证机制能够在动作块执行期间有效恢复反馈，同时确保修复过程与推理延迟保持一致，显著提高了长程移动操作任务的执行成功率。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常通过开环动作块执行长程移动操作，即在不接收新高层视觉输入的情况下发出多个动作。因此，已提交的动作块暗含了观察应当如何演化的期望，但意外偏差可能会破坏这一期望，而剩余动作则会继续传播错误：提交时的策略置信度无法对调度后发生的偏差做出反应，且仅基于观察的异常评分缺乏动作条件参考，无法将预期效果与未解释的变化区分开来。我们提出了CheckVLA，它通过一个单独训练且冻结的动作条件世界模型来验证执行过程。符合性校准的风险阈值限定了不必要首次干预的剧集级概率并确定何时干预；风险超额量控制重写的后缀保留被替代动作块的强度；延迟感知的硬前缀将替换限制在仍可部署的动作上；事件驱动的关键帧库在多次修复中保存先前进展的证据。在RoboCasa365上，在通用训练配方和匹配的调用预算下，CheckVLA的平均成功率达到36.1%，而定期重规划仅为27.6%（提高8.5个百分点）。在匹配的5%剧集级假警报目标下，动作条件将及时召回率提高到77.9%，而仅观察对照组为48.6%，动作打乱对照组为37.9%。这些仿真结果支持动作条件验证作为在动作块执行期间恢复反馈的一种方法，同时保持修复与推理延迟一致。
AI.summary: 针对VLA策略在开环动作块执行中无法应对中途错误的缺陷，本文提出了CheckVLA。该框架通过动作条件世界模型实时监控观察结果与期望演化是否匹配，结合符合性风险控制、延迟感知的前缀保护及关键帧记忆机制，实现了兼顾低误报与实时性的在线监测与纠错，显著提升了长程移动操作的稳健性。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作策略, 动作条件世界模型, 执行期验证, 异常检测, 移动操作
AI.comments: 创新点在于将动作条件世界模型引入VLA策略的开环执行阶段，解决了传统开环动作块（action chunking）缺乏中途反馈的问题，同时结合了符合性校准与延迟感知约束。重要性在于显著提升了长程移动操作的鲁棒性与故障恢复能力。局限性在于目前实验仅在RoboCasa365仿真环境中完成，真实机器人部署中的视觉与物理噪声可能带来更大挑战。

title: Joint State-Parameter Inference Enhances Estimation Performance in Model-Based Digital Therapeutics for Type 1 Diabetes
comments: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for publication at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: Blood glucose estimation is the cornerstone of model-based decision support (DS) and Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) systems. Control systems that rely on physiologic/compartmental models depend heavily on model parameterization, which is either defined using population values or personalized through the user's data. Often, the model parameters are defined as constants. However, under real-world free-living conditions, fixed parameters can limit the accurate reconstruction and estimation of glucose levels and states. In this paper, we propose and discuss a recursive filtering framework for online joint state estimation and parameter identification in nonlinear, time-varying physiological models for Type 1 Diabetes (T1D). Specifically, we employ a Rao-Blackwellized Stein Variational Gradient Descent (RBSVGD) filter to compute the joint posterior distributions of model states and parameters. The proposed approach is applied to the Hovorka glucose-insulin model and validated using data generated by the the Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU) simulator across 20 virtual patients. We perform a comparative analysis against: (i) a standard Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) with fixed model parameters, and (ii) an Augmented Extended Kalman Filter (AEKF) for joint state-parameter estimation. The results demonstrate that the proposed RBSVGD-based framework outperforms both EKF and AEKF approaches not only in terms of the accuracy of glucose estimation, but also in terms of estimated model parameters.
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Accepted for publication at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)

AI.title_translation: 联合状态-参数推理提升基于模型的1型糖尿病数字疗法估算性能
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于RBSVGD滤波器的在线联合状态-参数估计框架，显著提升了1型糖尿病模型血糖估计和参数识别的准确性。
AI.motivation: 在真实自由生活条件下，生理模型中的固定参数无法适应个体血糖动态的时变与非线性特征，限制了血糖水平和生理状态的精确重建与估算。
AI.method: 提出了基于Rao-Blackwellized Stein变分梯度下降（RBSVGD）滤波器的递推滤波框架，用于计算Hovorka血糖-胰岛素模型状态和参数的联合后验分布；并在OHSU模拟器生成的20名虚拟患者数据上，与固定参数的扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）及增广扩展卡尔曼滤波（AEKF）进行了对比验证。
AI.result: 基于RBSVGD的框架在血糖估算准确度以及模型参数估计质量上，均显著优于固定参数的EKF和进行联合估计的AEKF方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于RBSVGD的在线联合状态-参数推理能够有效提升1型糖尿病数字疗法与自动胰岛素递送系统中生理模型的估算精度与参数辨识效果。
AI.translation: 血糖估算是基于模型的决策支持（DS）和自动胰岛素递送（AID）系统的基石。依靠生理/室模型的控制系统高度依赖于模型参数化，这些参数要么使用群体值定义，要么通过用户数据进行个性化定义。通常，模型参数被定义为常数。然而，在真实世界的自由生活条件下，固定参数会限制血糖水平和状态的准确重建与估算。在本文中，我们提出并讨论了一种用于1型糖尿病（T1D）非线性、时变生理模型的在线联合状态估计与参数识别的递推滤波框架。具体而言，我们采用Rao-Blackwellized Stein变分梯度下降（RBSVGD）过滤器来计算模型状态和参数的联合后验分布。所提出的方法应用于Hovorka血糖-胰岛素模型，并使用俄勒冈健康与科学大学（OHSU）模拟器生成的20名虚拟患者数据进行了验证。我们将其与以下方法进行了对比分析：（i）具有固定模型参数的标准扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF），以及（ii）用于联合状态-参数估计的增广扩展卡尔曼滤波（AEKF）。结果表明，基于RBSVGD的框架不仅在血糖估算的准确性方面，而且在估计的模型参数方面，均优于EKF和AEKF方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对1型糖尿病（T1D）生理模型的非线性与时变特性，提出了一种基于RBSVGD滤波的在线联合状态估计与参数识别递推框架。在Hovorka模型及OHSU模拟数据上的验证结果表明，该方法在血糖估算精度和参数识别质量上均优于传统EKF和AEKF方法，为基于模型的自动胰岛素递送与决策支持系统提供了更精准的估计手段。
AI.keywords: 1型糖尿病, 血糖估算, 联合状态-参数估计, RBSVGD, 决策支持系统
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将RBSVGD非线性采样/变分推理方法引入1型糖尿病生理模型的在线联合状态-参数估计中，有效克服了传统EKF和AEKF在面对强非线性与时变生理特性时的局限。论文在20名虚拟患者数据上进行了充分验证，对数字疗法和自动胰岛素递送系统的精确控制具有重要应用价值。局限在于目前验证仅基于模拟器数据，未来仍需在真实患者临床数据中进一步检验其鲁棒性与实时计算性能。

title: SecRespond: Benchmarking AI Agents for Real-World Post-Compromise Incident Response
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly adopted in real-world security operations with access to host artifacts and command-line interfaces (CLIs), making it critical to thoroughly assess their security capabilities. However, existing cybersecurity benchmarks focus on pre-compromise settings where agents are placed in a clean and idealized environment before an attack occurs. This leaves the post-compromise setting underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce SecRespond, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on the post-compromise incident-response workflow. Given a forensic disk snapshot of a compromised host together with the alerts, vulnerability scans, and baseline checks reported by a host security product, agents are required to produce forensic reports on intrusions, baseline risks, and vulnerability risks, together with a remediation plan. We instantiate this task across 10 cyber ranges, each constructed from a distinct compromised cloud host, spanning 4 entry-point types, 21 ATT&CK techniques, and 5 operating systems. We evaluate 23 frontier LLMs on the OpenCode agent harness. Experimental results show that although current agents can reliably uncover the problems exposed by alerts, they struggle to proactively investigate the disk for silent intrusions and to produce comprehensive, verified remediation plans, with no model achieving complete detection and remediation on any single range. This reveals a fundamental bottleneck in building agents for real-world incident response. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr/tree/main/data/secrespond.

AI.title_translation: SecRespond：针对真实世界入侵后事件响应评估AI Agent的基准测试
AI.tldr: SecRespond是首个评估LLM Agent在真实入侵后事件响应中能力的基准测试，研究发现当前模型在主动排查隐蔽入侵和制定有效修复计划上存在明显 bottleneck。
AI.motivation: 现有网络安全基准测试多关注攻击发生前的理想干净环境（入侵前设置），而对真实的入侵后事件响应（post-compromise）场景缺乏深入探索和有效评估。
AI.method: 提出了SecRespond基准，评估Agent在给定受侵害主机磁盘镜像快照及安全告警、漏洞扫描、基线检查的前提下，生成取证报告和修复计划的能力。测试覆盖10个基于真实云主机构建的网络靶场（包含4种入口类型、21种ATT&CK技术、5种操作系统），并在OpenCode Agent框架上对23个前沿LLM进行了评估。
AI.result: 对23个前沿LLM的评估显示，虽然Agent能够可靠地处理告警暴露的问题，但难以主动深入磁盘排查未告警的隐蔽入侵，也难以给出全面且经验证的修复计划；没有任何模型能在单个靶场上实现完全的检测与修复。
AI.conclusion: 现有的前沿LLM Agent在处理真实入侵后事件响应任务时存在根本性瓶颈，尤其缺乏对隐蔽入侵的主动调查能力和可靠的修复规划能力。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent在真实世界安全运维中得到越来越广泛的应用，它们能够访问主机工具和命令行界面（CLI），因此彻底评估其安全能力至关重要。然而，现有的网络安全基准测试主要关注攻击发生前的理想干净环境（即入侵前设置），这使得入侵后场景的研究不够充分。为了弥补这一空白，我们推出了 SecRespond，这是首个用于评估 LLM Agent 在入侵后事件响应工作流中表现的基准测试。在给定受侵害主机的磁盘取证快照以及主机安全产品报告的告警、漏洞扫描和基线检查的前提下，Agent 需要生成关于入侵、基线风险和漏洞风险的取证报告，并提供修复计划。我们在 10 个网络靶场上实操了该任务，每个靶场均构建自不同的受侵害云主机，涵盖 4 种入口类型、21 种 ATT&CK 技术和 5 种操作系统。我们在 OpenCode Agent 框架上评估了 23 个前沿 LLM。实验结果表明，尽管当前的 Agent 能够可靠地揭示告警所暴露的问题，但它们在主动调查磁盘中的隐蔽入侵以及制定全面、经过验证的修复计划方面表现欠佳，没有任何模型能在单个靶场上实现完全的检测与修复。这揭示了构建用于真实事件响应的 Agent 的根本瓶颈。该基准已公开于 https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr/tree/main/data/secrespond。
AI.summary: 本文推出了SecRespond，首个用于评估LLM Agent在真实入侵后事件响应能力的基准测试。通过构建涵盖多种操作系统和ATT&CK技术的受侵害云主机靶场，评估Agent从告警和磁盘快照中提取取证报告并制定修复计划的能力。测试结果揭示了当前LLM Agent在主动调查和修复验证方面的明显瓶颈。
AI.keywords: LLM Agent, 事件响应, 入侵后取证, 网络安全基准, 漏洞修复
AI.comments:
创新性：首次填补了AI Agent在网络安全“入侵后（Post-Compromise）事件响应”评估领域的空白，贴近真实安全运维的工作流（结合告警、取证快照、报告生成与修复计划）。
重要性：现实中的安全运维大量面对已发生的入侵，评估Agent在真实隐蔽入侵和修复场景下的能力对推动AI落地安全实践具有重大价值。
局限性：目前包含10个靶场，虽然涵盖了多种系统和技术，但对于复杂企业级网络和持续动态对抗场景的模拟仍有扩展空间。

title: When Does Span-Guided Detoxification Help? Human Preferences and Evaluator Diagnostics in a Controlled Comparison
summary:
Span-guided rewriting aims to preserve meaning by localizing edits to annotated harmful spans, but the same constraint can leave harmful intent insufficiently mitigated. We present a controlled exploratory comparison of span-guided and unguided detoxification on a mixed-source English evaluation set comprising manually curated inputs and HateXplain test items. We conduct a dense blinded human evaluation under a fixed single-generator setting.
  Human preferences reveal a trade-off rather than a uniformly superior rewriting strategy. Span-guided outputs are favored when localized editing preserves the original stance and avoids unnecessary modification, whereas unguided outputs are favored when broader rewriting achieves more complete mitigation. This contrast varies substantially across the study-defined strata: the two strategies are competitive in the strong stratum, while unguided rewriting is clearly preferred in the mild stratum. Rationale annotations trace this difference to complementary failure risks: residual harm after localized editing and over-modification after broader rewriting.
  We treat automatic evaluation as a diagnostic rather than a substitute for human judgment. Toxicity-similarity scalarizations, a multi-generator analysis, and two general-purpose LLM judges reproduce parts of the aggregate tendency but do not yield an analogous stratified contrast. These setting-specific findings do not establish a severity-based routing rule. Instead, they motivate evaluation protocols that assess mitigation sufficiency and meaning preservation separately and report both residual harm and over-modification alongside aggregate scores.

AI.title_translation: 基于跨度的去毒化何时有效？控制比较中的人类偏好与评估器诊断
AI.tldr: 通过人类偏好对比，研究发现基于跨度的文本去毒与无指导重写各有优劣，提出评估去毒模型时应分别衡量“剩余伤害”与“过度修改”。
AI.motivation: 基于跨度的重写旨在通过将修改局限在已标注的有害文本跨度内来保留语义，但这种限制可能导致有害意图未能得到充分消除。研究旨在明确基于跨度重写与无指导重写各自适用的场景及权衡。
AI.method: 在固定单一生成器设置下，基于包含手动精选输入和HateXplain测试项的混合源英文评估集，开展了一项密集的双盲人类评估实验，对比基于跨度与无指导的重写策略；同时使用了基于毒性-相似度标量化方法、多生成器分析及通用大语言模型裁判进行诊断性自动评估。
AI.result: 人类偏好表明存在明显的权衡：在需要保留原始立场且避免不必要修改时，基于跨度的输出更受青睐；而在需要更全面消除毒性时，无指导输出更受青睐。两者在强毒性分层中势均力敌，而在温和毒性分层中无指导重写明显更优。自动评估指标能复制部分总体趋势，但无法还原这一分层对比。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调，评估协议应当将去毒充分性与语义保留分开评估，并在汇报综合得分的同时，分别报告剩余伤害和过度修改，而不是仅依赖单一的自动评估标量指标。
AI.translation: 基于跨度的重写旨在通过将修改局限在标注的有害跨度内来保留语义，但同样的约束可能导致有害意图未能得到充分减轻。我们在包含手动精选输入和 HateXplain 测试项的混合源英文评估集上，对基于跨度与无指导的去毒化进行了受控探索性比较。我们在固定的单一生成器设置下进行了密集的双盲人类评估。人类偏好揭示了一种权衡，而非单一优越的重写策略。当局部的编辑能保留原始立场并避免不必要的修改时，基于跨度的输出更受青睐；而当更广泛的重写能实现更充分的去毒时，无指导的输出更受青睐。这种对比在研究定义的分层中存在显著差异：两种策略在强毒性分层中势均力敌，而在温和毒性分层中无指导重写明显更受青睐。理由标注将这一差异归因于互补的失败风险：局部编辑后的剩余伤害，以及广泛重写后的过度修改。我们将自动评估视为诊断手段而非人工判断的替代品。毒性-相似度标量化、多生成器分析以及两个通用大模型裁判能够还原部分总体趋势，但未能给出类似的分层对比。这些特定设置下的发现并未确立基于严重程度的路由规则，而是提出了应分别评估去毒充分性和语义保留的评估协议，并在汇报综合得分的同时报告剩余伤害和过度修改。
AI.summary: 本研究针对文本去毒中的“基于跨度重写”与“无指导重写”策略开展了控制比较实验。研究通过密集的人类偏好评估发现，两种策略在消除毒性与保留语义之间存在权衡，且表现差异随输入文本的毒性程度而异。此外，现有的自动评估指标和LLM裁判无法完整捕捉人类评估中的分层对比，表明需要改进去毒评估协议。
AI.keywords: 去毒化, 文本重写, 人类偏好, 自动评估, 自然语言处理
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于通过受控的人类评估深入探讨了基于跨度去毒与无指导去毒的内在权衡，揭示了自动评估指标在捕捉细粒度策略差异方面的局限性。其重要性在于提出了未来文本去毒评估应将“剩余伤害”和“过度修改”分开衡量的建议，为后续去毒技术和评估标准的设计提供了有力参考。

title: Optimal Error Estimates of a Finite Element Method for Semilinear SPDEs with Additive Noise and Nonsmooth Initial Data
summary: This paper presents a strong error analysis of both semidiscrete and fully discrete approximations for semilinear parabolic stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) driven by additive noise and subject to nonsmooth initial data. The spatial discretization is based on a standard finite element method, coupled with the linearly implicit Euler scheme in time. Under low-regularity initial conditions, we derive sharp spatial and temporal regularity estimates that isolate the loss of initial regularity into an integrable temporal singularity, allowing us to establish optimal strong error estimates for positive times. Specifically, we prove strong convergence rates of order $O(h^β)$ for the spatially semidiscrete approximation and $O(h^β+ k^{β/2})$ for the fully discrete scheme away from $t = 0$, where the parameter $β\in (0, 2]$ characterizes the spatial regularity of the noise process. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical convergence rates.

AI.title_translation: 具有加性噪声和非光滑初值的半线性随机偏微分方程有限元法的最优误差估计
AI.tldr: 本文针对非光滑初值和加性噪声驱动的半线性SPDE，推导了有限元和线性隐式Euler格式在远离 $t=0$ 时的最优强误差估计。
AI.motivation: 针对驱动噪声且初始数据非光滑（低正则性）的半线性抛物型SPDE，建立离散数值格式在正时间上的最优强误差估计。
AI.method: 空间上采用标准有限元法，时间上采用线性隐式Euler格式；推导敏锐的时空正则性估计，将初值正则性的损失隔离为可积的时间奇异性。
AI.result: 在远离 $t=0$ 时，证明了空间半离散格式的强收敛阶为 $O(h^\beta)$，全离散格式的强收敛阶为 $O(h^\beta + k^{\beta/2})$（其中 $\beta \in (0, 2]$ 表征噪声的空间正则性），数值实验验证了理论收敛阶。
AI.conclusion: 成功建立了非光滑初值半线性抛物型SPDE半离散与全离散有限元格式的最优强收敛速率，数值实验印证了理论结果。
AI.translation: 本文对由加性噪声驱动且具有非光滑初值的半线性抛物型随机偏微分方程（SPDE）的半离散和全离散近似进行了强误差分析。空间离散基于标准有限元法，时间上结合线性隐式Euler格式。在低正则性初值条件下，我们推导出了敏锐的时空正则性估计，将初值正则性的损失隔离为可积的时间奇异性，从而使我们能够在正时间建立最优的强误差估计。具体而言，在远离 $t = 0$ 的情况下，我们证明了空间半离散近似的强收敛阶为 $O(h^\beta)$，全离散格式的强收敛阶为 $O(h^\beta + k^{\beta/2})$，其中参数 $\beta\in (0, 2]$ 表征噪声过程的空间正则性。数值实验验证了理论收敛速率。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有加性噪声和非光滑初值的半线性抛物型SPDE的时空数值离散方案。结合标准有限元法与线性隐式Euler格式，通过隔离初值引起的时空奇异性，证明了远离初始时刻下的最优强误差估计，并通过数值实验验证了收敛率。
AI.keywords: 随机偏微分方程, 有限元法, 线性隐式Euler格式, 非光滑初值, 强误差估计
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于成功处理了低正则性（非光滑）初值半线性SPDE的强误差分析，通过推导敏锐的时空正则性估计，将初值正则性损失隔离为可积的时间奇异性，从而建立了正时间上的最优强收敛阶。这为非光滑初值下随机偏微分方程的数值分析提供了坚实的理论依据。局限在于目前研究主要针对加性噪声，推广至乘性噪声仍具挑战。

title: PRISM-Net: Patient-specific reference-guided inter-breast symmetry matching for three-class breast DCE-MRI classification
summary: Breast DCE-MRI AI is increasingly being explored for breast-level classification of no-lesion, benign, and malignant findings, beyond conventional lesion-centered diagnosis. Within this broader diagnostic scope, however, patient-specific background variability remains a major source of imaging confounding across classification tasks. Existing approaches predominantly focus on unilateral or lesion-centric analysis, whereas bilateral methods offer limited explicit modeling of spatially adaptive cross-breast correspondence. We propose PRISM-Net, a registration-free bilateral framework that leverages contralateral breast features as patient-specific references for background-aware representation learning. PRISM-Net integrates bilateral feature matching and asymmetry-aware attention to establish adaptive inter-breast correspondence and enhance representations of discriminative asymmetric patterns. On ODELIA, Macro AUC, Micro AUC, and quadratic weighted kappa were $84.11 \pm 2.33$, $90.64 \pm 1.61$, and $60.94 \pm 5.64$ on the in-distribution test set, and $68.51 \pm 4.54$, $80.74 \pm 2.68$, and $43.45 \pm 7.10$ on the held-out institution, respectively, outperforming the evaluated baseline methods across the primary evaluation metrics. PRISM-Net further demonstrated performance on independent institutional and background-complexity evaluations. Ablation experiments revealed that both bilateral relation modeling and asymmetry-aware reweighting contributed to improved classification performance. These findings highlight patient-specific bilateral reference modeling as a clinically grounded strategy for DCE-MRI interpretation, improving asymmetric pattern discrimination through explicit modeling of background complexity.

AI.title_translation: PRISM-Net：基于患者特异性参考引导的双乳对称性匹配的三类乳腺DCE-MRI分类网络
AI.tldr: PRISM-Net利用对侧乳腺作为患者特异性参考，结合免配准的双侧特征匹配和不对称感知注意力，提升了乳腺DCE-MRI三分类的准确率。
AI.motivation: 乳腺DCE-MRI诊断中，患者特异性的背景变异性是主要的图像干扰因素。现有的分析方法多集中于单侧或以病灶为中心，而现有的双侧方法缺乏对空间自适应跨乳腺对应关系的显式建模。
AI.method: 提出了PRISM-Net，一种免配准（registration-free）的双侧深度学习框架。该框架利用对侧乳腺特征作为患者特异性的参考，进行背景感知的表示学习，并融合了双侧特征匹配和不对称感知注意力机制，建立自适应的双乳对应关系，强化有区分度的不对称模式表示。
AI.result: 在ODELIA数据集上，PRISM-Net在分布内测试集上的Macro AUC、Micro AUC和二次加权kappa分别达到84.11%、90.64%和60.94%；在留出机构测试集上分别达到68.51%、80.74%和43.45%，性能均显著优于基线方法。消融实验进一步证实了双侧关系建模和不对称感知重加权对性能提升的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 患者特异性的双侧参考建模是一种符合临床诊断逻辑的DCE-MRI解释策略，通过显式建模背景复杂性，能够有效改善不对称病变模式的区分能力。
AI.translation: 乳腺DCE-MRI人工智能正在超越传统的以病灶为中心的诊断，越来越多地被探索用于无病灶、良性和恶性结果的乳腺级分类。然而，在这一更广泛的诊断范围内，患者特定的背景变异性仍然是跨分类任务中图像干扰的主要来源。现有方法主要关注单侧或以病灶为中心分析，而双侧方法对空间自适应跨乳腺对应关系的显式建模有限。我们提出了PRISM-Net，这是一个免配准的双侧框架，利用对侧乳腺特征作为患者特定的参考来进行背景感知的表示学习。PRISM-Net集成了双侧特征匹配和不对称感知注意力，建立自适应的双乳对应关系，并增强具有区分度的不对称模式的表示。在ODELIA数据集上，分布内测试集的Macro AUC、Micro AUC和二次加权kappa分别为84.11±2.33、90.64±1.61和60.94±5.64；保留机构测试集上分别为68.51±4.54、80.74±2.68和43.45±7.10，在主要评估指标上均优于所评估的基线方法。PRISM-Net在独立机构和背景复杂性评估中进一步展示了其性能。消融实验表明，双侧关系建模和不对称感知重加权均有助于提高分类性能。这些发现强调了患者特定的双侧参考建模作为DCE-MRI解释的一种具有临床依据的策略，通过对背景复杂性的显式建模，改善了不对称模式的区分能力。
AI.summary: 针对乳腺DCE-MRI分类中背景变异性带来的干扰问题，本文提出了PRISM-Net框架。该框架无需复杂的图像配准，通过将对侧乳腺作为患者自体的特征参考，结合双侧特征匹配与不对称感知注意力机制，有效地建模了双乳自适应对应关系并增强了不对称病变特征。实验表明，该方法在乳腺无病灶、良性和恶性三分类任务中表现优异，并在跨机构泛化测试中展现出良好效果。
AI.keywords: DCE-MRI, 乳腺三分类 (Breast classification), 双侧特征匹配 (Bilateral feature matching), 患者特异性参考 (Patient-specific reference), 不对称感知注意力 (Asymmetry-aware attention)
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于巧妙地利用对侧乳腺作为患者自体的背景参照，提出了无需图像配准的双侧特征匹配与不对称感知注意力机制，这与临床放射科医生通过双侧对比来排除背景干扰的诊断习惯高度吻合。方法在多中心数据和跨机构验证中取得了较好的泛化性能，具有较高的临床实用价值。

title: FedTopo: Relation-Level Topology Sharing for Model-Heterogeneous Federated Learning
comments: 13 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to ICDE 2027 (first submission round)
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative learning over decentralized data silos without centralizing raw data. However, heterogeneous local architectures often induce non-aligned representation spaces, making it difficult to transfer global knowledge across silos. Existing paradigms share this knowledge as model parameters, distilled predictions, or class prototypes, yet all encode it in an absolute space that must be aligned across clients. Heterogeneous backbones break this alignment, so the shared knowledge becomes unreliable and misleads local training. We propose FedTopo, a relation-level framework that encodes global knowledge as class relation topology, capturing how classes relate within each client rather than where they lie in feature space. Each client builds its relation topology from local prototypes and uploads it with class statistics. The server then aggregates these relations in a reliability-aware manner that down-weights weakly supported ones, and broadcasts the global topology to clients. The global topology guides local training by emphasizing topology-similar negative classes. Experiments on three datasets under eight heterogeneous backbones show that FedTopo consistently outperforms parameter-, distillation-, and prototype-sharing baselines, with low communication and no inference overhead. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zhaoyang-Ma/FedTopo.
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to ICDE 2027 (first submission round)

AI.title_translation: FedTopo：面向模型异构联邦学习的关系级拓扑共享
AI.tldr: FedTopo通过在联邦学习中共享类间关系拓扑而非模型参数，解决了模型异构带来的表征空间不对齐问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦学习方法多在绝对空间中共享模型参数、蒸馏预测或类原型，而异构的网络架构会导致非对齐的表征空间，使得共享知识变得不可靠并误导本地训练。
AI.method: 提出FedTopo框架，每个客户端根据本地原型构建类关系拓扑并上传类统计信息；服务器进行可靠性感知聚合后广播全局拓扑；全局拓扑通过强调相似负类来指导本地训练。
AI.result: 在三个数据集和八种异构骨干网络上的实验表明，FedTopo在保持较低通信开销和零推理开销的同时，持续优于参数、蒸馏和原型共享的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FedTopo通过关系级拓扑共享，有效解决了模型异构联邦学习中的表征不对齐问题，在多个数据集和异构骨干网络上展现出优越性能。
AI.translation: 联邦学习（FL）能够在不集中原始数据的情况下，实现对分散数据孤岛的协同学习。然而，异构的本地架构往往会诱导非对齐的表征空间，使得全局知识难以在各个孤岛之间进行迁移。现有的范式将这些知识共享为模型参数、蒸馏预测或类原型，但它们都将其编码在必须跨客户端对齐的绝对空间中。异构的骨干网络破坏了这种对齐，导致共享知识变得不可靠并误导本地训练。我们提出了FedTopo，这是一个关系级框架，它将全局知识编码为类关系拓扑，捕捉各个客户端内部类之间的关系，而不是它们在特征空间中的位置。每个客户端从本地原型构建其关系拓扑，并将其与类统计信息一起上传。随后，服务器以可靠性感知的方式聚合这些关系，降低弱支持关系的权重，并将全局拓扑广播给客户端。全局拓扑通过强调拓扑相似的负类来指导本地训练。在三个数据集和八种异构骨干网络上的实验表明，FedTopo在低通信开销且无推理开销的情况下，持续优于参数共享、蒸馏共享和原型共享基线。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Zhaoyang-Ma/FedTopo 获取。
AI.summary: FedTopo是一种用于模型异构联邦学习的关系级拓扑共享框架。它通过构建和聚合类关系拓扑来替代绝对特征空间的对齐，从而在异构客户端之间安全有效地传递全局知识，并指导本地模型训练。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 模型异构, 拓扑共享, 类间关系
AI.comments: 该论文提出了FedTopo，通过关系级别的拓扑共享解决模型异构联邦学习中的表征空间不对齐问题。创新点在于不依赖绝对特征空间的对齐，而是通过共享类间关系拓扑来传递全局知识，方法巧妙且无推理开销。

title: Risk-Aware Motion Planning with Learned Trajectory Primitives and Probabilistic Safety Assessment
comments: 8 pages, submitted to IEEE ITSC 2026, Naples, Italy
summary: This paper presents a radial basis function network (RBFN)-informed motion planning framework for safe and efficient urban autonomous driving. The proposed approach combines RBFN-based candidate trajectory generation with an analytic collision probability assessment and optimization-based trajectory refinement. The network learns jerk-minimal trajectories, enabling the MPC to operate within a reduced and dynamically consistent search space. Candidate motion primitives are selected based on an accurate probabilistic risk measure. This design decreases solver complexity while preserving safety and constraint satisfaction. The framework is evaluated in numerous urban driving scenarios. Results demonstrate improved risk awareness and fewer vehicle-limit violations compared to benchmark methods. The proposed approach integrates learning-based trajectories into optimization-based motion planning, thereby ensuring safety and interpretability.
comment: 8 pages, submitted to IEEE ITSC 2026, Naples, Italy

title: MRCoder: An Efficient Context Selecting Approach for Repository-Level Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation. However, repository-level code generation remains challenging, as it requires effectively identifying and utilizing repository-specific context. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) incorporates relevant code snippets, it often introduces redundant context that interferes with the LLM's ability to utilize relevant information, leading to degraded generation quality and increased computational cost. Moreover, existing context selection and compression methods struggle to balance efficiency and quality, either introducing additional computational overhead or failing to effectively select valid context. In this paper, we propose MRCoder, an efficient context selection framework that improves both the effectiveness and efficiency of repository-level code generation. MRCoder adopts a Map-Reduce paradigm: in the Map Phase, a lightweight draft model generates drafts over partitioned contexts, and Structure-Aware Draft-Guided Selection (SADGS) selects informative contexts based on drafts through API consistency and logical similarity; in the Reduce Phase, the refined contexts are aggregated for final generation, with a parallel verification strategy further accelerating decoding. We evaluate MRCoder on two widely used repository-level code generation benchmarks, CoderEval and DevEval, using Qwen2.5-Coder and DeepSeek-Coder as backbone LLMs. Experimental results show that MRCoder improves code generation accuracy over strong baselines while reducing token consumption by 30 to 50% and inference time by up to 52%. These results demonstrate that our proposed structured and draft-guided context selection strategy is crucial for improving both the quality and efficiency of repository-level code generation

title: Route by Kinematics, Act by Observation: Kinematics-Supervised Expert Routing in MoE-Augmented VLA
summary: While MoE augments VLA via expert specialization, router suffers from ineffective expert routing owing to the kinematic heterogeneity of actions across manipulation tasks and, even worse, the unavailability of the kinematic signals at inference time. In this work, we first observe that most semantically distinct manipulation tasks reduce to multiple kinematic archetypes. Motivated by this finding, we propose Kinematics-supervised explicit routing (KinRT), a new paradigm that shifts from implicit, observation-driven expert routing to explicit, kinematics-guided expert dispatching. Specifically, we perform kinematic clustering on action trajectories into multiple kinematically coherent groups, whose IDs serve as ground truth to supervise the training of the router; at inference time, the router dispatches experts only using visual-language observations, without any reliance on action kinematics. KinRT actually introduces an asymmetric bridging mechanism that distills the task kinematics from the action space in training into the observation space at inference. In addition, to assess KinRT's cross-platform generalization, we build an economical, Do-It-Yourself robot (DIYRobot) platform from scratch using 3D-print technology ($<$ 2,000USD). Extensive experiments demonstrate KinRT's superiority over both dense and MoE-featured VLAs by more than 23.26% on RoboTwin benchmark and 20.27% on our introduced DIYRobot platform. Our code and DIYRobot platform will be open-sourced.

title: Practice Makes Policies: Bootstrapping and Consolidating Robotic Capabilities from Zero Human Demonstrations
summary: General-purpose robotic manipulation requires robots to perform diverse tasks in open-world environments while improving their skills over time. Despite recent progress in robotic manipulation, existing systems still primarily acquire manipulation skills in a static manner, where capabilities are learned for specific tasks or settings rather than adaptively evolving through physical interaction. Resembling how repeated practice enables humans to develop muscle memory, advanced manipulation proficiency requires an autonomous capability evolution mechanism that allows robots to progressively transform interaction experiences into increasingly effective manipulation abilities. To this end, we propose HERO, a self-improving hierarchical embodied agent that enables autonomous capability evolution from zero human demonstrations. HERO organizes heuristic reasoning, exemplar reuse, and reflexive execution into a unified orchestration framework, allowing robots to autonomously bootstrap manipulation experience, rapidly accumulate reusable behaviors through experience transfer, and progressively consolidate recurring interactions into efficient closed-loop visuomotor policies. By tightly coupling autonomous data collection with task execution, HERO continuously expands and dynamically schedules manipulation capabilities according to different stages of experience accumulation and execution requirements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HERO substantially reduces human intervention during robotic data collection while achieving robust manipulation across diverse tasks, providing a promising path toward self-improving robotic systems.

title: DistillAlign: Coordinating Mode Covering and Mode Seeking in Autoregressive Video Distillation
summary: Existing autoregressive video distillation methods commonly adopt a Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD)-based multi-stage pipeline. However, they typically decouple the initialization and DMD stages -- which then pursue different target distributions -- and judge the intermediate student mainly by visual scores such as VBench. In this paper, we revisit this design from a distributional perspective. Given the mode-seeking nature of the distribution matching loss, a good initialization should match the mode coverage of the target DMD teacher, rather than merely pursuing high quality. To analyze this, we introduce a distributional evaluation protocol that measures precision and coverage between student and teacher distributions in a shared latent space. It exposes differences hidden by visual scores: some initializations reach high precision but low coverage, leading to suboptimal refinement, while mode-covering ones preserve broader support. Furthermore, even when the target distributions are aligned, DMD's reverse-KL objective can still drive the student toward high-probability teacher regions in late training, reducing coverage and diversity. To address this, we propose joint distillation, which combines DMD's mode-seeking objective with a Consistency Distillation-based mode-covering constraint. Experiments show that our method improves generation quality, coverage, and diversity; notably, even with a Wan-1.3B DMD teacher, it outperforms baselines refined with Wan-14B, underscoring the importance of distributional alignment in autoregressive video distillation.

title: From Uncertainty to Determinism: Coarse-to-Fine Visual Floorplan Localization without Ray Matching
summary: Visual Floorplan Localization (FLoc) has emerged as a promising solution for indoor localization by matching egocentric images against minimalist structural maps. However, due to cross-modal information asymmetry and repetitive indoor layouts, visual FLoc is fundamentally challenged by multimodal pose distributions, where visually identical observations map to distinct, spatially separated locations. Existing ray-matching-based methods tackle this by explicitly predicting sparse geometric or semantic rays, which inherently incur information loss and demand resource-intensive preprocessing alongside exhaustive matching during inference. In this paper, we bypass the intermediate ray-matching paradigm and propose a coarse-to-fine visual FLoc framework that progresses from uncertainty to determinism. In the coarse stage, we design an image-conditioned pose diffusion model to parameterize the continuous multimodal pose distribution, effectively routing stochastically initialized pose particles toward distinct candidate modes. In the refinement stage, we propose a localized refiner that predicts bounded sub-meter pose residuals from candidate-centered floorplan crops, where structural ambiguities are largely eliminated. Our method effectively balances global multi-hypothesis tracking and local sub-meter refinement without requiring any offline map preprocessing or test-time lookup tables. Comprehensive results on the S3D (full) and ZInD benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and robustness.

title: Ripple: Real-Time Streaming Audio-Video Generation With Cross-Modal Recurrent Memory
summary: Audio-video generative models achieve impressive quality but suffer from high latency, making them unsuitable for real-time applications. Although several streaming audio-video generation methods have been proposed, they remain costly and fail to support long-form generation. To address this, we propose \textbf{Ripple}, a real-time joint audio-video generation system with a cross-modal recurrent memory mechanism. To enable efficient streaming inference while preserving long-term context, Ripple combines a fixed-length sliding-window attention with modality-specific memory states that continuously summarize audio and video context. Cross-modal memory interaction is further introduced to enhance audio-visual synchronization. To learn this memory-augmented model effectively, we devise a three-stage training recipe: (1) adapting a bidirectional audio-video teacher to block-wise causal attention with simulated memory, (2) optimizing the memory construction and interaction pipeline through end-to-end distillation, and (3) applying online reinforcement post-training tailored for streaming audio-video generation. As a result, Ripple achieves ~28 FPS at 480P resolution, over faster than the teacher, while capable of coherent long-form generation. Extensive experiments on both short-video and long-video benchmarks demonstrate our superior performance over existing offline and online joint audio-video generation methods.

title: A First Look at Coding Agents' Compliance with AI Contribution Rules in Open-Source Communities
summary: Open source communities have been flooded with AI-generated contributions. In defense, they have written contribution rules to regulate coding agents' behavior, spanning from a total ban, mandatory disclosure, to verification gates and human sign-offs. Yet, whether coding agents read and follow those rules, and behave in open source repositories, remains unknown. To estimate real-world rule compliance of coding agents, we curate 106 issues from 49 repositories containing AI contribution rules into RepoComplianceBench. We judge the trajectory of each run against the repository's rules, measuring whether the agent refuses to contribute, discloses its assistance truthfully, clears the required verification gates, or escalates critical steps to a human. We also test if extra prompts, rule disclosure, or feedback from the compliance verifier help with the situation. Our experiments on four frontier models show that today's agents almost never proactively retrieve the contribution rules. Agents pick up disclosure and verification with reminder prompts, rule quotes, and verifier feedback; however, they never refuse to contribute in AI-banned repositories under any condition we tested. The status reveals that verification and disclosure issues are solvable with existing mechanisms, yet enforcing bans and human escalations remains an open problem.

title: Forecasting Trajectory-Level Safety Risks in Black-Box Multi-Turn Interactions
summary: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from standalone assistants into autonomous agents, ensuring their safety requires shifting beyond pointwise risk assessment to understand how risks emerge and unfold over long-horizon trajectories. In multi-turn interactions, malicious intent can be decomposed across seemingly harmless turns and gradually reconstructed through interaction trajectories, eventually resulting in safety failures. Existing safeguards remain largely reactive, detecting manifested violations while lacking the ability to predict latent risk evolution and enable preemptive prevention. To address this limitation, we propose Recast, a safety risk forecasting framework that advances LLM safeguarding beyond turn-level violation detection to trajectory-level risk prediction. Recast first retrieves risk-relevant evidence from both short-term dialogue progression and long-term historical context via a dual-scale trajectory view. It then models compositional risk evolution by capturing the current risk configuration and its temporal dynamics. Finally, a causal temporal encoder learns latent risk evolution patterns and predicts the distribution of future risk emergence turns. Extensive experiments across 7 risk categories show that Recast predicts 88.3% of future safety failures with an average lead time of 2.41 turns, while maintaining a false alarm rate of 12.3%, showcasing the effectiveness of trajectory-level forecasting in identifying emerging risks before safety violations occur.

title: Mind the Gap: The Disconnect Between Synthetic and Natural Edge Weights in Parallel Single-Source Shortest Path
summary: Scientific research works often evaluate Parallel Single-Source Shortest Path (SSSP) algorithms using synthetic, uniformly distributed edge weights. However, real-world graphs exhibit very different, often heavy-tailed, weight distributions. This creates a disconnect between how algorithms are evaluated and their real-world performance, since most SSSP implementations inherently rely on the weight distribution for parameter tuning and work efficiency. In this paper, we explore whether current benchmarking methods unintentionally bias the performance results of these algorithms. To this end, we statistically characterize the weight distributions of 17 real-world graphs from a variety of domains and contrast them with six synthetic distributions used in the literature. Through a comprehensive evaluation of seven state-of-the-art parallel SSSP algorithms, we demonstrate severe sensitivity to edge weights, and show that evaluating with synthetic uniform weights alters optimal parameter configurations and can invert the performance hierarchy. These findings challenge existing benchmarking standards and offer practical insights for rigorous SSSP algorithm design.

AI.title_translation: 注意差距：并行单源最短路径中合成边权与自然边权的脱节
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了并行单源最短路径（SSSP）评估中使用合成均匀边权与真实重尾边权的脱节，指出合成边权评估会误导算法最佳参数配置甚至倒置算法性能排名。
AI.motivation: 现有并行单源最短路径（SSSP）算法大多使用合成的均匀分布边权进行评估，而真实世界图往往呈现重尾等截然不同的权重分布。这种评估方法与实际场景之间的脱节会导致参数调优偏差及算法效率评估失真。
AI.method: 统计刻画了来自多个领域的17个真实世界图的边权分布，并将其与文献中使用的6种合成分布进行对比分析；同时对7种最先进的并行SSSP算法进行了全面且系统的对比评估。
AI.result: 研究表明SSSP算法对边权极度敏感。使用合成均匀边权进行评估不仅会改变算法的最佳参数配置，甚至可能颠倒算法之间的性能排名。
AI.conclusion: 现有基于合成均匀边权的SSSP算法评估标准存在严重缺陷，未来的并行SSSP算法设计与评估需要更加重视真实世界图中复杂的边权分布特征。
AI.translation: 科学研究工作通常使用合成的、均匀分布的边权来评估并行单源最短路径（SSSP）算法。然而，现实世界的图展现出非常不同且通常是重尾的权重分布。这导致算法评估方式与其现实性能之间存在脱节，因为大多数 SSSP 实现固有地依赖权重分布来进行参数调优和工作效率优化。在本文中，我们探讨了当前的基准测试方法是否无意中偏向了这些算法的性能结果。为此，我们统计刻画了来自各个领域的 17 个真实世界图的权重分布，并将它们与文献中使用的 6 种合成分布进行了对比。通过对 7 种最先进的并行 SSSP 算法进行全面评估，我们展示了算法对边权的严重敏感性，并证明使用合成均匀权重进行评估会改变最佳参数配置，甚至可能颠倒性能层级。这些发现挑战了现有的基准测试标准，并为严格的 SSSP 算法设计提供了实用的见解。
AI.summary: 本文揭示了并行单源最短路径（SSSP）算法评估中合成边权与真实边权分布之间的严重脱节问题。通过对17个真实图与6种合成分布的统计对比，以及对7种主流并行SSSP算法的评估，研究发现传统的使用合成均匀边权评估的方式会产生误导性的性能结论并颠倒算法优劣顺序，从而对现有图算法基准测试标准提出了挑战。
AI.keywords: 并行单源最短路径, 边权分布, 性能评估脱节, 基准测试, 图计算
AI.comments:
该论文具有很强的实用意义和批判性思考：
1. 创新性：首次揭示了并行SSSP算法在评估时过度依赖“合成均匀边权”所导致的基准测试偏差问题，指出了实验室性能与真实场景性能脱节的根源。
2. 重要性：挑战了图计算领域的传统基准测试惯例，证明了评估数据集的选择会颠倒算法优劣甚至改变最优参数配置，对后续并行图算法的设计与评估标准制定提供了极具价值的实践指导。
3. 局限性：主要聚焦于SSSP算法与边权分布的关系，对于图的拓扑结构（如度分布）与边权分布的复合影响探讨可能尚需进一步拓展。

title: Self-dual double cyclic codes over $\mathbb{F}_q$
summary: This article focuses specifically on the study of self-dual double cyclic codes over a finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$. A self-dual double cyclic code is a double cyclic code that is equal to its dual. Structurally, a double cyclic code of length $(r,s)$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$ is a $\mathbb{F}_q[x]$-submodule of $\mathbb{F}_{q,r,s}:=\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle x^r-1\rangle\times\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle x^s-1\rangle$. Moreover, any double cyclic code of length $(r,s)$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$ is generated by two pairs of polynomials in $\mathbb{F}_{q,r,s}$. From the properties of the generating elements, we provide the necessary and sufficient conditions such that two pairs of polynomials in $\mathbb{F}_{q,r,s}$ generate a self-dual code. Furthermore, we examine the existence of self-dual double cyclic codes for some specific lengths: $(r,r)$; $(r,2r)$ and $(2r,r)$; and $(r,s)$, where $\gcd(r,s)=1$. For each case, we provide a construction method with some explicit examples over various finite fields. We also observe some connections between self-dual double cyclic codes and other classes of self-dual codes.

AI.title_translation: 有限域 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上的自对偶双循环码
AI.tldr: 本文提出了有限域上自对偶双循环码生成的充要条件，并给出了特定长度下的显式构造方法与示例。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索有限域 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上自对偶双循环码的结构特性、存在条件以及具体构造方法。
AI.method: 基于双循环码作为模 $\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle x^r-1\rangle\times\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle x^s-1\rangle$ 的子模结构，分析生成多项式对的性质，推导出自对偶性的充要条件，并在不同长度限制下进行显式构造。
AI.result: 推导出两对多项式生成自对偶双循环码的充分必要条件，确定了长度为 $(r,r)$、$(r,2r)$、$(2r,r)$ 及 $\gcd(r,s)=1$ 的 $(r,s)$ 情形下的存在性，并提供了显式构造示例与相关码类之间的联系。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了有限域上自对偶双循环码的理论框架，给出了具体的生成充要条件与构造方法，并阐明了其与其他自对偶码类的联系。
AI.translation: 本文专门研究有限域 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上的自对偶双循环码。自对偶双循环码是指与其对偶码相等的双循环码。从结构上看，有限域 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上长度为 $(r,s)$ 的双循环码是 $\mathbb{F}_{q,r,s}:=\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle x^r-1\rangle\times\mathbb{F}_q[x]/\langle x^s-1\rangle$ 的一个 $\mathbb{F}_q[x]$-子模。此外，有限域 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上任意长度为 $(r,s)$ 的双循环码均由 $\mathbb{F}_{q,r,s}$ 中的两对多项式生成。基于生成元的性质，本文给出了 $\mathbb{F}_{q,r,s}$ 中两对多项式生成自对偶码的充分必要条件。此外，本文探讨了在某些特定长度下自对偶双循环码的存在性，包括：$(r,r)$；$(r,2r)$ 与 $(2r,r)$；以及满足 $\gcd(r,s)=1$ 的 $(r,s)$。对于每种情形，本文均提供了构造方法以及在不同有限域上的显式示例，并观察到了自对偶双循环码与其他类自对偶码之间的联系。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有限域 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上的自对偶双循环码，导出了由两对多项式生成自对偶码的充要条件，并针对几种特定长度组合给出了具体的构造方法、显式示例及其与其他自对偶码类的联系。
AI.keywords: 自对偶码, 双循环码, 有限域, 生成元, 编码构造
AI.comments: 本文对有限域上的自对偶双循环码进行了系统深入的研究，给出了其生成的充要条件以及多种特殊长度下的具体构造方法，具有较好的理论创新性和实用价值。局限在于对更任意长度组合下的普遍存在性尚未完全展开探讨。

title: From Found to Designed: Concepts as a Design Axis for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) encode rich concept-like information, but represent it implicitly through distributed statistical associations rather than as explicit, structured, compositional concepts. Consequently, concept-level structure is typically \emph{found} rather than \emph{designed}: it is recovered after training through probing or dictionary learning, with no architectural guarantee of stability, compositionality, controllability, or alignment with human conceptual organization. We argue that concepts should instead be treated as a design axis for LLMs, and map the design space along two dimensions: the pipeline stage at which concept structure is introduced (training objective, core architecture, inference, or post-hoc interpretation), and whether that structure is internally derived from the model's own representations or grounded in external resources. This taxonomy reveals three broad patterns: inference-time approaches remain comparatively underexplored, related ideas have developed largely in isolation across pipeline stages, and externally grounded methods span the entire pipeline despite often being described under different terminology. Together, these observations motivate moving beyond recovering concept-like structure from trained models toward designing LLMs with explicit conceptual representations.

AI.title_translation: 从发现到设计：概念作为大语言模型的设计轴线
AI.tldr: 本文主张将大语言模型中的“概念”从事后挖掘（Found）转变为事前显式设计（Designed），并提出了一个二维分类空间来指导未来可解释、可控的 LLM 开发。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 主要通过分布式的统计关联隐式表示概念，导致概念结构只能在训练后被“发现”而非预先“设计”，缺乏稳定性、可组合性、可控性以及与人类概念组织的明确对齐。
AI.method: 提出了一个二维设计空间分类法（Taxonomy）：1) 引入概念结构的管线阶段（训练目标、核心架构、推理或事后解释）；2) 概念结构是源自模型内部表示还是锚定于外部资源。
AI.result: 通过分类法揭示了三个模式：1) 推理阶段的概念设计方法仍相对缺乏探索；2) 跨管线阶段的相关思想大多孤立发展；3) 外部锚定方法虽贯穿整个管线，但常被不同术语掩盖。
AI.conclusion: 研究呼吁学术界和工业界超越仅在训练后恢复概念结构的传统范式，转向直接设计具备显式、可控且与人类对齐的概念表示的新一代大语言模型。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）编码了丰富的概念类信息，但它是通过分布式统计关联隐式表示的，而非作为显式、结构化和可组合的概念。因此，概念层面的结构通常是被“发现”而非被“设计”的：即在训练后通过探针（probing）或字典学习恢复，在架构上无法保证稳定性、可组合性、可控性或与人类概念组织的对齐。我们主张将概念视为 LLM 的一个设计轴线，并沿着两个维度绘制设计空间：引入概念结构的流水线阶段（训练目标、核心架构、推理或事后解释），以及该结构是从模型自身表示内部衍生还是锚定于外部资源。这一分类法揭示了三个广泛的模式：推理阶段的方法相对缺乏探索；相关思想在不同流水线阶段基本上是孤立发展的；外部锚定方法跨越了整个流水线，尽管它们经常在不同的术语下被描述。总之，这些观察激励我们超越从已训练模型中恢复概念类结构，转向设计具有显式概念表示的 LLM。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了将“概念”作为大语言模型（LLM）核心设计轴线的必要性。作者针对现有模型隐式表达概念且依赖事后提取的局限，构建了一个结合“管线阶段”与“内部/外部来源”的二维分类体系，总结了当前研究模式，并指出了显式概念设计的未来方向。
AI.keywords: Large Language Models, Conceptual Representations, Representation Design, Taxonomy
AI.comments: 本论文提供了一个非常深刻且及时的方法论视角转变，将 LLM 的概念表示研究从“事后被动分析/提取（Post-hoc interpretability）”推向了“主动架构/流程设计（Explicit design）”。提出的二维分类框架逻辑清晰，成功揭示了推理阶段研究不足以及领域术语割裂等现状。局限在于摘要表明该文主要侧重于框架构建与概念梳理，缺乏具体的模型实现或实验定量验证。

title: AI as Friction for Reflection Support in Ideation
comments: In Proceedings of The First Reflection in Creative Experience (RiCE) Workshop (RiCE W1) arXiv:2607.24558
summary: Generative AI tools for creative work tend to be designed around the goal of removing friction, on the assumption that smoother iteration and faster output translate into more value for the designer. We argue, however, that this framing leaves out something important about how design ideation works, namely reflection-in-action. The act of accepting, rejecting and reworking candidate ideas is both a path to a final outcome and the process through which designers develop the rationale that allows them to think with their ideas and to communicate them to others. This becomes particularly important in group ideation, where ideas need to be expressed and explained to others to allow the group to extend, reject or combine them further. We suggest that AI in design ideation might be more usefully thought of as a friction agent for reflection rather than as a smoothing agent for output. This reframing opens up a different role for AI in design ideation, one that supports designers in building and carrying rationale rather than substituting for it.
comment: In Proceedings of The First Reflection in Creative Experience (RiCE) Workshop (RiCE W1) arXiv:2607.24558

AI.title_translation: AI作为构思中反思支持的摩擦力
AI.tldr: 现有AI工具旨在消除摩擦以加速设计迭代，但本文认为AI应作为“摩擦力”来支持设计师的反思和理性构建，而非仅仅加速输出。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI工具在创意工作中侧重于消除摩擦以实现更快的迭代和输出，假设这能为设计师带来更多价值。然而，作者认为这种框架忽略了设计构思中重要的“行动中反思”过程，即设计师通过接受、拒绝和修改想法来发展其思维逻辑和沟通能力。特别是在团队构思中，想法需要被清晰表达和解释。
AI.method: 作者提出将AI在设计构思中的角色重新定义为“反思的摩擦剂”，而非输出的平滑剂。这种重新定义旨在支持设计师建立和承载其想法的内在逻辑和理由，而不是替代它。
AI.result: 重新定义了AI在设计构思中的角色，提出AI可以作为支持设计师构建和承载其想法内在逻辑（rationale）的工具，而不是仅仅用于加速输出。
AI.conclusion: 结论是AI在设计构思中可以扮演一个不同的、更具建设性的角色，即作为“反思的摩擦力”来支持设计师发展和沟通其想法的内在逻辑，从而更好地促进设计过程，尤其是在团队协作中。
AI.translation: 生成式AI工具在创意工作中的设计倾向于围绕消除摩擦的目标，假设更顺畅的迭代和更快的输出能为设计师带来更多价值。然而，我们认为这种框架忽略了设计构思工作方式中的重要一点，即行动中的反思。接受、拒绝和修改候选想法的行为既是达成最终结果的途径，也是设计师发展其推理过程的途径，这种推理使他们能够用自己的想法进行思考并将其传达给他人。这在团队构思中变得尤为重要，因为想法需要向他人表达和解释，以便团队进一步扩展、拒绝或组合它们。我们建议，设计构思中的AI可能更有效地被视为反思的摩擦剂，而不是输出的平滑剂。这种重新定义为AI在设计构思中开辟了一个不同的角色，一个支持设计师建立和承载推理而非替代推理的角色。
AI.summary: 本文挑战了生成式AI在创意工作中通过消除摩擦来加速迭代的普遍设计理念。作者强调，设计构思中的“行动中反思”对于设计师建立想法的内在逻辑和有效沟通至关重要。因此，论文建议将AI重新定位为“反思的摩擦剂”，以支持设计师在构思过程中构建和维护其想法的理由和逻辑，而非仅仅作为提高输出效率的工具。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI, 设计构思, 反思, 摩擦力, 创造力支持
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个创新性的视角，挑战了AI在创意领域中常见的“效率优先”范式。它强调了设计过程中“反思”和“理由构建”的内在价值，并为AI在支持人类创造力方面开辟了新的可能性，即通过引入“有益的摩擦”来深化设计师的思考。这对于AI辅助设计工具的未来发展具有重要指导意义。

title: Budget-Aware LLM Discovery via Cost-Calibrated Frontier Utility
summary: Large language models increasingly support scientific and algorithmic discovery through inference-time search over evaluated candidates. Existing adaptive discovery controllers assign credit based only on score progress, even though prompt length, retries, and guidance calls cause search actions to incur different token costs. We prove that cost-blind credit can forfeit all but a vanishing fraction of attainable quality as frontiers multiply and costs diverge. Under a fixed search-side token budget, the controller must decide which frontier is improving and whether its gain justifies the realized cost before the budget is exhausted. We introduce \textbf{CostAda}, a cost-calibrated adaptive controller built around \emph{cost-calibrated frontier utility}. The utility values frontier progress relative to realized action cost and conditions that credit on the remaining budget. CostAda uses this signal to control local exploration intensity, frontier allocation, and budgeted tactic intervention. Cost and remaining budget therefore shape the search rather than serving only as accounting variables or a stopping rule. CostAda reaches the strongest baseline's full-budget quality with at most half the budget on twelve of sixteen benchmark--backbone pairs while achieving the strongest mean final quality on all eight benchmarks under GLM-5 and GPT-5.4.

AI.title_translation: 基于成本校准前沿效用的预算感知大语言模型发现
AI.tldr: CostAda 通过将 Token 消耗成本和剩余预算引入控制信号，以不超过一半的预算达到了传统最强基线在全额预算下的发现质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 发现控制器仅根据分数进展分配信用，忽略了提示词长度、重试和指导调用导致的 Token 成本差异。在固定预算下，这种无视成本的机制会导致大量可达到的质量损失。
AI.method: 提出了 CostAda 自适应控制器，其核心是“成本校准前沿效用”。该方法将前沿进展与已消耗的动作成本进行对比，并根据剩余预算调节信用分配，从而动态控制局部探索强度、前沿分配及策略干预。
AI.result: 在 16 个基准-骨干模型对中的 12 个上，CostAda 仅使用不超过一半的预算就达到了最强基线在全额预算下的质量，并在 GLM-5 和 GPT-5.4 模型下的全部 8 个基准中取得了最高的平均最终质量。
AI.conclusion: 将动作成本与剩余预算直接作为搜索控制的关键信号，能够大幅提升 LLM 引导的科学与算法发现的效率和最终质量。
AI.translation: 大语言模型越来越多地通过对已评估候选对象进行推理阶段搜索来支持科学和算法发现。现有的自适应发现控制器仅根据分数进展进行信用分配，即使提示词长度、重试和指导调用会导致搜索动作产生不同的 Token 成本。我们证明，随着前沿激增和成本分化，无视成本的信用分配可能会放弃绝大部分可达到的质量。在固定的搜索端 Token 预算下，控制器必须在预算耗尽之前决定哪个前沿正在改善，以及其收益是否值得已付出的成本。我们引入了 CostAda，一种围绕“成本校准前沿效用”构建的成本校准自适应控制器。该效用根据已实现的动作成本来衡量前沿进展，并根据剩余预算调节信用。CostAda 利用该信号来控制局部探索强度、前沿分配和有预算的策略干预。因此，成本和剩余预算塑造了搜索过程，而不仅仅作为记账变量或停止规则。CostAda 在 16 个基准-骨干模型对中的 12 个上仅用至多一半的预算即可达到最强基线的全额预算质量，同时在 GLM-5 和 GPT-5.4 下的全部 8 个基准测试中取得了最强的平均最终质量。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于 LLM 的科学与算法发现问题，提出了预算感知的自适应控制器 CostAda。针对传统搜索控制器忽视 Token 消耗成本的问题，CostAda 引入成本校准的前沿效用，将成本和剩余预算作为调控搜索强度、分配前沿与策略干预的核心信号，成功以显著更低的 Token 消耗获得了优于最强基线的发现质量。
AI.keywords: Large Language Models, Scientific Discovery, Adaptive Controller, Token Budget, Frontier Utility
AI.comments:
创新性：本文打破了仅依据分数进展分配信用的传统视角，首次将 Token 消耗成本与剩余预算直接引入到自适应搜索控制中。
重要性：在 LLM 推理成本高昂的背景下，实现“预算感知”的探索控制对于提高 LLM 在科学发现与算法优化中的实际投入产出比具有重要意义。
局限性：摘要中未详细说明前沿效用的具体数学形式，以及对于非均匀分布成本任务的泛化能力。

title: BATS: Resource-Efficient Volumetric Segmentation with Boundary-Aware Mixed-Resolution Tokens
summary:
Many high-performing volumetric segmentation models maintain dense multi-scale feature maps, leading to high activation memory and inference cost. We present BATS (Boundary-Aware Token Selection), a 3D medical image segmentation architecture that concentrates fine-resolution processing near predicted class boundaries. A dense boundary predictor identifies where additional resolution is needed, while a fine-first context cascade constructs an input-dependent mixed-resolution hierarchy. Homogeneous regions are represented coarsely, with finer tokens retained around boundaries, thin structures, and small targets. The sparse hierarchy is refined and rasterised into a dense segmentation.
  BATS predicts boundary relevance independently at every resolution level, preventing an erroneous coarse-scale decision from suppressing fine-scale evidence. Parent cluster attention further injects hierarchical ancestor tokens into local attention neighbourhoods, providing cross-scale context without dense multi-scale feature maps or cross-scale neighbour search.
  We evaluate BATS on five public CT and MRI datasets using the standardised nnU-Net Revisited protocol. BATS achieves the highest LiTS Dice among the compared methods and averages within 0.37 Dice points of the strongest dense baseline, MedNeXt-L, across the five datasets. Relative to MedNeXt-L, it reduces peak allocated GPU memory by more than 53% on KiTS, LiTS, and BraTS. Inference is up to 30% faster on KiTS and LiTS, which retain fewer tokens, but slower on the more token-dense BraTS. Mixed-resolution processing therefore provides consistent memory savings, while runtime and accuracy gains depend on dataset boundary density.

AI.title_translation: BATS：基于边界感知混合分辨率Token的资源高效体素分割
AI.tldr: BATS是一种用于3D医学图像分割的架构，通过在预测边界附近集中高分辨率处理，显著降低了内存消耗并提高了推理速度，同时保持了与最先进模型的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 许多高性能体素分割模型需要维护密集的多种尺度特征图，导致高激活内存和推理成本。
AI.method: 提出了BATS (Boundary-Aware Token Selection)，一个3D医学图像分割架构。它通过一个密集的边界预测器识别需要额外分辨率的区域，并构建一个输入依赖的混合分辨率层次结构。均匀区域用粗略表示，而边界、细小结构和小型目标周围保留更精细的token。稀疏层次结构被细化并栅格化为密集分割。BATS在每个分辨率级别独立预测边界相关性，并使用父簇注意力将分层祖先token注入局部注意力邻域，提供跨尺度上下文。
AI.result: BATS在五个公共CT和MRI数据集上进行了评估。它在LiTS Dice上取得了最高分，并在所有五个数据集上与最强的密集基线MedNeXt-L的平均Dice分数相差0.37。相对于MedNeXt-L，它在KiTS、LiTS和BraTS上将峰值GPU内存减少了53%以上。在KiTS和LiTS上推理速度提高了30%，但在BraTS上较慢。混合分辨率处理提供了一致的内存节省，而运行时和精度增益取决于数据集的边界密度。
AI.conclusion: BATS在保持竞争性分割性能的同时，显著降低了3D医学图像分割的资源消耗，尤其是在内存方面，其运行时和精度提升则取决于数据集的边界密度。
AI.translation: 许多高性能的体素分割模型维护着密集的多种尺度特征图，导致高激活内存和推理成本。我们提出了BATS（边界感知Token选择），一个3D医学图像分割架构，它将精细分辨率处理集中在预测的类别边界附近。一个密集的边界预测器识别需要额外分辨率的地方，而一个精细优先的上下文级联构建了一个输入依赖的混合分辨率层次结构。均匀区域用粗略表示，而边界、细小结构和小型目标周围保留更精细的token。稀疏层次结构被细化并栅格化为密集分割。BATS在每个分辨率级别独立预测边界相关性，防止错误的粗尺度决策抑制精细尺度证据。父簇注意力进一步将分层祖先token注入局部注意力邻域，在没有密集多尺度特征图或跨尺度邻居搜索的情况下提供跨尺度上下文。我们在五个公共CT和MRI数据集上使用标准化的nnU-Net Revisited协议评估了BATS。BATS在所比较的方法中取得了最高的LiTS Dice分数，并且在五个数据集上与最强的密集基线MedNeXt-L的平均Dice分数相差在0.37以内。相对于MedNeXt-L，它在KiTS、LiTS和BraTS上将峰值分配的GPU内存减少了53%以上。在保留较少token的KiTS和LiTS上，推理速度提高了30%，但在token更密集的BraTS上较慢。因此，混合分辨率处理提供了一致的内存节省，而运行时和精度增益取决于数据集的边界密度。
AI.summary: BATS是一种用于3D医学图像分割的新型架构，旨在解决现有模型高内存和推理成本的问题。它通过引入边界感知Token选择机制，仅在预测的类别边界、薄结构和小型目标附近进行高分辨率处理，从而构建一个输入依赖的混合分辨率层次结构。实验结果表明，BATS在保持与最先进模型相当的分割性能的同时，显著降低了GPU内存消耗（超过53%），并在某些数据集上提升了推理速度，证明了其资源效率和有效性。
AI.keywords: 3D医学图像分割, 边界感知, 混合分辨率, 资源效率, Token选择
AI.comments: BATS的创新点在于其边界感知混合分辨率处理策略，这有效地解决了3D医学图像分割中资源消耗过大的问题。通过智能地分配计算资源，它在效率和性能之间取得了良好的平衡。这种方法对于处理大型3D医学数据集尤其重要，因为它能显著降低硬件需求。未来的工作可以探索如何进一步优化在边界密度高的数据集上的推理速度。

title: Galerkin Approximation of the Fractional Hardy Constant
summary: We establish sharp estimates for the discrete optimal constant of the fractional Hardy Inequality in dimension $N\geq 1$, with fractional exponent $s\in \left(0,\min\left\{1,\frac{N}{2}\right\}\right)$. The convergence rates that we establish take place for the Galerkin approximation with piecewise linear elements, when the computations are carried out in a bounded, convex and smooth domain containing the origin, for which we employ a quasi-uniform and regular mesh.

title: Language Models are not Equally Robust to Non-Canonical Tokenization across Languages
summary: Despite the existence of exponentially many valid tokenizations for a given string, language models operate on a single canonical sequence deterministically produced by the tokenizer, leaving the broader tokenization space largely uncharacterized. In this paper, we investigate this overlooked space by studying the behavior of language models under non-canonical tokenizations across diverse languages. For English, prior work shows that models are largely invariant to alternative tokenizations that represent the same underlying string. We ask whether this invariance generalizes to other languages beyond English. We conduct a multilingual study across 27 languages spanning diverse scripts and evaluate LLM behavior under alternative tokenizations across six downstream tasks. We find that tokenization invariance does not generalize: model behavior varies substantially across languages with instruction-tuned models exhibiting an average relative performance drop of 23.7% for Llama-3.1-8B, 11.4% for Qwen3-8B, and 9.9% for Gemma-3-12B. The variation of tokenization invariance is systematic across languages. Languages that exhibit higher token fragmentation show significantly greater sensitivity to non-canonical tokenizations. Our study of tokenization robustness serves as a diagnostic of how tightly a model is coupled to its tokenizer. These results demonstrate that tokenization robustness is not a universal property of language models, but depends strongly on the language and its interaction with the tokenizer. We also show that LoRA fine-tuning with multi-tokenization training data provides an effective mitigation for tokenization sensitivity. Fine-tuning on English alone improves tokenization robustness across languages, while systematically sampling diverse non-canonical tokenizations achieves the strongest overall performance.

title: Kairos: Numerically Robust News Recommendation under Item Cold-Start via Cholesky-based LinUCB
comments: English preprint. The German version was peer-reviewed and accepted at SKILL 2026 (Gesellschaft für Informatik)
summary: Algorithmic news personalization in regional markets often fails because modern deep learning models require massive interaction data while real-world news has a short Time-to-Live (TTL < 48 h) and shallow article pools. This structural item cold-start deprives collaborative filtering of the data needed for robust modeling. This paper presents Project Kairos, a framework that bridges this data scarcity through a contextual online learning approach (LinUCB). To ensure numerical integrity for continuous operation, Kairos replaces error-prone Sherman-Morrison inversions with direct rank-1 updates of Cholesky factors. This preserves the positive definiteness of the covariance matrix even under ill-conditioned data scenarios. Simultaneously, Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) integration addresses inference latency. Empirical evaluations based on the Tagesschau API demonstrate that exploiting semantic redundancy in the feature space achieves a 4.85-fold efficiency gain without significantly compromising ranking precision. Kairos thus provides a blueprint for high-performance recommendation systems in resource- and data-constrained environments.
comment: English preprint. The German version was peer-reviewed and accepted at SKILL 2026 (Gesellschaft für Informatik)

title: A Scalable AI-Powered System for Explainable Machine Learning Pipelines in Brain Tumor
summary: Artificial intelligence and radiomics are increasingly used in brain tumor research, yet their translation into clinical practice remains limited by fragmented workflows, poor transparency, and weak integration with end users' needs. We present the first version of a scalable web-based visual analytics system designed to support radiomics-driven machine learning inference in neuro-oncology. The platform integrates three core functions within a single interface: cohort management from structured clinical tables, radiomic feature extraction from medical images and segmentation masks, and guarded inference with pre-trained machine learning models. The system was developed through an iterative user-centred design process and evaluated on both a public glioblastoma dataset and a proprietary clinical cohort. A key contribution is the explicit exposure of intermediate workflow artifacts, which improves traceability, interpretability, and responsible use of AI. By combining portability, inspectability, and deployment simplicity, the proposed framework offers a practical foundation for clinically oriented AI applications in brain tumor analysis.

title: A Low-Power Sparse Convolution Accelerator with Idle-First-Task-Assignment for Edge Vision
comments: 5 pages, 5 figures, Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS 2026)
summary: In recent years, edge-vision monitoring systems for applications such as smart animal husbandry have faced strict tripartite constraints: maintaining input resolution under extremely limited transmission bandwidth and strict power budgets. Conventional dense convolutional neural networks (CNNs) cannot satisfy the resource limits of such constrained IoT nodes. To address this challenge, this paper presents a low-power sparse convolution accelerator for edge devices, fabricated and validated in a 16 nm process. First, the accelerator adopts a bitmap-based format for compression in both data transmission and computation, effectively reducing memory and bandwidth overhead. Second, to mitigate load imbalance in sparse computation, an Idle-First-Task-Assignment (IFTA) dynamic scheduling strategy is proposed, significantly reducing processing-element (PE) idle time and improving multiplier utilization. In addition, a dedicated dataflow is designed to support and accelerate depthwise separable convolution (DWConv), which is widely used in lightweight networks. Experimental results show that the chip occupies only 0.5~mm$^2$ core area and consumes as little as 12--16~mW. On ImageNet, for sparse VGG16 and MobileNetV2, the proposed accelerator achieves 6.5$\times$ and 2.8$\times$ speedups, respectively, over traditional dense accelerators, and also delivers significant performance gains over the existing sparse accelerator.
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS 2026)

title: Before Agents Speak: Pre-hoc Failure Risk Inference in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have exhibited remarkable capabilities in collaborative reasoning and decision-making, yet their interconnected communications introduce new systemic risk: localized hallucinations can propagate along agent communication chain, amplify through interactions, and ultimately trigger cascading failures. Existing countermeasures predominantly follow a post-hoc paradigm, identifying failures only after unsafe behaviors emerge, by which time harmful effects may have already spread throughout the agent network. To tackle this problem, we investigate a complementary pre-hoc approach and propose HalluProp, a Propagation-aware Hallucination inference framework that estimates individual agent failures and emergent system-level hallucination risks before inter-agent interaction. First, we model intrinsic hallucination risks by identifying fine-grained semantic misalignment between agent roles and task queries. We then characterize inter-agent risk propagation by modeling both semantic influence and communication topology. Finally, we integrate these two risks via a differentiable Noisy-OR inference mechanism to derive a systemic diagnosis. Extensive experiments show that HalluProp accurately localizes faulty agents, achieving an average AUROC of 84.6%, while enabling sub-second diagnosis with over $65\times$ speedup over post-hoc methods. By facilitating early intervention through upstream screening, HalluProp effectively complements post-hoc methods, highlighting the potential of pre-hoc risk inference for building more reliable multi-agent systems.

title: Tight Generalization Bound for AdaBoost
summary: In this paper we show that the generalization error of AdaBoost is $Θ\big(\tfrac{d\ln(nγ^{2}/d)}{nγ^2}+\tfrac{\ln(1/δ)}{n}\big)$, where $γ$ is the advantage guaranteed by the weak learner, $d$ is the VC-dimension of the class containing the weak hypotheses, $n$ is the sample size, and $δ$ is the confidence parameter. The contribution of this paper is the upper bound; the matching lower bound follows from prior work. The upper bound proof follows by combining the known fact that AdaBoost outputs a voting classifier whose voting function has zero empirical $γ/2$-margin loss with what is, to the best of our knowledge, a new margin-based generalization bound for voting classifiers.

title: When Knowledge Changes: Metamorphic Testing of RAG Systems with Mutations
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based LLM systems rely on external document corpora that can evolve and change over time. However, current evaluation methodologies (e.g., RAGAS) assess correctness against static snapshots, failing to detect faults when routine updates, factual changes, or noise alter the underlying data. We introduce a metamorphic testing framework that evaluates the consistency of RAG systems under corpus evolution. We formalise a fault taxonomy and 11 mutation operators that systematically perturb the system at both the pre-chunk (retrieval index) and post-chunk (retrieved context) levels. An empirical evaluation across five datasets and over 28k mutants reveals metamorphic violation rates of 4.9-10.2%. In a meta-evaluation against ground truth, our metamorphic oracle achieves F1 scores of 0.927-1.000, while the best RAGAS metric reaches only 0.570. Finally, we provide actionable insights into mitigating these faults through retrieval re-configuration, generator upgrades, and LLM-based reranking.

title: Thinking Under Uncertainty: Evidence Use and Information-Seeking in Language Models
summary: Inference-time thinking improves the performance of large language models, but aggregate outcomes do not reveal whether models use available evidence more effectively or seek information that could improve future decisions. We distinguish these responses by measuring action preference, thinking length, and reported confidence under matched uncertainty. Ten open-weight models completed matched horizon-style two-armed bandit trials in thinking and non-thinking modes. A cognitive model separated value-guided action and uncertainty-independent choice noise from two behavioral signatures of exploration: a UCB-like preference for the less-known arm and Thompson-like choice variability that increases with total uncertainty. On average, thinking strengthened value-guided action and reduced uncertainty-independent choice noise, without producing UCB-like exploration or strengthening Thompson-like exploration. Outside action, the information-imbalanced history condition, which also displayed more observations than the matched balanced condition, was associated with greater thinking length. Reported confidence became more sensitive to decision difficulty and more strongly associated with chosen task evidence. We interpret these thinking-length and reported-confidence patterns as consistent with metacognitive control and metacognitive monitoring, respectively, without establishing either process. Decoder sweeps, especially temperature, altered choice noise and thinking length but did not reproduce the joint cross-output pattern. In this controlled decision setting, thinking improved how models acted on current evidence, while neither measured signature supported a shift toward a more information-seeking policy.

title: Network Verified NTN Positioning for 6G A Standards Oriented Survey of Hybrid TN NTN Localization
summary: Wireless positioning is evolving from legacy cellular and standalone satellite navigation toward hybrid, high-accuracy, three-dimensional (3D), and network-verifiable frameworks for 5G Advanced, 6G, and non terrestrial network (NTN) systems. This shift is driven by intelligent transportation, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) operation, low-altitude economy services, public warning, and regulated NTN use cases that require not only accurate location estimates, but also vertical awareness and verification confidence. This survey reviews the evolution from Long Term Evolution (LTE) and Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning to New Radio (NR), Release-18/19 positioning enhancements, and NTN-enabled 3D positioning. It synthesizes observable families, 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) standard evolution, method-level tradeoffs, and open challenges for hybrid terrestrial network (TN) NTN designs, with emphasis on standardization impact, vertical observability, reliability-aware measurement selection, and network-side verification.

title: ICDAR 2026 Competition on Information Extraction from Atomic Layer Deposition/Etching (ALD/E) Scientific Figures
comments: 17 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables, to be published in ICDAR 2026 Conference Proceedings and Volume 16975 of the Lecture Notes in Computer Science series (Springer Nature)
summary: Scientific figure comprehension and reasoning using multimodal AI requires integrating visual perception with domain-specific reasoning to extract meaningful knowledge, often not presented in the text of a research publication. The Sci-ImageMiner benchmark dataset, accompanied by a community-driven competition, raises the bar over prior scientific competitions by curating a comprehensive, expert-annotated dataset across four end-to-end complementary tasks. The competition attracted 68 active participants and 1,263 public/private submissions from 9th January 2026 to 8th April 2026. Our results show that state-of-the-art multimodal models perform well on classification and summarization tasks but struggle with data extraction and scientific reasoning, particularly in visual question-answering. These findings reveal key limitations and highlight challenges and opportunities for improving domain-aware multimodal AI systems. Overall, the Sci-ImageMiner benchmark and competition establish a rigorous platform for advancing research in scientific figure comprehension and reasoning and demonstrate the potential of state-of-the-art approaches for a challenging and complex research area.
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables, to be published in ICDAR 2026 Conference Proceedings and Volume 16975 of the Lecture Notes in Computer Science series (Springer Nature)

title: ToxScreen: Detecting Whether an LLM Has Been Poisoned
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed in high-stakes domains, adversaries may poison training data to implant backdoors: hidden triggers that covertly manipulate model behavior at inference time. We ask whether a defender can recover such a trigger under realistic affordances, namely white-box access to the weights and knowledge of the behavior of concern, but no training data, no trusted reference model, no knowledge of the trigger, and no certainty that the model is poisoned. To evaluate whether a defender can recover such a trigger under realistic settings, we release ToxScreen, a benchmark of roughly 800 backdoored models spanning attack objectives, trigger mechanisms, poisoning rates, model scales, and backdoor training mechanisms. We also assert that the backdoors are high-quality: they achieve high attack success rates, generalize to unseen harmful inputs, and preserve clean-task performance. Scoring recovery of the planted trigger, we find that gradient-based prompt optimization fails in recovery, whereas a token look-up that ranks candidates by attack-success rate recovers the trigger wherever the backdoor is effective. To understand this more, we study the relationship between attack behaviors and the weights of an LLM. We find a phenomenon whereby backdoors operate via different mechanistic strategies than jailbreaks, allowing defenders to filter jailbreaks. Finally, no method reliably surfaces every backdoor, but a broadly jailbreakable model is itself anomalous, a useful signal even when the exact trigger is not recovered. We release all models and evaluation code

title: From Representations to Behaviors: Exploring the Person-Situation-Behavior Triad in LLMs
summary: Human personality theories characterize traits not as isolated attributes captured by a single score, but as stable individual tendencies expressed through the interplay among persons, situations, and behaviors. Existing studies of personality-related behavior in LLMs have primarily focused on outputs elicited under personality conditioning, characterizing observable trait-related expressions while lacking mechanistic evidence for the existence of internal personality-related representations, their cross-situational expression, and how these representations shape specific behaviors. Building on Funder's personality triad framework, we adapt its three components for LLM analysis: Person as personality-related internal representations, Situation as contexts that afford trait-relevant responses, and Behavior as response patterns on broader social tasks. We introduce a framework for discovering, controlling, and validating trait-like representations in LLMs. First, using contrastive behavior pairs grounded in shared situations, we identify sparse internal features associated with opposing poles of personality traits through SAE decomposition. We validate their trait relevance through effects on behavior to situation, token-level activation patterns, and robustness to paraphrasing. Second, feature-level interventions induce bidirectional trait-related shifts across a separate, diverse set of situations while preserving response validity, demonstrating consistent expression across contexts. Third, applying the same interventions to social intelligence tasks reveals behavioral changes with benefit-tradeoff patterns consistent with findings from human personality research, providing behavioral-level validation beyond personality scores. Our findings provide evidence that LLMs contain controllable trait-like representations linking internal states, situational expression, and behavioral outcomes.

title: TREA-Net: A Transferable Residual Epidemiological Adaptation Network for Dengue Incidence Forecasting
summary: Accurate multi-week dengue forecasting supports timely vector-control interventions, outbreak preparedness, and healthcare resource allocation. However, newly established surveillance systems often lack the historical data needed to train reliable neural forecasting models. Although pretrained time-series models offer promising zero-shot forecasts, their cross-domain training may not capture local epidemiological dynamics. We propose TREA-Net, a Transferable Residual Epidemiological Adaptation Network for dengue forecasting under limited data. TREA-Net augments neural forecasting backbones with projections from an Environmental Time-Series Susceptible-Infected-Recovered model and learns a lightweight gated residual correction transferable from data-rich to data-scarce regions. Its node-invariant design accommodates surveillance systems with different numbers of locations, while target adaptation requires learning only two global parameters. We transfer knowledge from long-running dengue surveillance in Colombia and Nicaragua to 8-week-ahead forecasting in Mexico and Malaysia using only 78 or 104 weeks of target data. Across five neural backbones and ten transfer settings, TREA-Net improves the corresponding backbone in 9 out of 10 settings, with statistically significant gains. When integrated with TiRex, a foundation model for forecasting, it achieves the lowest mean absolute error across all target datasets. Conformal prediction further maintains empirical coverage while reducing 8-week prediction-interval width by 29.6% in Mexico. These results demonstrate TREA-Net's potential as a lightweight and portable early-warning framework for health agencies with limited surveillance data.

title: NeoRacer: An Open, Standardized 1:12 Scale Autonomous Race Car for Benchmarking and Education
summary:
Many scientific fields rely on standard benchmarks and shared platforms to improve review and reproducibility, but autonomous systems research still lacks widely accepted open hardware. Where standardization has emerged, progress has accelerated. This is especially evident in autonomous racing, where teams often build custom systems or buy niche, expensive vehicles, making control and robotics research and education hard to compare and reproduce. High costs also limit access outside well-funded labs, while affordable educational robots are often underpowered.
  To address this gap, we present NeoRacer, an open-source 1:12 scale autonomous racing platform. It is built around an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (67 TOPS), a 270° LiDAR, a 120 fps global-shutter camera, and a 9-axis IMU. NeoRacer ships pre-assembled for USD 2,699, offering over 3x the compute of comparable platforms at less than half the cost of the nearest pre-assembled alternative. Co-developed by the Neobotics Foundation and Seeed Studio, and manufactured by Seeed Studio, NeoRacer combines open hardware and software design with scalable, repeatable production. The modular, extensible platform provides a standardized benchmarking environment for autonomous racing algorithms across institutions. We describe the hardware/software architecture, design decisions from two pilot deployments (MIT IAP, 15 students; BU CPS Lab, 10 students), and key cost-performance tradeoffs. Hardware is licensed under CERN-OHL-S v2 and software under GPLv3, with all design files, firmware, and ROS2 packages publicly accessible.

title: Amortized Moment Matching for Visual Generation
summary: We propose amortized moment matching, utilizing neural networks to learn data moments as distributional training signals. By casting diffusion denoisers through polynomial projections, we establish a general framework for moment amortization, revealing that an $n$-th degree projection explicitly identifies data moments up to order $n+1$. Derived from the tractable affine case, we instantiate the Amortized Fréchet Distance (AMFD) loss. Unlike FD-loss which relies on explicit marginal moment calculations, AMFD is able to dynamically learn conditional moments via an alternating, matrix-free optimization pipeline that effortlessly scales to high-dimensional data.
