title: Characterizing Real-World Bugs in Tile Programs for Automated Bug Detection
comments: In Proceedings of the 35th ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis (ISSTA 2026)
summary: Tile-based programming frameworks are increasingly adopted to write high-performance GPU kernels in domains such as deep learning and scientific computing. While these frameworks enhance productivity and hardware utilization, their multi-stage compilation pipelines introduce distinct code generation bugs that are tightly coupled to input shapes, data types, and backend targets. These bugs often manifest as silent wrong results or performance issues, making them difficult to detect using existing compiler testing tools. Additionally, the unique programming conventions of tile domain-specific languages complicate root cause identification, while fixing such bugs demands specialized knowledge of tile abstractions and compilation pipelines. Despite the growing adoption of tile-based systems, their code generation bugs remain largely unexplored. This paper presents the first systematic study of tile-program code generation bugs. We curate 401 bug reports from GitHub and identify 301 tile-program codegen bugs for analysis, characterizing their root causes and symptoms, the input patterns that trigger them, the test oracles that detect them, and the strategies for fixing these bugs. Our study provides foundational insights for building debugging, testing, and repair tools tailored to tile-based compiler infrastructures.
comment: In Proceedings of the 35th ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis (ISSTA 2026)

title: Exact Symmetry as Algebra: A Machine-Verified Tensor Calculus that Enforces Physical Selection Rules
summary: Symmetry is central to the physical sciences, yet machine learning usually captures it only approximately, leaving a residual per-step equivariance error $\varepsilon$ that compounds with depth $M$ as $M\varepsilon$, whereas exact equivariance holds at unbounded depth; we demonstrate this divergence at fourteen orders of magnitude. We show that a symmetry can be made exact by construction, as the multiplication rule of a tensor algebra. In the resulting $\starG$ algebra, defined by any finite group $G$, the group-Fourier transform block-diagonalizes every tensor into irreducible-representation blocks, making equivariance intrinsic; requiring equivariance conversely \emph{forces} this suitably normalized transform, so the algebra is determined by $G$ rather than chosen. The standard matrix toolbox, including a Frobenius-optimal low-rank factorization, transfers blockwise, machine-checked in Lean~4 under an explicit axiom budget, and extends unchanged to band-limited compact groups and, under periodic boundary conditions, to all 230 crystallographic space groups and the compact little-group fibers of Euclidean and Poincaré symmetry. This exactness is an applied capability: on inorganic-crystal elastic tensors the algebra enforces point-group selection rules exactly on the output of \emph{any} predictor, driving a trained graph network's forbidden-channel leakage from $10^{-2}$ to machine zero, eliminating mechanically unstable predictions, and recovering viable materials that an unconstrained screen discards; on molecular data, with no quantum-mechanical input, it exposes octahedral selection-rule signatures consistent with the Wigner--Eckart theorem. Matched networks lead on pooled molecular accuracy, which we report plainly: the contribution is a complementary algebraic calculus, structural and diagnostic, exact at any depth.

title: An $O(n^5)$-Time Algorithm for Optimal Broadcast Domination
summary: Broadcast domination assigns a nonnegative integer power to every vertex of a graph so that every vertex is within the assigned power of some broadcasting vertex, and the objective is to minimize the sum of the powers. Heggernes and Lokshtanov proved that the problem is polynomial-time solvable on arbitrary connected unweighted graphs by showing that some optimal efficient broadcast has a domination graph that is a path or a cycle, and by reducing the general case to an $O(n^6)$-time algorithm. This paper gives an efficient algorithm of the path-case. Instead of building one auxiliary acyclic graph for every possible left endpoint vertex, we build a single directed acyclic graph whose states are oriented broadcast balls together with their two possible residual sides. The resulting path-case algorithm runs in $O(n^3)$ time and $O(n^3)$ space on an $n$-vertex graph. Combining this routine with the same peel-one-ball reduction of Heggernes and Lokshtanov yields an exact $O(n^5)$-time algorithm for optimal broadcast domination on arbitrary connected unweighted graphs. This resolves the quintic-time conjecture for general graphs attributed to Heggernes and Sæther and recorded in subsequent surveys of broadcast domination.

title: Ratchet: A Minimal Hygiene Recipe for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
summary: Self-evolving skill libraries, pioneered by Voyager, let frozen LLM agents accumulate reusable knowledge without weight updates, yet recent evaluation shows that LLM-authored skills deliver $+0.0$pp over no-skill baselines while human-curated ones deliver $+16.2$pp: the bottleneck is not skill authoring but lifecycle management. We introduce \textbf{Ratchet}, a single-agent loop in which a frozen LLM writes, retrieves, curates, and retires its own natural-language skills. Ratchet integrates four candidate hygiene mechanisms: outcome-driven retirement, a bounded active-cap, meta-skill authoring guidance, and pattern canonicalisation. On MBPP+ hard-100 with Claude Opus 4.7, Ratchet lifts held-out pass@1 from a $0.258 \pm 0.047$ baseline to a late-window rolling mean of $0.584$ (peak $0.658 \pm 0.042$) across 100 rounds and 3 seeds, a $+0.328 \pm 0.018$ rolling-mean gain where the no-skill control drifts at $+0.002 \pm 0.005$; the same recipe transfers to an agentic solver on SWE-bench Verified ($+0.22$ peak lift over 20~rounds). Eight ablations (A1--A8) reveal that the minimal working recipe is smaller than our design suggests: retirement and the meta-skill authoring prior are load-bearing, while explicit deduplication (canonicalisation, cover-guard) is subsumed by the meta-skill itself. A non-divergence proposition shows that bounded cap and retirement threshold together keep expected performance from drifting below the no-skill floor by more than a fixed margin, bounding library drift rather than guaranteeing improvement.

title: When One Point Is Not Enough: Addressing Ambiguous Instances in Dimensionality Reduction by Splitting
summary: Dimensionality Reduction (DR) methods are widely used to visualize high-dimensional data. One key task in DR-based analysis is discovering neighborhoods, which relies on analyzing the fine-grained local structure of a projection. However, DR is an inherently lossy process; no technique can perfectly preserve the high-dimensional relationships, and projections therefore contain visual artifacts. In this paper, we highlight a typically overlooked source of visual artifacts: ambiguous instances. These are instances that are highly similar to multiple mutually dissimilar neighborhoods in the high-dimensional space. Standard DR methods cannot faithfully project such instances, since each data instance is mapped to a single point in the visual space. As a result, such an instance is placed in only one of its neighborhoods (or in none at all), so only part of its neighborhood structure is represented. We call this distortion partial neighborhood embedding. In this paper, we introduce a graph-based approach that identifies ambiguous instances and replicates them as multiple points in the projection, placing each copy within its respective neighborhood. We use UMAP for our results, but our approach also generalizes to other local graph-based DR techniques. We show that our approach reveals previously hidden neighborhood memberships in projections and reduces partial neighborhood embedding across multiple examples, and is further supported by quantitative analyses.

title: Towards Verifiable Transformers: Solver-Checkable Circuit Explanations
comments: 23 pages. v2: adds GPT-2-scale verified distillation (three-edge verified quote circuit), LayerNorm removal for sparsemax models, and gated localization protocols
summary: Mechanistic interpretability typically discovers circuits and then argues what they do from examples and ablations. We introduce Verifiable Transformers, a framework for turning task-localized circuits into bounded, solver-checkable claims: projected functional equivalence, task-relevant invariance, edge necessity, and robustness to continuous final-residual perturbations. At small scale, we directly verify all four properties for quote-closing and bracket-type circuits, including program-mediated circuits whose attention selection is entirely symbolic. At GPT-2 scale, we remove LayerNorm from a sparsemax/LeakyReLU model after training with a +0.0087 OpenWebText loss increase, replace retained attention heads with synthesized restricted-DSL programs, and calibrate only program-local readouts while freezing and hashing every other parameter. The resulting three-edge quote circuit (embedding $\to$ MLP 0 $\to$ program head $\to$ logits) verifies all four properties over a hash-pinned 1,280-prompt domain in linear real arithmetic: 1,280/1,280 equivalence and invariance, 640 edge-necessity witnesses per edge, and robustness at $ε= 0.01$ with minimum certified radius 0.01515. For two alphabet variants of the same opener-detection/copy-type task, untouched gates expose a localization frontier: bracket-type extraction is exact only with all 144 heads, while the constructed quote artifact verifies with three edges. Naive discovery-based verification failed for measured reasons; at scale, we find we must build the object we can verify. The verified object is a calibrated artifact, not the unmodified model, and all claims are bounded to declared domains.

title: StateRAG: Typed State Contracts for Complex Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Complex retrieval-augmented generation requires evidence retrieval and control over what to retrieve next, which paths to explore, whether evidence is sufficient, and which intermediate results to retain. Existing RAG paradigms encode these decisions through method-specific model contexts, traversal procedures, verification signals, and memory. We introduce StateRAG, which represents retrieval control as a typed state external to the final reader. The state records the query plan, typed traversal path, candidate evidence, verification verdict, and reusable artifacts, with defined field semantics and designated update sources. Ordered role operators propose field values, and the controller validates and commits accepted proposals. A one-time compact-evidence check may select Bypass. Otherwise, the controller combines the committed verdict with the remaining budget to select Release, Revise, or Fallback. The final reader is invoked only after a terminal action and at most once per query. Among the evaluated methods, StateRAG achieves the best score on 10 of 11 reported quality metrics across LongBench, QASPER, and DocVQA. Its LongBench macro-average EM and F1 exceed ReAct by 6.3 and 6.1 percentage points, and its largest task-level gain is 9.8 F1 points on MuSiQue. Under normalized model-size weighting, StateRAG records lower mean LLM-token use per query than ReAct across all five workloads. In a matched LongBench control, the typed, role-owned carrier exceeds a free-form shared carrier by 1.3, 2.2, and 3.0 percentage points in macro EM, F1, and accuracy, with 6.2% lower mean RET. Removing TAM, MARS, or SMP lowers every reported LongBench and QASPER ablation metric.

title: When Rule Violations Are Rare: Chimera Training for Logical Anomaly Detection
summary: Many practical anomalies are not merely rare inputs, but violations of semantic constraints: objects co-occur in structured ways, actions imply preconditions, and events satisfy temporal or relational regularities. We study anomaly detection in this setting, where constraints are given as logical rules over learned visual concepts, but real rule violations are rare or absent during training. We propose a neural rule evaluator that compiles each constraint into a directed acyclic graph and learns feature-aware subtree MLP gates for its internal logical operators. Each gate maps child features and edge-level negations to a parent representation and a rule-satisfaction probability, with intermediate supervision obtained from exact Boolean propagation over ground-truth concept labels. The key difficulty is that same-image training data often provide insufficient coverage of informative truth configurations and also allow shortcut solutions. To address this, we introduce chimera training: an operand-level counterfactual construction at the feature level. Instead of mixing input images, we concatenate subtree features from different samples; each operand keeps the hard truth label of the sample it came from, and the chimera target is obtained by applying the node's logical operator to those inherited labels. This supplies supervised logical counterexamples without requiring real anomalous images. Across CLEVRER, OpenImages, and VidOR, the resulting evaluator improves rule-level anomaly AUROC over independent-events and same-image semantic-training baselines, especially for compositional and relational rules. The method yields both scalar anomaly scores and rule-level attributions.

title: VideoFDB: Evaluating Full-Duplex Vision-Speech Capabilities in Conversational Agents
summary: Natural human conversation is full-duplex and audio-visual: people simultaneously speak and listen while continuously interpreting and producing nonverbal cues, such as nods, smiles, and gestures. To support successful human-agent interaction, agents must model full-duplex audiovisual conversation; however, existing full-duplex benchmarks evaluate only speech. In this work, we present VideoFDB, the first benchmark to evaluate full-duplex audio-visual-to-audio-visual (AV2AV) conversational agents. VideoFDB contributes (i) 237 dyadic clips spanning 11 nonverbal conversational dynamics from real-world video calls, (ii) a taxonomy separating perception from generation behaviors, and (iii) a rubric-based LM-as-judge evaluation framework with interpretable axes for assessing conversational quality with respect to nonverbal conversational dynamics. Across open- and closed-source vision-speech agents, we find systematic failure modes: captioning collapse and visual-stream ignorance, and we show that current systems exploit vision for explicit visual question answering but not for the streaming joint audiovisual grounding required in natural conversation. We further evaluate cascaded speech-to-avatar systems and find that their architecture fundamentally precludes the production of full-duplex nonverbal cues. As the first benchmark for full-duplex AV2AV interaction, VideoFDB establishes a foundation for systematic evaluation and, we hope, will accelerate the advancement and development of next-generation multimodal conversational agents.

title: PACE: Phase-Aware Chunk Execution for Robot Policies with Action Chunking
summary: Recent vision-language-action and diffusion-based robot policies often use action chunking, where each policy query predicts a sequence of future actions and the robot executes an open-loop prefix before re-querying. While this interface improves local motion continuity, deployment still requires choosing the execution horizon: how much of each predicted chunk should be executed before acquiring a new observation. However, our experiments show that success is strongly task-dependent and non-monotonic with respect to the execution horizon, making a single constant horizon an unreliable deployment rule. We propose PACE (Phase-Aware Chunk Execution), a training-free test-time execution method that selects the execution horizon online from the predicted chunk itself. PACE exploits the phase-dependent kinematic structure of manipulation trajectories by identifying low-speed transition points in the predicted speed profile and using them as candidate replanning boundaries. Because PACE uses only the predicted action chunk, it is plug-and-play and requires no retraining or access to policy internals. We validate PACE through large-scale evaluations in both simulation and real-robot settings. On 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks, PACE raises the average success rate from 57.8% to 64.2%. In real-robot experiments on bimanual ALOHA and single-arm Franka platforms, PACE improves the average task score from 60.7 to 77.7 and the average success rate from 50.7% to 70.4%. Ablations and rollout-level analyses show that PACE adapts execution horizons across manipulation phases, shortening near transitions while preserving longer execution during coherent motion.

title: Mapping small reservoirs across Brazil from 1984 to 2025
summary: Water research in Brazil largely overlooks the widespread damming of small streams for agricultural uses including watering cattle, farm-scale hydropower, irrigation, and aquaculture. These ubiquitous dams and their reservoirs affect water temperature, stream connectivity, aquatic habitats, greenhouse gas emissions, and evaporative water losses. Mapping small reservoirs is challenging because it requires reliably detecting small water bodies and distinguishing artificial reservoirs from natural lakes. As a result, most regional and global datasets exclude them. To address this gap, we trained a deep learning computer vision model to accurately segment small (0.1 to 100 ha), stream-fed, surface water reservoirs in Brazil leveraging data from Landsat 5-9. Applying our model from 1984 to 2025, we created annual reservoir maps for the entire country to evaluate how their count, size, and distribution have changed over time. The number of detected reservoirs grew nearly fourfold from 224,059 to 817,458, while their total surface area increased from 3490 $km^2$ to 8455 $km^2$. To our knowledge, this is the first country-wide annual dataset representing the evolution of small reservoirs over four decades. The publicly available annual maps highlight the extent and cumulative impacts of small stream impoundments across Brazil, providing actionable insights for managing freshwater ecosystems and water resources.

AI.title_translation: 1984至2025年巴西小型水库遥感监测与空间制图
AI.tldr: 本研究基于深度学习和Landsat卫星数据，首次构建了巴西1984—2025年跨越40年的全国小型水库长时序动态监测数据集。
AI.motivation: 巴西小溪流上广泛修建小型水库（用于畜牧、灌溉、水产养殖等）对水环境和生态产生了深刻影响，但由于小型水体检测困难且难以区分人工水库与天然湖泊，现有大部分区域和全球数据集均忽略了小型水库。
AI.method: 利用Landsat 5-9卫星遥感数据训练深度学习计算机视觉模型，实现对巴西面积在0.1至100公顷之间、由溪流补给的小型地表水库的精确分割，并对1984年至2025年期间全境水库进行逐年制图与动态追踪。
AI.result: 1984年至2025年间，巴西检测到的小型水库数量从224,059个增加到817,458个（增幅近4倍），总表面积从3,490 km²增加到8,455 km²。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个跨越四十年的全国性小型水库演变数据集，揭示了巴西小型溪流截流的范围与累积影响，为淡水生态系统和水资源的科学管理提供了关键的数据支撑与决策依据。
AI.translation: 巴西的水资源研究在很大程度上忽视了因农业用途（包括畜牧饮水、农场规模水电、灌溉和水产养殖）而对小溪流进行的广泛拦截。这些无处不在的大坝及其水库影响着水温、溪流连通性、水生生境、温室气体排放和蒸发水损失。小型水库的制图具有挑战性，因为这需要可靠地检测小水体，并区分人工水库与天然湖泊。因此，大多数区域和全球数据集都排除了它们。为了填补这一空白，我们利用 Landsat 5-9 的数据训练了一个深度学习计算机视觉模型，以精确分割巴西小型（0.1 至 100 公顷）、溪流补给的地表水水库。将我们的模型应用于 1984 年至 2025 年，我们创建了覆盖全国的年度水库地图，以评估其数量、大小和分布随时间的变化。检测到的水库数量从 224,059 个大幅增加近四倍至 817,458 个，而其总表面积从 3,490 平方公里增加到 8,455 平方公里。据我们所知，这是首个代表四十年来小型水库演变过程的全国性年度数据集。公开获取的年度地图凸显了巴西全境小溪流拦截的范围和累积影响，为管理淡水生态系统和水资源提供了切实可行的见解。
AI.summary: 本研究利用Landsat 5-9遥感数据与深度学习计算机视觉模型，成功绘制了1984年至2025年巴西全国小型水库（0.1–100公顷）的逐年空间分布图谱。研究发现四十年间巴西小型水库数量增长近四倍，总面积翻倍以上。该开源数据集填补了长时序小型水库监测的空白，为水资源管理和淡水生态保护提供了重要依据。

AI.comments: 本研究创新性地结合深度学习与跨越四十年的Landsat遥感数据，克服了小水体分割及天然/人工水体区分的行业难题。该研究填补了全国尺度、长时序小型水库监测的数据空白，对评估人类农业活动对水生态系统、水文循环和温室气体排放的累积效应具有极为重要的学术与应用价值。

title: Target localization, identification and sensing using latent symmetries
comments: Published in SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences
summary: We show that an array of scatterers which has been designed to have latent ("hidden") symmetries can be used as a sensor. We use the capacitance matrix as a canonical model for three-dimensional hybridisation and study how the introduction of an "intruder'' scatterer breaks the latent symmetries. By analysing the degree to which each symmetry is broken, we identify the radius of the intruder and localize its position. This can be achieved using a dictionary-based approach, however Bayesian inference or an artificial neural network (multi-layer perceptron) perform better in the presence of measurement noise. To our knowledge, this is the first time latent symmetries have been exploited successfully for sensing problems. It is also the first time latent symmetries have been observed in a three-dimensional open system that cannot be approximated by a sparse graph.
comment: Published in SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences

AI.title_translation: 利用潜在对称性实现目标定位、识别与感知
AI.tldr: 本文首次将潜在对称性用于感知领域，通过分析入侵物引起的潜在对称性破缺，实现了三维开放系统中目标的定位与识别。
AI.motivation: 探索能否以及如何利用散射体阵列中精心设计的潜在（隐藏）对称性来实现目标的定位、识别与感知。
AI.method: 以电容矩阵作为三维杂化的规范模型，研究入侵散射体对系统潜在对称性的破坏程度；结合基于字典的方法、贝叶斯推理以及人工神经网络（多层感知机）对入侵散射体的半径进行识别并对其位置进行定位。
AI.result: 通过分析对称性破缺程度可以精确识别入侵者的半径并定位其位置；在存在测量噪声的情况下，贝叶斯推理和多层感知机（MLP）的表现显著优于传统的字典搜索方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功证实了潜在对称性在感知问题中的可行性与有效性，这是潜在对称性首次在三维开放系统中的实际观察与应用。
AI.translation: 我们展示了经过设计具有潜在（“隐藏”）对称性的散射体阵列可以用作传感器。我们使用电容矩阵作为三维杂化的规范模型，研究了“入侵者”散射体的引入是如何破坏潜在对称性的。通过分析每个对称性被破坏的程度，我们确定了入侵者的半径并定位了其位置。这可以通过基于字典的方法来实现，但是在存在测量噪声的情况下，贝叶斯推理或人工神经网络（多层感知机）的表现更好。据我们所知，这是首次成功将潜在对称性应用于感知问题。这也是首次在无法近似为稀疏图的三维开放系统中观察到潜在对称性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用潜在对称性进行目标传感与定位识别的新方法。研究利用电容矩阵建立三维开放系统模型，分析了入侵散射体打破潜在对称性的机制。通过量化对称性破缺程度并结合字典法、贝叶斯推理及多层感知机神经网络，成功实现了对入侵目标的尺寸识别和定位，并展示了机器学习方法在噪声条件下的良好鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 潜在对称性, 目标定位, 目标识别, 物理传感, 神经网络
AI.comments:
创新性：首次将物理学中的“潜在对称性”概念成功应用于感知与目标定位识别领域，开辟了对称性破缺传感的新方向。
重要性：突破了过去潜在对称性仅能在稀疏图等简单系统中观察到的限制，首次在复杂的三维开放系统中实现了观察与应用，并结合贝叶斯推理与神经网络提高了抗噪性能。
局限性：研究基于电容矩阵这一规范模型，实际物理场景（如复杂电磁或声学散射环境）中的硬件实现与实验验证仍需进一步探索。

title: The Ghost Couple: Correlated LLM Name Priors and Their Haunting of the Web and Academic Publishing
summary: These names do not exist. Elena Vasquez and Marcus Chen have appeared as volcano experts, astronauts, thriller protagonists, podcast hosts, and academic co-authors across hundreds of independently produced AI-generated documents, never having lived. We show that large language models do not merely default to high-probability individual names when generating fictional experts: they produce correlated character ensembles, pairs and trios whose co-occurrence rates far exceed chance and are consistent across independent generations. These priors are model-family-specific (Claude: Elena Vasquez + Marcus Chen + Amara Okafor; Gemini: Aris Thorne + Lena Petrova; GPT: Elara Voss with no fixed partner), version-specific, and actively suppressed at model release boundaries, leaving dateable behavioral fingerprints in the content they produced. We document a downstream consequence at scale. On Zenodo, a CERN-operated repository that mints real DataCite DOIs, we identify 1,655 ghost-authored records claiming nonexistent journals with fabricated publication dates: server-side DataCite timestamps prove deliberate backdating, and 991 records were registered in a single month; these carry real DOIs registered in DataCite, making them harvestable by any scholarly aggregator that ingests DOI metadata. Ghost names additionally appear on ResearchGate forming synthetic research groups with collaborators drawn from multiple model families; publication dates on these records provide a reliable temporal proxy for model deployment windows.

AI.title_translation: 幽灵伴侣：大语言模型的关联姓名先验及其对网络和学术出版的困扰
AI.tldr: LLM在生成虚构人物时存在特定的关联姓名组合偏好（幽灵伴侣），这些“幽灵作者”已大规模渗透至Zenodo等学术平台，铸造了上千条带真实DOI的虚假文献记录。
AI.motivation: 揭示大语言模型（LLM）在生成虚构专家或角色时不仅偏好特定单个高频姓名，还会生成固定搭配的“关联姓名组合”，并探究这种姓名先验在现实网络与学术出版平台（如Zenodo和ResearchGate）中的大规模渗透及其潜在危害。
AI.method: 通过对不同模型家族（Claude、Gemini、GPT）独立生成的数百份AI文档进行统计，分析姓名共现率与模型家族及版本的对应关系；同时搜集并检索Zenodo及ResearchGate平台上的元数据，利用服务器端DataCite时间戳与DOI注册记录，量化分析虚假学术记录的分布与时间特征。
AI.result: 发现不同模型家族存在特定的关联姓名先验组合（如Claude对应Elena Vasquez + Marcus Chen等），且具有版本敏感性；在Zenodo平台上识别出1,655条带有真实DataCite DOI但由不存在的“幽灵作者”撰写、存在故意倒填日期行为的虚假记录；在ResearchGate上也发现了跨模型家族形成的合成研究小组，其发表日期可作为模型部署的时间代理。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的关联姓名先验不仅构成了可识别、可定年的模型行为指纹，还在现实学术生态中造成了大规模的虚假文献与DOI数据污染，揭示了AI生成内容对学术检索和出版元数据系统的严峻威胁。
AI.translation: 这些名字并不存在。Elena Vasquez和Marcus Chen曾在数百份独立生成的AI文档中作为火山专家、宇航员、惊悚小说主角、播客主持人以及学术合著者出现，但他们从未真实存在过。我们表明，大语言模型在生成虚构专家时，并不仅仅默认使用高概率的单个姓名：它们会生成具有关联性的角色组合（双人或三人组），其共现率远超随机概率，且在独立生成中保持一致。这些先验具有模型家族特定性（Claude：Elena Vasquez + Marcus Chen + Amara Okafor；Gemini：Aris Thorne + Lena Petrova；GPT：Elara Voss且无固定搭档）、版本特定性，并在模型发布边界受到主动抑制，从而在其生成的内容中留下了可定年的行为指纹。我们记录了这一现象在规模化应用中的下游后果：在欧洲核子研究中心（CERN）运营、可铸造真实DataCite DOI的开放存储库Zenodo上，我们识别出1,655条由幽灵作者撰写的记录，这些记录声称属于不存在的期刊并带有伪造的发表日期；服务器端DataCite时间戳证实了故意倒填日期的行为，其中991条记录在单月中注册；这些记录带有在DataCite注册的真实DOI，使得任何摄取DOI元数据的学术汇总系统都能采集它们。此外，幽灵姓名还出现在ResearchGate上，与来自多个模型家族的合作者组成合成研究小组；这些记录上的发表日期为模型部署窗口提供了可靠的时间代理。
AI.summary: 本文揭示了大语言模型（LLM）在生成虚构专家时存在特定的“关联姓名先验组合”（如Elena Vasquez与Marcus Chen等），这些组合因模型家族和版本而异，形成了独特的行为指纹。研究发现，这些“幽灵作者”已大规模渗透至真实学术平台：在Zenodo上生成了1,655条带有真实DOI和虚构出版信息的学术记录，并在ResearchGate上构建了合成研究小组，对学术元数据和出版生态造成了实质性污染。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型先验, 幽灵作者, 学术出版污染, DOI元数据, 行为指纹
AI.comments: 本研究视角独特且具有深刻的警示意义。它不仅揭示了大语言模型内部潜在的“关联姓名先验”这一行为特征，更揭示了这种偏置在学术出版索引体系（如Zenodo、DataCite、ResearchGate）中造成的“虚假文献污染”危机。文章将模型行为指纹分析与现实世界的文献溯源相结合，创新性极高，对于LLM生成内容检测、生成式AI溯源以及学术数据治理具有重大参考价值。

title: VistaHop: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Visual DeepSearch
summary: Visual DeepSearch tasks require multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to resolve complex visual queries by repeatedly inspecting image regions, grounding reasoning in visual evidence, and connecting fine-grained clues across multiple steps. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate single-step visual understanding or isolated visual-query response generation. They have limited difficulty, limited search horizons, and single-pass image inspection, and thus fail to evaluate models' ability to iteratively revisit visual evidence and reason across multiple steps. In this work, we introduce VistaHop, a benchmark designed specifically to evaluate Visual DeepSearch. It evaluates repeated image inspection, visual-anchor grounding, and long-horizon evidence traversal across different visual regions. VistaHop comprises 600 images, 25 visual search scenarios, and 600 Visual DeepSearch tasks. We also propose VistaArena, a unified evaluation framework that supports tool-based interactions, including visual retrieval, image inspection, and evidence-grounded reasoning. Experiments show that even state-of-the-art MLRMs remain far from solving VistaHop, with the best-performing model, SenseNova-MARS-32B, achieving only 26.33% Pass@1. These findings highlight the importance of specialized benchmarks and improved agentic methods for Visual DeepSearch.

AI.title_translation: VistaHop：长视角视觉深度搜索基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 VistaHop 基准和 VistaArena 评估框架，用于测试多模态大模型在长视角、多步骤视觉深度搜索中的表现，实验表明现有顶级模型在该基准上表现依然较弱。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态基准主要评估单步视觉理解或孤立的视觉查询响应生成，存在难度低、搜索视野受限和仅进行单次图像审查的缺点，无法有效评估模型迭代复查视觉证据并跨多步进行推理的能力。
AI.method: 推出了专门用于评估视觉深度搜索的基准 VistaHop（包含 600 张图像、25 个视觉搜索场景和 600 个任务），评估重复图像审查、视觉锚点定位和长视野证据遍历；同时提出了统一的交互评估框架 VistaArena，支持视觉检索、图像审查和基于证据的推理等工具化交互。
AI.result: 即使是最先进的多模态大模型在 VistaHop 上表现依然较差，表现最好的 SenseNova-MARS-32B 模型仅取得了 26.33% 的 Pass@1 准确率。
AI.conclusion: 强调了为视觉深度搜索开发专用基准测试以及改进基于智能体（Agentic）的方法的重要性。
AI.translation: 视觉深度搜索（Visual DeepSearch）任务要求多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通过反复审查图像区域、将推理建立在视觉证据上，并跨多个步骤连接细粒度线索，来解决复杂的视觉查询。然而，现有的基准测试主要评估单步视觉理解或孤立的视觉查询响应生成。它们的难度有限、搜索视野狭窄且仅进行单次图像审查，因此无法评估模型迭代复查视觉证据并跨多步推理的能力。在这项工作中，我们推出了 VistaHop，这是一个专门设计用于评估视觉深度搜索的基准。它评估了跨不同视觉区域的重复图像审查、视觉锚点定位和长视角证据遍历。VistaHop 包含 600 张图像、25 个视觉搜索场景和 600 个视觉深度搜索任务。我们还提出了 VistaArena，这是一个统一的评估框架，支持基于工具的交互，包括视觉检索、图像审查和建立在证据上的推理。实验表明，即使是最先进的多模态模型距离解决 VistaHop 仍有很大差距，表现最好的模型 SenseNova-MARS-32B 仅取得了 26.33% 的 Pass@1。这些发现强调了专门基准和改进的智能体方法对视觉深度搜索的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了用于评估长视角视觉深度搜索（Visual DeepSearch）的新基准 VistaHop 以及配套评估框架 VistaArena。VistaHop 通过 600 个任务评估模型在多步搜索中的重复审查、锚点定位及证据遍历能力。实验显示现有 SOTA 模型在该任务上表现普遍欠佳（最高 Pass@1 为 26.33%），凸显了开发更强智能体方法和专用基准的必要性。
AI.keywords: Visual DeepSearch, Benchmark, Multimodal Large Language Models, Long-Horizon Reasoning, Agentic Evaluation
AI.comments: 该论文提出了针对长视野多步视觉深度搜索（Visual DeepSearch）的新基准，弥补了现有视觉基准大多局限于单步理解的不足。创新点在于将图像检索、反复审查与多步推理结合，并推出了配套的交互评估框架 VistaArena。实验结果揭示了当前 SOTA 多模态大模型在复杂多步视觉推理上的显著短板（最佳模型 Pass@1仅为 26.33%），对推进多模态 Agent 的发展具有重要意义。

title: An Empirical Audit of Input Encoders for Multi-Channel Signal Transformers
summary: Transformers consuming multi-channel scalar signals must embed $C$ simultaneous values into one $d_{\text{model}}$-dimensional vector per time step. We audit eight input encoders -- a shared-scalar baseline, per-channel linear projections, an orthogonality regulariser, a nonlinear MLP, block-partitioned concatenation, channel-independent and channel-as-token architectures, and a projected positional encoding -- on a synthetic benchmark where channel identity is informative and on ETTh1, scored by next-step negative log-likelihood. The headline is practical near-equivalence within a wide "top tier": the standard per-channel linear projection matches every alternative up to small, statistically real but practically modest differences. A direct geometric probe attributes this to a spontaneous orthogonalisation of the per-channel projections: with no explicit regulariser they tighten well beyond the near-orthogonality of random initialisation, letting the standard linear recover channel identity from the summed embedding. Two encoders lose decisively: the shared-scalar baseline collapses for information-theoretic reasons we make explicit, and the channel-independent PatchTST-spirit baseline overfits universally on the synthetic benchmark and underperforms on both. Paired tests resolve two small gaps: projecting the sinusoidal positional encoding through a learned linear layer edges the rest at small $C$ by extending this orthogonality to the positional subspace; a nonlinear MLP stem edges them at the largest $C$, with the gap shrinking under more training data. The practical recommendation: use the standard per-channel linear projection by default; reach for something more elaborate only when the task calls for it.

AI.title_translation: 多通道信号 Transformer 输入编码器的实证审计
AI.tldr: 标准逐通道线性投影在多通道信号 Transformer 输入编码中表现足够优秀且与复杂方案效果近乎等价，建议默认使用。
AI.motivation: 多通道标量信号 Transformer 需要将每个时间步的 $C$ 个同步标量嵌入到 $d_{\text{model}}$ 维向量中，但不同输入编码器的设计对模型表示能力与预测性能的影响缺乏系统性的实证审计与理论解释。
AI.method: 评估并审计了八种输入编码器（共享标量基线、逐通道线性投影、正交正则化器、非线性 MLP、块分区拼接、通道独立架构、通道作为 Token 架构、投影位置编码），并在合成基准数据集及真实数据集 ETTh1 上以下一步负对数似然（NLL）进行评估，结合几何探测方法分析向量空间的特征。
AI.result: 1. 标准逐通道线性投影与多种复杂编码器在实操性能上近乎等价；2. 几何探测表明标准线性投影在训练中会产生“自发正交化”，从而能从求和嵌入中有效恢复通道身份；3. 共享标量基线因信息论限制崩溃，通道独立基线出现严重过拟合且表现最差；4. 小通道数时投影位置编码微弱领先，极大通道数时非线性 MLP 略优。
AI.conclusion: 建议在绝大多数实际场景中默认使用标准的逐通道线性投影编码器，仅在特定特殊需求下才考虑更复杂的架构设计。
AI.translation: 处理多通道标量信号的 Transformer 在每个时间步必须将 $C$ 个同步标量值嵌入到一个 $d_{\text{model}}$ 维度的向量中。我们在通道身份具有信息量的合成基准数据集以及 ETTh1 数据集上，对八种输入编码器（共享标量基线、逐通道线性投影、正交正则化器、非线性 MLP、块分区拼接、通道独立架构、通道作为 Token 架构以及投影位置编码）进行了审计，并以下一步负对数似然为指标进行打分。主要结论是，在一个广泛的“顶层”编码器集合中实操效果近乎等价：标准逐通道线性投影与各种替代方案的表现相匹配，差距在统计上真实存在但实际影响微乎其微。直接几何探测将此归因于逐通道投影的“自发正交化”：在没有显式正则化的情况下，它们收紧程度远超随机初始化的近正交性，使标准线性投影能够从求和嵌入中恢复通道身份。两种编码器明显劣势：共享标量基线因我们明确指出的信息论原因而崩溃，而通道独立（PatchTST 风格）基线在合成基准上普遍过拟合且在两个数据集上均表现不佳。配对检验解决两个微小差距：在小通道数 $C$ 时，通过可学习线性层投影正弦位置编码将其正交性扩展到位置子空间，从而略胜一筹；在最大通道数 $C$ 时，非线性 MLP 主干略占优，但随着训练数据的增加，这种差距会缩小。实用建议：默认使用标准的逐通道线性投影；只有当任务有特殊需求时，才使用更复杂的方案。
AI.summary: 本研究针对多通道信号 Transformer 的八种输入编码器进行了系统实证审计。研究发现，传统的逐通道线性投影凭借训练过程中的“自发正交化”机制，能够在保持简便性的同时完美恢复通道身份，其实际性能与更复杂的编码方案基本持平。因此，作者建议将逐通道线性投影作为默认选择。
AI.keywords: 输入编码器, 多通道信号, Transformer, 逐通道线性投影, 自发正交化
AI.comments: 本文对多通道序列建模中常被忽视的输入嵌入层进行了深入且务实的实证探究，创新性地通过几何探测解释了线性投影具备“自发正交化”机制，解释了其为什么难以被更复杂的编码器超越。文章给出的实用结论对时间序列与多通道信号建模的模型设计具有极高指导价值。

title: TLA-Prover: Verifiable TLA+ Specification Synthesis via Preference-Optimized Low-Rank Adaptation
comments: 12 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures. In Proceedings at the 21st International Conference on Software Technologies (ICSOFT 2026)
summary: TLA+ is a formal specification language for verifying distributed systems and safety-critical protocols. Large language models (LLMs) frequently produce TLA+ specifications that fail the TLC model checker for semantic reasons. Across 25 LLMs, the best public baseline is 26.6% syntactic parse and 8.6% semantic model-check. We present TLA-Prover, a 20-billion-parameter model for TLA+ specification synthesis. Training combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on verified examples with repair-based group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). In the GRPO stage, the model learns to fix its own rejected specifications. We also train a direct preference optimization (DPO) variant from the same SFT checkpoint as an ablation. TLC provides the reward signal directly, with no learned reward model. Four tiers grade each output: Bronze (parses), Silver (no warnings), Gold (passes TLC), and Diamond. To reach Diamond, the model's correctness property is automatically altered in a small way; TLC must then detect a violation. If TLC still passes, the property was always-true and contributes nothing; the output fails Diamond. TLA-Prover reaches 9/30 (i.e. pass@1 = 30%) at both Gold and Diamond on a held-out 30-problem benchmark. This is roughly 3.5x the 8.6% untuned baseline. The DPO variant reaches 20% at Diamond. Gold and Diamond coincide at every checkpoint; this prevents the trivial-property failure mode.
comment: 12 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures. In Proceedings at the 21st International Conference on Software Technologies (ICSOFT 2026)

AI.title_translation: TLA-Prover：基于偏好优化低秩适应的可验证 TLA+ 规范合成
AI.tldr: TLA-Prover通过将SFT与基于修复的GRPO结合，并直接利用TLC模型检查器作为奖励信号，将TLA+形式化规范合成的通过率从8.6%提升至30%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在生成用于验证分布式系统和安全关键协议的TLA+形式化规范时，普遍存在语法或语义错误，现有最佳基线的语义模型检查通过率仅为8.6%。因此需要一种能够自动生成语义正确且可验证规范的新方法。
AI.method:
1. 训练一个200亿参数的模型TLA-Prover；
2. 首先在经过验证的TLA+示例上进行监督微调（SFT）；
3. 接着采用基于修复的群体相对策略优化（GRPO），使模型学习修复自身被拒绝的规范，且直接利用TLC模型检查器提供客观奖励信号（无需学习奖励模型）；
4. 引入包括Bronze、Silver、Gold和Diamond的四级评估机制，其中Diamond通过对属性进行微小扰动并要求TLC检测出错误，从而排除“恒真（trivial）”属性。
AI.result: 在包含30个问题的留出评估基准上，TLA-Prover在Gold和Diamond级别上均达到了30%（9/30）的pass@1，约为未微调基线（8.6%）的3.5倍；消融实验中的DPO变体在Diamond级别达到20%。Gold和Diamond的通过率在各个检查点完全一致，成功防止了生成平凡恒真属性的失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 利用TLC模型检查器提供直接反馈，并通过基于修复的GRPO强化学习方法，可以大幅提升大语言模型生成语义正确、非平凡且可验证的TLA+形式化规范的能力。
AI.translation: TLA+ 是一种用于验证分布式系统和安全关键协议的形式化规范语言。大语言模型（LLMs）生成的 TLA+ 规范频繁因语义原因无法通过 TLC 模型检查器。在 25 个大模型中，最佳的公开基线仅有 26.6% 的语法解析通过率和 8.6% 的语义模型检查通过率。我们提出了 TLA-Prover，一个拥有 200 亿参数的 TLA+ 规范合成模型。训练结合了在已验证示例上的监督微调（SFT）与基于修复的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）。在 GRPO 阶段，模型学习修复自己被拒绝的规范。我们还从同一个 SFT 检查点训练了一个直接偏好优化（DPO）变体作为消融实验。TLC 直接提供奖励信号，无需训练奖励模型。评估分为四个等级：Bronze（可解析）、Silver（无警告）、Gold（通过 TLC）和 Diamond。为了达到 Diamond，模型的正确性属性会被自动进行微调改动；TLC 随后必须检测出违规。如果 TLC 仍然通过，则该属性属于恒真属性且毫无贡献，输出将无法达到 Diamond。TLA-Prover 在包含 30 个问题的留出基准测试中，Gold 和 Diamond 级别均达到了 9/30（即 pass@1 = 30%）。这大约是 8.6% 未微调基线的 3.5 倍。DPO 变体在 Diamond 级别达到了 20%。Gold 和 Diamond 在每个检查点都重合，这避免了平凡属性的失效模式。
AI.summary: 针对大语言模型生成TLA+形式化规范时通过率低的问题，本文提出了TLA-Prover（20B参数模型）。该模型将监督微调（SFT）与基于修复的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）相结合，并直接使用TLC模型检查器作为无偏奖励信号。为了防止生成毫无意义的恒真属性，研究还提出了四级评估机制（Bronze、Silver、Gold、Diamond）。实验表明，TLA-Prover将TLA+规范合成的pass@1通过率从8.6%大幅提升至30%。
AI.keywords: TLA+, 规范合成, 模型检查, 群体相对策略优化 (GRPO), 低秩适应
AI.comments: 创新点在于将形式化验证工具TLC直接作为强化学习（GRPO）的客观奖励信号，避免了传统RLHF中奖励模型的不准确性；同时提出了Diamond评估标准，巧妙解决了规范生成中模型可能钻空子生成“恒真”无效属性的问题。局限性在于评估的测试集规模较小（仅30个问题），且模型参数量较大（20B），训练与部署成本较高。

title: RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention
summary:
As the input length of large language model (LLM) serving continues to grow, the KV cache has become a dominant bottleneck in AI infrastructure. It limits GPU memory capacity, serving concurrency, cache reuse, and distributed scalability. Multiple important problems, including position-independent KV cache, prefix KV cache compression, hot/cold KV cache separation, and distributed KV cache management, all depend on how the KV cache is represented and managed. However, existing serving systems largely rely on a monolithic KV cache abstraction, where the KV cache is treated as a homogeneous sequence of token-level memory blocks and managed with similar policies across attention heads and serving scenarios. We observe that KV cache utility is highly structured across KV heads: different heads exhibit different functional roles, attention distances, and runtime importance. Therefore, a full KV cache is not always necessary for every head, token range, or serving scenario.
  We present RedKnot, a head-aware KV cache management system for LLM serving. RedKnot breaks the conventional monolithic KV cache abstraction by decomposing the KV cache along KV heads, whose importance and effective attention ranges vary significantly across serving scenarios. This head-level decomposition turns the KV cache from a monolithic tensor abstraction into a structured memory object, enabling RedKnot to uniformly support position-independent KV reuse, prefix KV compression, hot/cold KV separation, and distributed KV placement while preserving output fidelity and improving resource efficiency, without requiring model retraining or fine-tuning. RedKnot establishes a new foundation for AI infrastructure by transforming the KV cache from a monolithic, passive runtime artifact into a dynamic, model-aware runtime substrate for scalable LLM serving.

AI.title_translation: RedKnot：基于注意力头感知的KV重用与SegPagedAttention的高效长文本LLM推理服务
AI.tldr: RedKnot提出了一种感知注意力头的KV cache管理系统，通过将KV cache按头分解为结构化内存对象，在无需微调模型的情况下实现了高效的KV重用、前缀压缩、冷热分离及分布式放置。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM推理服务的输入长度剧增，KV cache成为显存容量、并发服务、缓存重用和分布式扩展的主要瓶颈。现有系统主要依赖单体式（Monolithic）KV cache抽象，对所有注意力头采用统一的管理策略，忽略了不同注意力头在功能角色、注意力距离和运行时重要性上的显著差异。
AI.method: 提出RedKnot系统，破除传统的整体式（Monolithic）KV cache抽象，将KV cache沿着注意力头（KV heads）维度进行分解，将其转化为结构化的内存对象。基于此head级分解机制，RedKnot在无需重训练或微调模型的前提下，统一支持位置无关的KV重用、前缀KV压缩、冷热KV分离以及分布式KV放置。
AI.result: RedKnot在完全保持模型输出保真度的同时，显著提升了显存与计算资源效率，成功统一支持了位置无关KV重用、前缀KV压缩、冷热KV分离以及分布式KV放置等多种高级缓存管理策略。
AI.conclusion: RedKnot将KV cache从单体、被动的运行时产物转变为动态、感知模型的运行时基础，为构建高可扩展性、高性能的长文本LLM推理服务建立了新的AI基础设施基石。
AI.translation:
随着大语言模型（LLM）推理服务的输入长度持续增长，KV cache已成为AI基础设施中的核心瓶颈。它限制了GPU显存容量、服务并发度、缓存重用以及分布式扩展能力。包括位置无关的KV cache重用、前缀KV cache压缩、冷/热KV cache分离以及分布式KV cache管理在内的多个重要问题，均取决于KV cache的表示与管理方式。然而，现有的推理服务系统在很大程度上依赖于单体式（monolithic）KV cache抽象，即将KV cache视为由token级内存块组成的同质序列，并在不同注意力头和推理场景中采用类似的策略进行管理。我们观察到，KV cache的效用在KV头之间具有高度的结构化特性：不同的头表现出不同的功能角色、注意力距离和运行时重要性。因此，并非每个头、token范围或推理场景都需要完整的KV cache。
我们提出了RedKnot，一个用于LLM推理服务的感知注意力头KV cache管理系统。RedKnot打破了传统的单体式KV cache抽象，通过沿KV头分解KV cache（其重要性和有效注意力范围在不同推理场景下差异显著）。这种头级别的分解将KV cache从单体张量抽象转变为结构化内存对象，使RedKnot能够在保持输出保真度并提高资源效率的同时，统一支持位置无关的KV重用、前缀KV压缩、冷/热KV分离以及分布式KV放置，且无需对模型进行重训练或微调。RedKnot通过将KV cache从单体、被动的运行时产物转变为动态、感知模型的运行时基础，为可扩展的LLM推理服务奠定了新的AI基础设施基础。
AI.summary: 针对长文本LLM推理服务中单体式KV cache导致的显存与扩展性瓶颈，本文提出了RedKnot系统。RedKnot通过观察到不同注意力头在功能和重要性上的结构化差异，打破传统单体式抽象，将KV cache沿注意力头维度分解为结构化内存对象。该方法无需模型微调即可统一实现KV重用、压缩、冷热分离及分布式放置，大幅提升资源效率并保持输出质量。
AI.keywords: KV Cache, LLM Serving, Head-Aware, Memory Management, Long-Context
AI.comments:
1. 创新点：打破了传统的整体式（Monolithic）KV cache抽象范式，首次从“注意力头（Attention Head）”粒度对KV cache进行细粒度解耦与结构化管理。
2. 重要性：随着长文本LLM推理需求激增，显存成为瓶颈。RedKnot在不需要对模型进行任何重训练或微调的前提下，统一支持了位置无关重用、前缀压缩、冷热分离和分布式放置，具有极高的实际应用与部署价值。
3. 局限性：摘要未给出具体的量化实验数据（如吞吐量提升幅度、显存节省比例等），且头维度的细粒度管理可能带来额外的调度与控制开销，具体效果需参考论文全文正文实验。

title: SafeECGMatch: Calibration-Aware Joint Frequency and Time Space Semi-Supervised Learning for Open-Set ECG Classification
comments: 8 pages. Accepted to the KDD 2026 - UC (The 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining - Undergraduate Consortium)
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) classification models often suffer from severe label scarcity, making semi-supervised learning (SSL) an attractive strategy for reducing annotation costs. In clinical settings, however, unlabeled pools frequently contain out-of-distribution (OOD) anomalies or diagnostic groups absent from the labeled set. Standard SSL forces incorrect pseudo-labels onto these unseen classes, producing overconfident predictions. To address this, we propose SafeECGMatch, a calibration-aware safe SSL framework for single-label ECG classification under label distribution mismatch. Methodologically, SafeECGMatch employs a dual-branch architecture extracting time-frequency latent representations via ECG-specific augmentations. Crucially, it dynamically aligns confidence with empirical accuracy through adaptive label smoothing and temperature scaling, calibrating both the multiclass classifier and the OOD detector across temporal and spectral domains. This joint optimization allows trustworthy OOD rejection and reliable pseudo-labeling. Evaluated on the PTB-XL and PhysioNet/CinC Challenge benchmarks, SafeECGMatch achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and calibration, advancing reliable knowledge discovery in physiological time-series. Code is available at https://github.com/labhai/SafeECGMatch.
comment: 8 pages. Accepted to the KDD 2026 - UC (The 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining - Undergraduate Consortium)

AI.title_translation: SafeECGMatch：用于开放集心电图分类的校准感知时频联合空间半监督学习
AI.tldr: SafeECGMatch 结合时频表征提取与动态置信度校准，解决了开放集心电图半监督学习中分布外样本导致的过度自信预测问题。
AI.motivation: 在临床实际场景中，半监督学习（SSL）面对的未标记数据池常包含标记集中未出现的分布外（OOD）异常或病症。传统 SSL 会强制对这些未知类赋予错误的伪标签，导致模型产生过度自信的错误预测。
AI.method: 提出 SafeECGMatch 框架：1) 采用双分支架构并通过 ECG 特定增强提取时频隐表征；2) 通过自适应标签平滑和温度缩放动态对齐模型置信度与经验准确率，在时域和频域联合校准多分类器和 OOD 检测器。
AI.result: 在 PTB-XL 和 PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 基准数据集上的实验表明，SafeECGMatch 取得了当前最先进（SOTA）的准确率与校准性能。
AI.conclusion: SafeECGMatch 实现了高可靠性的 OOD 拒绝与伪标签标注，显著提升了开放集场景下的模型性能与可信度，推动了生理时间序列分析的发展。
AI.translation: 心电图（ECG）分类模型通常面临严重的标签稀缺问题，这使得半监督学习（SSL）成为降低标注成本的一种极具吸引力的策略。然而在临床环境中，未标记数据池往往包含分布外（OOD）异常或标记集中不存在的诊断类别。标准的半监督学习会向这些未见过的类别强制赋予错误的伪标签，从而产生过度自信的预测。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 SafeECGMatch，这是一种用于标签分布不匹配情况下单标签心电图分类的校准感知安全半监督学习框架。在方法上，SafeECGMatch 采用双分支架构，通过特定于心电图的数据增强提取时频隐式表征。关键在于，它通过自适应标签平滑和温度缩放动态地将置信度与经验准确率对齐，从而在时域和频域上共同校准多分类器和 OOD 检测器。这种联合优化实现了值得信赖的 OOD 拒绝和可靠的伪标签生成。在 PTB-XL 和 PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 基准上的评估表明，SafeECGMatch 达到了当前最先进的准确率和校准度，推动了生理时间序列中可靠知识发现的发展。代码已开源：https://github.com/labhai/SafeECGMatch。
AI.summary: 本文针对开放集心电图半监督分类问题，提出了 SafeECGMatch 框架。该框架结合 ECG 时频双分支表征提取与基于自适应标签平滑及温度缩放的动态校准机制，有效解决了分布外数据导致的伪标签过度自信问题，实现了可靠的未知类别拒绝与高质量伪标签生成。
AI.keywords: 心电图分类, 半监督学习, 开放集识别, 模型校准, 时频分析
AI.comments: 该研究切中临床心电图分析中“未标注数据常混有未知病症/分布外异常”这一实际痛点。其创新点在于将时频域联合表征与模型动态校准（自适应标签平滑+温度缩放）相结合，不仅提升了半监督学习的分类精度，更大幅增强了模型在医疗高风险场景下的可信度与 OOD 拒绝能力，具有很高的实用价值。

title: JAX-AMG: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Sparse Linear Solver Library for JAX
summary: Sparse linear systems from PDE discretizations are central to scientific computing, yet no existing JAX-ecosystem solver simultaneously provides GPU-accelerated algebraic multigrid (AMG), automatic differentiation (AD), and distributed multi-GPU execution. JAX-AMG fills this gap by wrapping the NVIDIA AmgX solver suite as a native JAX primitive, exposing AMG and Krylov methods with configurable preconditioners through a unified interface compatible with JIT compilation, reverse-mode AD via adjoint methods, batched solves, and MPI-based distributed execution. Solver caching amortizes setup costs across repeated solves, making JAX-AMG practical for PDE-constrained optimization and inverse problems. The result is a robust, scalable sparse linear algebra layer that integrates seamlessly into differentiable simulation and scientific machine learning pipelines.

AI.title_translation: JAX-AMG：面向 JAX 的 GPU 加速可微稀疏线性求解器库
AI.tldr: JAX-AMG 将 NVIDIA AmgX 封装为 JAX 原语，为 JAX 生态带来了结合 GPU 加速代数多重网格（AMG）、自动微分和分布式多 GPU 执行的高效稀疏求解器。
AI.motivation: 偏微分方程（PDE）离散化产生的稀疏线性系统在科学计算中至关重要，但现有 JAX 生态中缺乏能同时支持 GPU 加速代数多重网格（AMG）、自动微分（AD）和分布式多 GPU 执行的求解器。
AI.method: 将 NVIDIA AmgX 求解器套件封装为原生 JAX 原语，提供统一接口支持 AMG 与 Krylov 方法；同时兼容 JIT 编译、基于伴随方法的反向模式自动微分、批处理求解和基于 MPI 的分布式多 GPU 执行，并引入求解器缓存机制来摊销重复求解的设置成本。
AI.result: 构建了一个鲁棒且可扩展的稀疏线性代数层，能够显著摊销重复求解成本，并无缝集成到可微模拟和科学机器学习流水线中。
AI.conclusion: JAX-AMG 成功为 JAX 生态系统提供了鲁棒、高性能且可扩展的稀疏线性代数求解能力，推动了可微物理模拟与科学机器学习的发展。
AI.translation: 来自偏微分方程（PDE）离散化的稀疏线性系统是科学计算的核心，然而现有的 JAX 生态系统中没有求解器能同时提供 GPU 加速的代数多重网格（AMG）、自动微分（AD）和分布式多 GPU 执行。JAX-AMG 通过将 NVIDIA AmgX 求解器套件封装为原生 JAX 原语填补了这一空白，通过与 JIT 编译、基于伴随方法的反向模式 AD、批处理求解和基于 MPI 的分布式执行相兼容的统一接口，暴露了具有可配置预条件子的 AMG 和 Krylov 方法。求解器缓存分摊了多次重复求解的设置成本，使 JAX-AMG 在 PDE 约束优化和反问题中具备实用性。其结果是一个鲁棒、可扩展的稀疏线性代数层，能够无缝集成到可微模拟和科学机器学习流水线中。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 JAX-AMG 库，它通过将 NVIDIA AmgX 封装为原生 JAX 原语，填补了 JAX 生态中缺乏兼具 GPU 加速代数多重网格、自动微分与分布式多 GPU 计算的求解器的空白。该库提供统一接口并引入缓存机制，为 PDE 约束优化和科学机器学习提供了强有力的底层算子支持。
AI.keywords: 代数多重网格, 自动微分, 稀疏线性求解器, JAX, 科学机器学习
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将高性能 GPU 科学计算库（NVIDIA AmgX）与现代化可微编程框架（JAX）深度结合，弥补了 JAX 生态在分布式 GPU 代数多重网格（AMG）与自动微分结合方面的空白，对科学机器学习（SciML）和 PDE 约束优化具有重要意义。局限在于该库依赖 NVIDIA 硬件及 AmgX 生态。

title: Semantic Evidence Regulation via Relational Bias for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
summary: Object navigation requires an embodied agent to locate a target object in an unknown environment through visual observations. Existing zero-shot methods typically leverage open-vocabulary perception and semantic priors to identify promising search regions. However, these methods often assume that semantic cues provide reliable guidance, while lacking mechanisms to assess and adjust their influence during exploration. Consequently, misleading semantic evidence can persist throughout navigation, biasing frontier selection and causing agents to repeatedly explore unreliable regions. To address this problem, we propose SER-Nav, a training-free framework that achieves dynamic Semantic Evidence Regulation via relational bias. SER-Nav introduces dual relational biases: activation reinforces target-related and contextual evidence to guide exploration, while inhibition attenuates misleading evidence caused by perceptual confusion and failed verification. These relational biases dynamically update the navigation search space, and a reliability-aware commitment gate prevents premature pursuit of insufficiently verified targets. By adaptively adjusting the influence of semantic cues, SER-Nav preserves useful guidance while mitigating persistent semantic misguidance under noisy open-vocabulary perception. Experiments on standard ObjectNav benchmarks demonstrate that SER-Nav consistently improves success rate and path efficiency over representative zero-shot methods. Extensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component. Real-world robot experiments further validate its robustness and practical applicability.

AI.title_translation: 零样本目标导航中基于关系偏差的语义证据调控
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SER-Nav，一个免训练框架，通过动态关系偏差调控语义证据，以解决零样本目标导航中语义误导问题，从而提高成功率和路径效率。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本目标导航方法依赖语义线索，但缺乏评估和调整其影响的机制，导致误导性语义证据持续存在，偏向边界选择，使代理重复探索不可靠区域。
AI.method: 本文提出了SER-Nav，一个免训练框架，通过引入双重关系偏差（激活和抑制）实现动态语义证据调控。激活偏差强化目标相关和上下文证据，抑制偏差减弱感知混淆和验证失败导致的误导性证据。此外，还引入了可靠性感知承诺门以防止过早追求未充分验证的目标。
AI.result: SER-Nav在标准ObjectNav基准上，相对于代表性零样本方法，持续提高了成功率和路径效率。广泛的消融研究验证了各组件的有效性。真实世界机器人实验进一步验证了其鲁棒性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: SER-Nav通过自适应调整语义线索的影响，在嘈杂的开放词汇感知下，既保留了有用指导，又减轻了持续的语义误导，显著提升了零样本目标导航的性能。
AI.translation: 目标导航要求具身代理在未知环境中通过视觉观测定位目标对象。现有的零样本方法通常利用开放词汇感知和语义先验来识别有希望的搜索区域。然而，这些方法通常假设语义线索提供可靠的指导，但缺乏在探索过程中评估和调整其影响的机制。因此，误导性语义证据可能在整个导航过程中持续存在，偏向边界选择，并导致代理重复探索不可靠区域。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SER-Nav，一个免训练框架，通过关系偏差实现动态语义证据调控。SER-Nav引入了双重关系偏差：激活偏差强化目标相关和上下文证据以引导探索，而抑制偏差减弱由感知混淆和验证失败引起的误导性证据。这些关系偏差动态更新导航搜索空间，并且一个可靠性感知承诺门防止过早追求未充分验证的目标。通过自适应调整语义线索的影响，SER-Nav在嘈杂的开放词汇感知下，既保留了有用指导，又减轻了持续的语义误导。在标准ObjectNav基准上的实验表明，SER-Nav相对于代表性零样本方法，持续提高了成功率和路径效率。广泛的消融研究进一步验证了每个组件的有效性。真实世界机器人实验进一步验证了其鲁棒性和实际适用性。
AI.summary: 本文针对零样本目标导航中语义线索可能导致误导的问题，提出了一个免训练框架SER-Nav。该框架通过引入激活和抑制双重关系偏差，动态调控语义证据，强化有用信息并减弱误导性信息。结合可靠性感知承诺门，SER-Nav能有效调整语义线索的影响，在嘈杂感知环境下提高导航的成功率和效率。
AI.keywords: 零样本目标导航, 语义证据调控, 关系偏差, 具身智能, 免训练框架
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个无需训练的框架，通过动态关系偏差来调控语义证据，有效解决了零样本目标导航中语义误导的难题。这种自适应调整语义线索影响的机制，对于提升具身智能体在未知环境中的鲁棒性和决策能力具有重要意义。其免训练特性也增强了其实用性。

title: Ouroboros-Spatial: Closing the Data-Model Loop for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches largely rely on large-scale, statically curated datasets, where all training samples are treated uniformly regardless of the model's evolving capabilities. This static paradigm is inherently data-inefficient: training capacity is often spent on samples that are either trivial or overly difficult for the model at its current stage. To address this limitation, we propose Ouroboros-Spatial, a self-evolving training framework in which the model plays dual roles as a proposer and a solver. In each iteration, a frozen proposer generates spatial question-answer (QA) pairs from 3D scene metadata and raw video frames, together with executable code for deriving reliable ground truth. A learnable solver is then fine-tuned on the accepted samples, and its per-sample prediction confidence is used as a difficulty signal. This signal is fed back to the proposer in the next iteration, guiding it to generate questions better matched to the solver's current capabilities. Through this closed-loop design, the training distribution co-evolves with model ability, reducing redundant trivial examples while filtering out ambiguous or uninformative samples with limited learning value. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks, Ouroboros-Spatial substantially improves Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B while using an order of magnitude fewer training examples than recent large-scale curated datasets. On VSI-Bench, it yields absolute gains of 9.9 and 6.8 points for the 4B and 8B models, respectively, enabling both to outperform a wide range of strong open-source and proprietary baselines.

title: Hyperbolicity-Preserving Stochastic Galerkin Methods for Conservation Laws Based on Associative Truncated Products on Polynomial Spaces
summary: Stochastic Galerkin discretizations of nonlinear hyperbolic conservation laws may lose hyperbolicity because the standard pseudospectral product is generally nonassociative, leading to non-commuting blocks in the flux Jacobian matrix. We develop a novel framework for constructing hyperbolicity-preserving stochastic Galerkin systems based on associative truncated products on polynomial spaces. In one stochastic dimension, we characterize associative truncated products through a single polynomial datum and identify examples with useful symmetry, positivity, and spectral properties, including collocation products and an associative symmetric product based on Gaussian quadrature nodes. We prove a consistency result showing that, under suitable projection-error assumptions, these products converge to the classical product as the polynomial degree grows. For systems with rational fluxes, we derive sufficient conditions under which the resulting stochastic Galerkin flux remains hyperbolic on the corresponding admissible set. Applications to the one-dimensional isothermal and compressible Euler equations show accurate statistical approximation and robust hyperbolicity preservation of the computed stochastic Galerkin states.

AI.title_translation: 基于多项式空间可结合截断积的守恒律保持双曲性随机Galerkin方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多项式空间可结合截断积的随机Galerkin方法，克服了传统伪谱积缺乏结合律的问题，从理论和数值上实现了对非线性双曲守恒律双曲性的稳健保持。
AI.motivation: 在非线性双曲守恒律的随机Galerkin离散化中，传统的伪谱积通常不满足结合律，导致通量雅可比矩阵中出现不可交换的块，进而使系统失去双曲性。
AI.method: 提出了基于多项式空间可结合截断积构建保持双曲性随机Galerkin系统的框架；在一维随机维度下利用单一多项式数据表征可结合截断积，并构造了基于高斯求积节点的结合律对称积等示例；证明了多项式阶数增长时的收敛一致性；针对有理通量系统推导了保持双曲性的充分条件。
AI.result: 在在一维等温及可压缩Euler方程的应用中，该方法展示出了精确的统计近似能力，并成功稳健地保持了计算出的随机Galerkin状态的双曲性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了一种基于可结合截断积的随机Galerkin框架，理论上保证了收敛一致性与双曲性保持条件，数值上在Euler方程中实现了高精度与高稳健性的双曲性保持，为不确定性量化中的双曲守恒律求解提供了有力工具。
AI.translation: 非线性双曲守恒律的随机Galerkin离散化可能会失去双曲性，因为标准的伪谱积通常不满足结合律，导致通量雅可比矩阵中出现不可交换的块。我们开发了一个新颖的框架，用于基于多项式空间上的结合律截断积构建保持双曲性的随机Galerkin系统。在一个随机维度下，我们通过单个多项式数据表征了结合律截断积，并识别了具有有用对称性、正定性和谱性质的示例，包括配点积和基于高斯求积节点的结合律对称积。我们证明了一致性结果，表明在适当的投影误差假设下，随着多项式阶数的增长，这些积收敛于经典积。对于具有有理通量的系统，我们导出了使生成的随机Galerkin通量在相应可接受集合上保持双曲性的充分条件。在一维等温和可压缩Euler方程上的应用表明，该方法具有精确的统计近似能力，并能稳健地保持所计算随机Galerkin状态的双曲性。
AI.summary: 本文针对随机Galerkin方法求解非线性双曲守恒律时易丧失双曲性的难题，提出了基于多项式空间可结合截断积的全新计算框架。论文在一维随机维度下表征了该截断积并给出了高斯节点对称积等实例，证明了方法的收敛一致性及有理通量系统保持双曲性的充分条件，并在Euler方程的数值实验中验证了其高精度与稳健的双曲性保持能力。
AI.keywords: 随机Galerkin方法, 双曲守恒律, 保持双曲性, 可结合截断积, Euler方程
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于从代数性质（结合律）入手，引入“可结合截断积”概念，打破了传统伪谱积不满足结合律导致通量雅可比矩阵失去双曲性的瓶颈；理论上给出了收敛一致性证明及保持双曲性的充分条件，并在Euler方程中展现了优异的数值稳健性。局限性在于目前详细的代数表征主要针对一维随机变量，推广到高维随机空间可能面临更高的代数复杂性。

title: The GIST Korea Test System: A Public-Data Synthetic Model of the Korean Power Grid
summary: No model of the Korean transmission system at native resolution is publicly available, hindering reproducible research on one of the world's most distinctive grids - an islanded interconnection with extreme separation between generation and the Seoul Metropolitan Area load center and heavy reliance on extra-high-voltage transmission. Working strictly from public data, we present the GIST Korea test system, a geographically grounded synthetic model of the Korean grid. Unlike fully synthetic cases, whose lines match no real corridor, and aggregated public Korean models, it derives its 345 and 154 kV layout from the OpenStreetMap power layer by a multi-source shortest-path reassembly of overhead-line and underground-cable geometry, gap-fills unmapped substations by a geographic minimum spanning tree, and calibrates aggregate circuit length to published statistics (94/100/104% at 765/345/154 kV). The current release spans 2265 buses, 614 generation and renewable sources (151 GW), 3185 AC circuits with explicit underground sections, four HVDC converter links, 3413 transformers, and reactive resources, in a PSS/E-compatible CSV schema with zero-sequence and grounding data for unbalanced-fault studies. The model is distributed as a frozen operating point - taps, setpoints, and bus voltages settled once offline - so a single deterministic Newton-Raphson pass reproduces a 91GW evening peak snapshot anchored to the observed 2025 summer peak (2.3% losses, no overloads), consistent with the public KPG-193 model. Standard-parameter dynamic, protection, and unit commitment layers, and a library of 24 hourly operating points derived by security-constrained unit commitment, extend the dataset beyond a single power flow case. The dataset, maps, and tooling are released as a citable, continuously maintained platform for power flow, planning, and decarbonization studies.

AI.title_translation: GIST韩国测试系统：韩国电网的公共数据合成模型
AI.tldr: GIST韩国测试系统是一个基于公共数据构建的韩国电网地理合成模型，旨在解决缺乏高分辨率韩国输电系统公开模型的问题，为可重复研究提供平台。
AI.motivation: 目前没有公开的、具有原始分辨率的韩国输电系统模型，这阻碍了对韩国这一独特电网（孤岛互联、发电与首尔都市区负荷中心之间高度分离、严重依赖特高压输电）进行可重复的研究。
AI.method: 该系统严格基于公共数据构建，通过多源最短路径重组OpenStreetMap电力层的数据来推导345和154 kV的布局，利用地理最小生成树填充未映射的变电站，并根据公开统计数据校准总电路长度。
AI.result: 当前版本包含2265个母线、614个发电和可再生能源（151 GW）、3185条带有明确地下部分的交流线路、四个HVDC换流站、3413个变压器和无功资源，采用PSS/E兼容的CSV格式，包含用于非平衡故障研究的零序和接地数据。该模型以冻结运行点发布，通过一次确定性牛顿-拉夫逊迭代重现了91GW的晚高峰快照，与KPG-193模型一致。数据集还扩展了动态、保护和机组组合层，以及一个包含24个小时运行点的库。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集、地图和工具作为一个可引用、持续维护的平台发布，用于潮流、规划和脱碳研究。
AI.translation: 目前没有公开的、具有原始分辨率的韩国输电系统模型，这阻碍了对世界上最具特色的电网之一——一个孤岛互联、发电与首尔都市区负荷中心之间高度分离、严重依赖特高压输电的电网——进行可重复的研究。我们严格基于公共数据，提出了GIST韩国测试系统，这是一个基于地理的韩国电网合成模型。与完全合成的案例（其线路不匹配任何真实走廊）和聚合的韩国公共模型不同，它通过多源最短路径重组架空线和地下电缆几何结构，从OpenStreetMap电力层推导出其345和154 kV的布局，通过地理最小生成树填充未映射的变电站，并根据已发布的统计数据校准总电路长度（765/345/154 kV下分别为94/100/104%）。当前版本包括2265个母线、614个发电和可再生能源（151 GW）、3185条带有明确地下部分的交流线路、四个HVDC换流站、3413个变压器和无功资源，采用PSS/E兼容的CSV模式，包含用于非平衡故障研究的零序和接地数据。该模型以冻结运行点发布——分接头、设定点和母线电压离线一次确定——因此一次确定性牛顿-拉夫逊迭代即可重现一个91GW的晚高峰快照，该快照以观测到的2025年夏季高峰为锚点（2.3%损耗，无过载），与公共KPG-193模型一致。标准参数的动态、保护和机组组合层，以及一个由安全约束机组组合推导出的24个小时运行点库，将数据集扩展到单个潮流案例之外。该数据集、地图和工具作为一个可引用、持续维护的平台发布，用于潮流、规划和脱碳研究。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了GIST韩国测试系统，这是一个基于公共数据构建的韩国电网高分辨率地理合成模型。鉴于当前缺乏公开的韩国输电系统原始分辨率模型，该系统旨在填补空白，支持可重复研究。它通过整合OpenStreetMap数据、地理最小生成树和统计数据校准来构建电网布局，并提供了包含2265个母线、614个发电电源、3185条交流线路等详细信息的PSS/E兼容数据集。该模型以冻结运行点发布，可重现2025年夏季高峰的电网快照，并包含动态、保护和机组组合层以及多小时运行点数据，作为一个持续维护的平台，支持潮流、规划和脱碳研究。
AI.keywords: 韩国电网, 合成模型, 公共数据, 输电系统, OpenStreetMap
AI.comments: 该论文通过严格利用公共数据构建了韩国电网的高分辨率合成模型，解决了现有公开模型不足的问题，为电力系统研究提供了宝贵且可重复的资源。其创新之处在于结合OpenStreetMap数据、地理空间算法和统计校准，创建了一个既地理精确又符合实际运行统计的详细模型，并提供了PSS/E兼容数据和多时间尺度的运行点，极大地促进了对韩国独特电网的分析和规划。

title: Functional Cache Grafting: Robust and Rapid Code-Policy Synthesis for Embodied Agents
summary: Code-writing large language models (CodeLLMs) generate executable code policies for embodied agents by translating natural language goals and environmental constraints into structured control programs. However, policy generation in open-domain embodied environments suffers from two fundamental limitations: (i) delayed decoding caused by repetitive prefill computation over long prompts, and (ii) limited robustness due to fully generative decoding, which often produces API mismatches, missing safety guards, and unstable control logic. To address these limitations, we present FCGraft, a Functional Cache Grafting framework. FCGraft maintains a library of function-level validated code skeletons and their associated prompt-level Transformer key-value (KV) caches, and synthesizes new policies by retrieving relevant functions and grafting their KV caches when a new task is provided. Given retrieved function caches, FCGraft performs cache grafting via stitching, which composes cached function segments into a composite policy, and patching, which locally adapts only the necessary code regions to satisfy task-specific parameters and constraints with minimal additional decoding. By eliminating redundant prefill computation, this approach reduces generation latency, while reusing validated control structures improves robustness over prompt-level caching methods RAGCache, achieving 18.31% higher task success rate and 2.3x faster policy synthesis.

AI.title_translation: 函数式缓存移植：面向具身智能体的高鲁棒与快速代码策略合成
AI.tldr: FCGraft通过函数级KV缓存移植（拼接与局部补丁），大幅降低具身代码策略合成延迟并提升18.31%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 代码大语言模型（CodeLLM）在开放域具身环境中生成代码策略时存在两个根本缺陷：一是长提示词上的重复预填充（prefill）计算导致高解码延迟；二是完全生成式解码鲁棒性不足，容易出现API不匹配、缺少安全防护和控制逻辑不稳定等问题。
AI.method: 提出了FCGraft（函数式缓存移植）框架。该框架维护一个经验证的函数级代码骨架及其对应的Transformer KV缓存库；在接收到新任务时，检索相关函数缓存，通过“拼接”（将缓存的函数片段组合成复合策略）和“补丁”（仅局部修改必要代码区域以满足特定参数和约束，极小化额外解码）来执行缓存移植与代码合成。
AI.result: 与RAGCache等提示词级缓存方法相比，FCGraft消除了冗余预填充计算，实现了18.31%的任务成功率提升以及2.3倍的策略合成加速。
AI.conclusion: 函数式缓存移植通过复用已验证的控制结构和局部极小解码调整，有效解决了长提示词解码延迟和全生成式逻辑不稳定的问题，为具身智能体的高效、鲁棒策略合成提供了行之有效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 代码编写大语言模型（CodeLLM）通过将自然语言目标和环境约束转换为结构化控制程序，为具身智能体生成可执行的代码策略。然而，在开放域具身环境中生成策略面临两个根本局限性：（i）长提示词上的重复预填充计算导致解码延迟；（ii）完全生成式解码导致鲁棒性有限，常产生API不匹配、缺少安全防护措施以及控制逻辑不稳定等问题。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了FCGraft（函数式缓存移植）框架。FCGraft维护了一个经过验证的函数级代码骨架及其关联的提示词级Transformer键值（KV）缓存库，并在提供新任务时通过检索相关函数并移植其KV缓存来合成新策略。在给定检索到的函数缓存后，FCGraft通过“拼接”（将缓存的函数片段组合为复合策略）和“补丁”（仅局部调整必要的代码区域以满足特定任务参数和约束，且只需极少的额外解码）来执行缓存移植。通过消除冗余的预填充计算，该方法降低了生成延迟，同时相比提示词级缓存方法（如RAGCache），复用经过验证的控制结构提高了鲁棒性，实现了任务成功率提升18.31%以及策略合成速度加快2.3倍。
AI.summary: 针对具身智能体代码策略生成中的高延迟与低鲁棒性问题，本文提出了FCGraft框架。该框架通过检索已验证的函数级代码KV缓存，并运用拼接与局部补丁技术快速合成新策略，显著降低了计算开销并提高了生成策略的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 具身智能体, 代码策略合成, KV缓存移植, 代码大语言模型, 拼接与补丁
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将Transformer KV Cache复用提升到了函数/模块化代码层面，结合了代码检索复用与局部微调（拼接与补丁机制），突破了全自动生成式解码易出错且延迟高的瓶颈，对具身智能体中的实时控制和可靠性保障具有重要的实用价值。

title: SkillCAT: Contrastive, Assessment-Augmented and Topology-AwareSkill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Skill self-evolution methods for LLM agents aim to turn execution trajectories into reusable skill documents. However, current pipelines typically derive skill patches from a single trajectory per task, merge them indiscriminately, and load the entire skill corpus during inference. These choices lead to unreliable evidence extraction, the accumulation of low-quality or even harmful skill edits, and inefficient use of context due to irrelevant or conflicting skill content. We propose SkillCAT, a framework that decomposes this process into three stages. (1) Contrastive Causal Extraction (CCE) samples multiple trajectories per task and contrasts same-task success/failure pairs to find the evidence that explains outcome differences. (2) Assessment-Augmented Evolution (AAE) replays each candidate patch on source-task clones, retains only those that do not damage task outcomes, and then merges the retained patches hierarchically. (3) Topology-Aware Task Execution (TTE) compiles the evolved skills into routable sub-skill topologies, so that inference loads only task-relevant capability nodes. We evaluate SkillCAT on widely-used agent benchmarks, including SpreadsheetBench, WikiTableQuestions, and DocVQA, and further assess cross-model and out-of-distribution generalization. Across these settings, SkillCAT improves the average score over the initial skill by up to 49.69%, demonstrating reliable and effective skill evolution.

AI.title_translation: SkillCAT：大语言模型智能体的对比式、评估增强与拓扑感知技能自我演化框架
AI.tldr: SkillCAT通过对比因果提取、评估增强演化和拓扑感知执行三阶段框架，实现了可靠、无害且高效的LLM智能体技能自我演化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的技能自我演化方法通常仅从单条任务轨迹派生技能补丁，盲目合并，并在推理时加载全部技能语料。这导致证据提取不可靠、低质量或有害的技能编辑不断累积，且因无关或冲突内容导致上下文利用效率低下。
AI.method:
提出SkillCAT框架，包含三个核心阶段：
1. 对比因果提取（CCE）：为每个任务采样多条轨迹，对比同一任务的成功/失败对，提取能解释结果差异的因果证据；
2. 评估增强演化（AAE）：在源任务克隆上回放候选补丁，仅保留不损害任务结果的补丁并进行分层合并；
3. 拓扑感知任务执行（TTE）：将演化后的技能编译为可路由的子技能拓扑结构，推理时仅按需加载任务相关的能力节点。
AI.result: 在SpreadsheetBench、WikiTableQuestions和DocVQA等标准智能体基准测试以及跨模型与分布外泛化评估中，SkillCAT相比初始技能将平均得分提升了高达49.69%。
AI.conclusion: SkillCAT通过三阶段协同机制成功解决了传统技能自我演化中的噪音累积与上下文低效问题，实现了可靠、高质量且高效的智能体技能演化。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体的技能自我演化方法旨在将执行轨迹转化为可复用的技能文档。然而，当前的流程通常仅从每个任务的单一轨迹派生技能补丁，盲目合并它们，并在推理期间加载整个技能语料库。这些选择导致不可靠的证据提取、低质量甚至有害技能编辑的积累，以及由于无关或冲突的技能内容导致的上下文利用效率低下。我们提出了SkillCAT，这是一个将该过程分解为三个阶段的框架：(1) 对比因果提取（CCE）为每个任务采样多条轨迹，并对比同一任务的成功/失败对，以找到解释结果差异的证据。(2) 评估增强演化（AAE）在源任务克隆上回放每个候选补丁，仅保留那些不会损害任务结果的补丁，然后分层合并保留的补丁。(3) 拓扑感知任务执行（TTE）将演化后的技能编译为可路由的子技能拓扑，以便推理仅加载与任务能力相关的节点。我们在广泛使用的智能体基准（包括SpreadsheetBench、WikiTableQuestions和DocVQA）上评估了SkillCAT，并进一步评估了跨模型和分布外的泛化能力。在这些设定下，SkillCAT相比初始技能将平均得分提升了高达49.69%，展示了可靠且有效的技能演化。
AI.summary: 针对LLM智能体技能自我演化中存在的证据提取不可靠、有害编辑累积及推理上下文冗余等问题，本文提出了SkillCAT框架。该框架通过对比因果提取（CCE）、评估增强演化（AAE）和拓扑感知任务执行（TTE）三阶段协同，显著提高了技能演化的质量与推理效率，并在多个基准测试中取得了高达49.69%的性能提升。
AI.keywords: LLM Agents, Skill Self-Evolution, Contrastive Learning, Skill Topology, Capability Routing
AI.comments:
创新性：该论文通过成功/失败轨迹对比精准识别因果证据，并结合评估回放验证与拓扑路由，系统地解决了智能体技能自我演化中的噪声积累与推理效率难题。
重要性：为LLM智能体的持续学习和自动技能积累提供了更具稳健性和可扩展性的范式。
局限性：评估增强阶段需在源任务克隆上回放候选补丁，这可能会增加演化阶段的计算开销与采样成本。

title: From Phase Semantics to Base-extension Semantics (and back)
summary: Linear logic admits a wide range of semantic presentations reflecting its resource-sensitive notion of consequence. One well-known example is phase semantics: an algebraic semantics in which formulas are interpreted in phase models, consisting of a phase space formed by a commutative monoid and a fixed subset, with respect to which an orthogonality relation is defined, and a valuation. A rather different and much more recent approach is given by base-extension semantics, which defines validity by inductively extending a provability relation on a base -- a set of inference rules over atomic propositions. We establish an equivalence between the two semantics by first defining bidirectional maps between bases and phase models, and then constructing an isomorphism between a phase model (resp. base) and its image under the composition of these maps. As a further contribution, we define the base-extension semantics clauses for the exponentials of linear logic.

AI.title_translation: 从相位语义到基扩展语义（以及反向转换）
AI.tldr: 本文建立了线性逻辑中相位语义与基扩展语义之间的等价性，并给出了指数连结词的基扩展语义定义。
AI.motivation: 线性逻辑拥有多种反映其资源敏感特性的语义表示（如代数型的相位语义与较新的基扩展语义），但这两者之间的内在关联尚未得到确立；此外，基扩展语义也需要扩展以支持线性逻辑中的指数连结词。
AI.method: 通过定义基（base）与相位模型之间的双向映射，并构造相位模型（或基）与其在映射复合下的图像之间的同构，从而确立两种语义的等价关系；同时设计了针对线性逻辑指数连结词的基扩展语义子句。
AI.result: 成功建立了相位语义与基扩展语义之间的等价性与同构关系，并补充给出了线性逻辑指数连结词的基扩展语义定义。
AI.conclusion: 相位语义与基扩展语义在线性逻辑中具有内在的等价性，且基扩展语义能够成功扩展以支持包含指数连结词的完整线性逻辑。
AI.translation: 线性逻辑允许广泛的语义表现形式，以反映其对资源敏感的推论概念。一个众所周知的例子是相位语义：一种代数语义，其中公式在相位模型中进行解释，相位模型由交换单半群和固定子集构成的相位空间（针对该空间定义了正交关系）以及赋值组成。一种截然不同且要新得多的方法是基扩展语义，它通过在基（即原子命题上的一组推理规则）上归纳扩展可证明性关系来定义有效性。我们通过首先定义基与相位模型之间的双向映射，然后构造相位模型（或基）与其在这两个映射复合下的图像之间的同构，建立了这两种语义之间的等价性。作为进一步的贡献，我们给出了线性逻辑指数连结词的基扩展语义子句。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了线性逻辑中相位语义与基扩展语义的关系。作者通过定义基与相位模型之间的双向映射及同构关系，证明了这两种不同语义体系的等价性，并进一步给出了线性逻辑指数连结词在基扩展语义下的定义。
AI.keywords: 线性逻辑, 相位语义, 基扩展语义, 指数连结词, 语义等价性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于成功连接了线性逻辑中代数范式的相位语义与基于规则扩展的基扩展语义，建立了二者之间的同构与等价关系。此外，将基扩展语义推广至线性逻辑的指数连结词（exponentials），填补了该领域的重要理论空白，对证明论语义学的发展具有重要意义。

title: Projective Graph Residualization: Variation-Allocation Frontiers for Control-Function IV
comments: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). 33 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Control-function instrumental-variable estimators pass an estimated first-stage residual to an outcome model. The residual must retain the latent control direction while leaving enough treatment variation to identify the structural effect. These demands conflict when the systematic signal is locally smooth but discontinuous across unknown feature-graph boundaries: interpolation can erase the residual, whereas isotropic smoothing can move systematic variation across a boundary. We propose Adaptive Anisotropic Instrumental Heat Flow (A-IHF), which adapts edge conductance from pilot treatment contrasts, extracts a generated control with a complementary sparse resolvent, and tunes without outcomes. For a linear control-function regression, only the generated control's span matters. This projective view yields an exact finite-sample fidelity--relevance frontier, spectral identities for residualized treatment variation and coefficient distortion, and a lower bound for monotone residual filters. A connected construction shows that conductance adaptation can escape the corresponding fixed-graph obstruction. Across 54 benchmark cells, the A-IHF family wins 32 and guarded observational A-IHF reduces mean nonlinear response error by 8.3 percent, with gains concentrated in fractured designs. Exact distortion correlates 0.998 with realized linear coefficient error. Controlled graph rewiring further shows that connectivity alone is inadequate: an outcome-free compatibility screen triggers foldwise fallback and, under severe corruption, abstention.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). 33 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material

title: LOCUS: Local Visual Cue Search for Enhancing Fine-Grained Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) remain unreliable on fine-grained visual perception, even when high-resolution inputs preserve the necessary local details. We identify this limitation as visual context rot: decisive evidence may exist in the full image, yet fail to be reliably selected and used amid redundant visual context. We propose LOCUS (LOcal visual CUe Search), a training framework that teaches MLLMs to internalize local evidence search through a verifiable proxy task. During training, LOCUS provides a local crop as a visual cue and optimizes the model to recover its spatial support in the full image using an IoU-based reward. The visual cue is used only during training, leaving the standard image-question inference interface unchanged. Experiments across fine-grained perception, hallucination, general understanding, and reasoning benchmarks show that LOCUS improves localization-sensitive visual understanding while preserving broad capabilities. Attention analyses further indicate stronger focus on task-relevant evidence regions, suggesting that training-time visual cue search provides an effective route to internalized fine-grained evidence selection.

title: Constellation-Level Power Allocation for LEO Space-Based Solar Power
comments: Paper accepted at the 2026 IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2026-Fall), Boston, MA, USA, 6 - 9 September, 2026
summary: Space-based solar power (SBSP) has recently gained renewed attention as an appealing technological advancement for providing continuous clean energy using space-based infrastructure. However, the potential of low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellations for SBSP remains largely unexplored and lacks detailed simulation-based studies. In this paper, we introduce a novel LEO SBSP system model and conduct a 24-hour system-level simulation of a Walker 4x5 LEO SBSP constellation at an altitude of 450 km, beaming 2.45 GHz microwave power to eight ground stations (GSs) under a greedy allocation policy. The model includes orbital propagation, eclipse cycles, the satellite power chain, Goubau-Brown beam coupling, ITU-R P.618 atmospheric attenuation, and onboard battery dynamics. The results confirm that the peak DC power delivered reaches 1.986 MW, while the mean per-site delivery at the served GS ranged from 40 to 75 kW. Two of the eight GSs received no service during the run, as their passes were consistently ranked lower under the greedy policy than competing links at the same step. The incident peak power density (PD) at the rectenna remained within the 3.35-5.72 W/m$^2$ range, below the International Commission on Non-Ionizing Radiation Protection (ICNIRP) general-public exposure limit. For a 20-satellite Walker LEO at this altitude, realistic per-site delivery is 50-100 kW, and the rectenna should be sized to the operational incident PD of order 5 W/m$^2$ rather than to a Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO)-era 100 W/m$^2$ rating.
comment: Paper accepted at the 2026 IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2026-Fall), Boston, MA, USA, 6 - 9 September, 2026

title: VEGA: Learning Navigation VLAs from In-the-Wild Egocentric Video with Geometric Trajectory Supervision
summary: We introduce VEGA, an approach for training navigation VisionLanguage-Action (VLA) models from unlabeled egocentric navigation videos. Internet-scale egocentric videos provide a scalable source of navigation-relevant visual observations, capturing cluttered scenes, close-range obstacles, and natural human motion through real-world spaces. However, these videos are not directly usable for policy learning because they do not provide obstacle-aware trajectories conditioned on explicit navigation goals in the robot's coordinate frame. VEGA addresses this gap by reconstructing local scene geometry from monocular video, sampling navigation goals (represented as text, image, or spatial waypoints) and generating obstacle-aware trajectories using the constructed geometry. The resulting trajectory distribution is then used to train a flow-matching VLA navigation policy. By using geometry exclusively during training, VEGA distills obstacle-aware planning directly into a vision-based policy. Furthermore, we introduce VEGA-Bench, a benchmark containing 250k scenes and approximately 5 million navigation goals paired with scene geometry, designed to evaluate goal progress, collision avoidance, and obstacle clearance of VLAs. Our evaluation shows that VEGA achieves competitive goal progress while reducing collisions by 33.0% and improving obstacle clearance by 17.9% over the strongest baseline on VEGABench, while improving success by at least 150.0%, reducing collisions by at least 66.7%, and improving obstacle clearance by at least 60.0% in real-world trials. Ultimately, we demonstrate that video-derived geometric supervision provides a scalable and effective signal for training obstacle-aware navigation VLAs. The code and benchmark will be released at the time of publication.

title: TGCM: Topic-Guided Consistency Modeling for One-Step Disentanglement of Interleaved APT Technique Sequences
comments: 14 pages, Due to arXiv's abstract length limit, the web version of the abstract has been shortened while preserving the paper's original scope, claims, and results. The implementation and experimental artifacts are publicly available at https://irish-kw.github.io/TGCM_Website/
summary:
Multiple Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) campaigns may execute concurrently, producing audit logs whose events are interleaved without explicit campaign boundaries. We formulate this setting as Unknown-K Interleaved Sequence Demixing (UKISD): recovering coherent campaign episodes when the number of concurrent campaigns is unknown. Each episode is represented as a sequence of MITRE ATT&CK technique occurrences, and demixing is cast as occurrence-level assignment with sequence reconstruction. Existing methods often assume single-campaign observations or rely on local heuristics, limiting robustness to severe interleaving, repeated techniques, abstraction noise, and unknown mixture cardinality.
  We propose Topic-Guided Consistency Modeling (TGCM), a consistency-inspired one-step framework for UKISD. TGCM maps an interleaved technique sequence to campaign episodes, jointly performing occurrence assignment and sequence reconstruction in one forward pass. It combines topic guidance from ATT&CK narratives with an embedding-space self-consistency objective to improve semantic coherence and retain efficient inference.
  We evaluate TGCM on synthetic mixtures, mixed benchmarks, DARPA engagement traces, and CAPTure, an end-to-end benchmark containing 200 scenarios, 855 million audit events, and 25 ATT&CK-aligned attack profiles in single-host and multi-host settings. TGCM improves occurrence-level assignment under heavy interleaving, repeated technique reuse, symbolic extraction errors, and budgeted unknown-K inference. It also generalizes to unseen benchmarks without retraining and remains effective with practical ATT&CK extraction pipelines. These results establish TGCM as a practical post-abstraction framework for reasoning about concurrent APT campaigns. Code and artifacts are available at https://irish-kw.github.io/TGCM_Website/.
